title: Account-History Features for Social Bot Detection in the Era of Large Language Models

detail.title: Account-History Features for Social Bot Detection in the Era of Large Language Models

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests, personal relationships, or financial arrangements that could have influenced this work. The research was conducted independently of any employer and reflects the author's own scholarly interest in the topic.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No ethics approval was sought or required. The study uses only publicly redistributed, pre-existing datasets of social-media account metadata. No new data was collected from human subjects, no live platform was accessed, and no personally identifiable information was processed beyond what was already in the publicly redistributed datasets.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this research. The work was conducted by the author in a personal capacity.

detail.abstract: Bot detection on social platforms has historically relied on a mix of account-metadata features and features extracted from the text of posts and profile fields. The arrival of capable language models complicates the latter. A bot operator can run every post through GPT-4 or Claude and produce text whose surface statistics are difficult to distinguish from those of human writing, which weakens the predictive value of content-derived features. This paper asks how much of the detection problem can be solved by features that an attacker cannot easily manipulate at low cost: the age of the account, follower and friend counts and their ratios, profile completeness, and the structural properties of the handle. On a publicly redistributed corpus of 2,432 Twitter accounts with manually verified labels (43.0% bots), a random forest using only these accounthistory features achieves ROC-AUC of 0.977 in five-fold cross-validation, against 0.830 for a content-only baseline and 0.981 for the fusion model. The behavioral-versus-content gap is large and statistically significant by DeLong's test (z = 9.36, p < 0.001). We then evaluate two adversarial settings. In the first, we rewrite the text of bot tweets to match human surface statistics for URLs, hashtags, mentions, and casing; the content classifier's ROC-AUC degrades from 0.842 to 0.785 while the behavioral classifier is essentially unchanged. In the second, more aggressive setting we directly perturb the content feature values toward the human distribution; the content classifier falls below chance (AUC 0.466) while behavioral performance is invariant. We replicate the score distribution qualitatively on a 100-account sample of TwiBot-20. We conclude that operational bot detection should not treat content features as the primary signal; account-history features carry most of the load already and are not eroded by adversarial text rewriting.

AI.tldr: 本文发现，在大语言模型时代，基于账户历史行为特征（如账号年龄、粉丝数等）的机器人检测方法，比基于文本内容的特征更稳健且效果更好。在对抗性文本改写下，内容分类器性能大幅下降，而行为分类器几乎不受影响。
AI.research_question: 在大语言模型能够轻松生成与人类难以区分的文本的背景下，仅靠账户历史行为特征（攻击者难以低成本操纵的特征）能在多大程度上解决机器人检测问题？
AI.motivation: 随着GPT-4等强大语言模型的出现，机器人运营者可以生成表面统计特征与人类写作难以区分的文本，从而削弱了基于文本内容的机器人检测特征的价值。因此，需要探索那些攻击者难以低成本操纵的特征（如账户历史行为特征）能否成为更可靠的检测信号。
AI.theoretical_framework: 机器人检测的特征分类：内容特征（文本统计特征）vs. 行为/账户历史特征（账号年龄、关注/粉丝关系、资料完整性、账号结构属性）；对抗性攻击框架：文本改写攻击和特征值扰动攻击。
AI.method: 使用公开数据集（2,432个Twitter账户，43.0%为机器人），采用随机森林模型，对比仅使用账户历史行为特征、仅使用内容特征以及两者融合模型的ROC-AUC表现；使用DeLong检验评估显著性；设计两种对抗性设置（文本改写和特征值扰动）评估模型鲁棒性。
AI.findings: 仅使用账户历史特征即可达到ROC-AUC 0.977，内容特征仅0.830，融合模型0.981。对抗性文本改写使内容分类器AUC从0.842降至0.785，行为分类器基本不变；更激进的扰动使内容分类器低于随机水平（AUC 0.466），行为分类器保持稳健。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确揭示了在大语言模型时代，内容特征在机器人检测中的脆弱性和行为特征的鲁棒性，为机器人检测的特征选择提供了理论依据；提出了对抗性攻击下的分类器性能退化框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社交平台运营者提供了明确的建议：机器人检测不应以文本内容特征为主要信号，而应优先利用账户历史行为特征；这些特征不仅携带了大部分检测信息，而且难以被低成本对抗性攻击所侵蚀。

title: Decomposing Information Acquisition Cost: Technical Access and Processing Capability Barrier in Cross-Border Electronic Disclosure Systems
affiliations: Korea University Business School, Arizona State University (ASU) - Thunderbird School of Global Management, University of Hawaii, Manoa and Korea University Business School

detail.title: Decomposing Information Acquisition Cost: Technical Access and Processing Capability Barrier in Cross-Border Electronic Disclosure Systems
detail.abstract: Regulatory bodies in emerging markets have increasingly adopted electronic disclosure systems to reduce information frictions facing foreign investors. However, expanding access to disclosed information does not always translate into more informed trading behavior, suggesting that disclosure-system effectiveness may depend on which acquisition barrier the intervention addresses. We develop a two-barrier framework that decomposes information acquisition cost into two structurally independent components, a technical access component and a processing capability component, each resolved by a categorically different disclosure-system intervention. We exploit the sequential rollout of Korea's electronic disclosure system as a natural experiment, comparing a 2021 expansion of automated data retrieval to a 2023 enhancement of language-related navigation and translation support. We find that foreign investors' trade quality improves only after the language-related intervention, while trading engagement responds positively at both stages without evidence of a significant difference in magnitude. This pattern of decoupling at Stage 1 and recoupling at Stage 2 constitutes the framework's central diagnostic prediction. The Stage 2 response further diverges across investor groups, with foreign investors' abnormal net buying becoming more positively associated with future returns while domestic individual investors' net buying becomes less informative. The cross-investor sign reversal is difficult to reconcile with a simple common market-wide shock. Heterogeneity analyses provide suggestive evidence of a complementarity condition under which the two interventions appear to matter under different stock-level conditions. Our study contributes to research on information technology and capital markets by showing that disclosure-system effectiveness depends on the structural match between intervention type and the binding user constraint and offers implications for the design of disclosure infrastructure in cross-border settings.

AI.tldr: 韩国电子披露系统分阶段实施的数据发现，只有解决语言处理障碍的干预措施才能提升外资交易质量，而技术接入改善仅增加交易参与度。这揭示了信息披露系统有效性取决于干预类型与用户约束之间结构性匹配的关键机制。
AI.research_question: 新兴市场电子披露系统的不同干预措施（技术接入 vs. 语言处理）对外国投资者交易行为和信息效率的影响是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 监管机构广泛采用电子披露系统以减少信息摩擦，但扩大信息可及性并不总能转化为更知情的交易行为。现有文献未能区分信息获取成本中不同结构性障碍（技术接入与处理能力）的独立作用效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双障碍框架（Two-Barrier Framework）：将信息获取成本分解为技术接入成本和处理能力成本，不同障碍需要不同类型的披露系统干预来解决。
AI.method: 利用韩国电子披露系统分阶段推出的自然实验，比较2021年自动数据检索扩展（技术接入干预）与2023年语言导航和翻译支持增强（语言处理干预）对外资交易行为的影响。
AI.findings: （1）仅在语言处理干预后，外资交易质量提升；（2）两个阶段交易参与度均提升，且幅度无显著差异；（3）外资异常净买入与未来收益的正向关系仅在第二阶段显著，而国内散户净买入的信息含量下降；（4）不同投资者群体的符号反转难以用共同市场冲击解释。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将信息获取成本分解为技术接入与处理能力两个结构性独立组件，并实证证明披露系统有效性取决于干预类型与用户瓶颈约束的结构匹配。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场跨境信息披露基础设施的设计提供政策启示：仅改善技术接入不足以提升外资信息交易质量，需同时关注语言等处理能力障碍。对交易所和监管机构优化电子披露系统具有直接指导意义。

title: SoK: AI-Assisted Threat Intelligence Pipelines -A Taxonomy and Research Agenda for the Agentic Transition

detail.title: SoK: AI-Assisted Threat Intelligence Pipelines -A Taxonomy and Research Agenda for the Agentic Transition

publicationDetails.detailsText: Not applicable. This manuscript has not previously appeared in, nor been accepted to appear in, any paper series, journal, or book.

detail.abstract: Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI) is in the middle of an architectural transition. Organizations are layering machine learning, large language models, and most recently autonomous agents into operational pipelines faster than the literature can document, and production practice has outpaced academic evaluation. Most published evaluations still focus on isolated model performance, while practitioners report that production success depends on governance, integration, and human-AI collaboration. This systematization makes three contributions. First, it operationalizes the CTI Autonomy-Stakes Framework through the Behavioral Autonomy Criteria (chained reasoning, state change, external effect, approval gating), a proposed set of observable tests for classifying AI-CTI systems by actual behavior rather than vendor description. The framework locates systems on dimensions of agent autonomy and decision consequence, with a "Guarded Agency" zone where viable production systems should sit. Second, it organizes the field into three architectural generations-rule-based with analyst review, AI-assisted analysis, and agent-directed execution-plus an autonomous-defense boundary, and grounds the framing in the documented evolution of named SOAR and SIEM platforms. Third, it identifies a research agenda focused on the evaluation gaps and adversarial-robustness questions most likely to determine whether the agentic transition produces trustworthy systems, in an environment where threat actors themselves are now operating AI-augmented tooling. The corpus weighs practitioner-authored and platform-derived sources alongside peer-reviewed work; in a field where production systems appear before academic evaluation of them, a SoK restricted to peer-reviewed sources would describe a field that does not exist.

AI.tldr: 本文系统化梳理了CTI从规则型到AI辅助再到自主代理的架构演进，提出了CTI自主性-风险框架和行为自主性标准，指出生产实践已超越学术评估，并提出了面向评估漏洞和对抗鲁棒性的研究议程。
AI.research_question: 如何系统化分类和评估CTI系统中人工智能与自主代理的实际行为、架构演进及治理需求？
AI.motivation: CTI领域正经历架构转型，生产实践已超越学术评估速度。现有评估仍聚焦孤立模型性能，而实践者报告生产成功取决于治理、集成和人机协作，存在系统性分类与评估框架的缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: CTI自主性-风险框架（CTI Autonomy-Stakes Framework），包含行为自主性标准（链式推理、状态变更、外部效应、审批门控），以及"受控代理"（Guarded Agency）概念区域。
AI.method: 系统化分类（Systematization），综合同行评审文献、实践者来源和平台衍生资料，基于实际行为而非厂商描述对AI-CTI系统进行分类。
AI.findings: (1) 提出了行为自主性标准（链式推理、状态变更、外部效应、审批门控）;(2) 将CTI架构分为三代：基于规则+分析师审查、AI辅助分析、代理自主执行，外加自主防御边界;(3) 识别了评估缺口和对抗鲁棒性问题作为关键研究议程。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出CTI自主性-风险框架及行为自主性标准，为以实际行为而非厂商描述分类AI-CTI系统提供了系统化理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 界定了"受控代理"（Guarded Agency）作为可行生产系统的定位区域；为SOAR和SIEM平台的架构演进提供了系统性分类；指出了评估与对抗鲁棒性的优先研究方向。

title: Researcher Latency: Independent Practitioner-Research, Institutional Infrastructure Gaps, and the Case for a Portable Research Identity Standard

detail.title: Researcher Latency: Independent Practitioner-Research, Institutional Infrastructure Gaps, and the Case for a Portable Research Identity Standard

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author holds UK patent applications covering technical implementations described in related prior work in the Rainfame Research Series. No competing financial or personal interests exist in relation to the subject matter of this paper. This paper does not describe a commercial product or service.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This research does not involve human subjects, human participants, human data, animal subjects, or tissue samples. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted independently by the author through Rainfame Technologies Ltd.

detail.abstract: The United Kingdom's research and innovation ecosystem operates on an institutional architecture designed for a labour market in which original research is conducted predominantly within universities and formally constituted research organisations. This architecture has not kept pace with the distributed knowledge economy, in which a growing population of practitioner-researchers conducts systematic original inquiry outside formal academic employment or enrolment. This paper introduces Researcher Latency as a formally defined structural concept describing the measurable gap between the achievement of an original research contribution and its formal recognition by the institutional infrastructure of the research and innovation system. Drawing on the economics of innovation, the sociology of Researcher Latency: Independent Practitioner-Research and Institutional Infrastructure knowledge production, and the governance literature on professional standards, the paper documents four measurable dimensions of Researcher Latency: credential exclusion, resource inaccessibility, recognition asymmetry, and portability deficit. It proposes the Independent Practitioner-Researcher as a formally defined category and outlines the architecture of a Portable Research Identity Standard as the institutional infrastructure response. The paper argues that Researcher Latency is an efficiency and innovation infrastructure problem whose resolution would increase the return on research investment at the national level and is not a welfare or recognition concern for individual researchers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"研究者延迟"（Researcher Latency）这一结构性概念，描述独立实践研究者（非学术机构雇佣的研究者）在做出原创研究贡献后，却无法获得研究创新系统正式认可的差距。论文提出"可携带研究身份标准"作为制度基础设施的应对方案。
AI.research_question: 独立实践研究者的研究成果与其被研究创新系统正式认可之间存在怎样的结构性差距？如何通过制度基础设施设计弥补这一差距？
AI.motivation: 英国现有的研究创新生态系统基于传统劳动市场设计，无法适应分布式知识经济中日益增长的独立实践研究者群体。这一制度鸿沟导致效率损失和创新潜力未能充分释放。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创新经济学、知识生产社会学、专业标准的治理文献。
AI.method: 概念构建与制度设计分析。通过整合多学科理论，提出"研究者延迟"的结构性概念，并据此设计制度基础设施方案。
AI.findings: 研究者延迟包含四个可测量的维度：资格排斥（credential exclusion）、资源不可及性（resource inaccessibility）、认可不对称（recognition asymmetry）、可携带性赤字（portability deficit）。论文提出了"独立实践研究者"的正式类别，以及"可携带研究身份标准"的制度构架。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出了"研究者延迟"（Researcher Latency）这一正式的结构性概念，将独立研究者认可问题从个体福利/认可议题重新定义为效率与创新基础设施问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了"可携带研究身份标准"（Portable Research Identity Standard）的制度基础设施方案，为政策制定者提供了解决研究者延迟问题的具体工具，有望提高国家层面的研究投资回报率。

title: The System Didn't Break -It Stopped Evolving
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The System Didn't Break -It Stopped Evolving

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no financial or personal conflict of interest. This research was conducted independently based on over 20 years of professional experience as a Chief Information Officer and former Director of Technical Services and Computer Laboratories at Forman Christian College University (FCCU), Lahore, Pakistan.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article is a policy research paper based on publicly observable institutional patterns. No human participants, patient data, or primary empirical research was involved. Ethics approval is not applicable.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Across much of the developing and developed world, Generation Z-the most formally educated cohort in recorded history-is entering labour markets and institutional environments that no longer reflect merit, adaptability, or technological competence. This article argues that the crisis confronting young professionals is not primarily economic: it is institutional. Drawing on patterns observable across Pakistan, India, Nigeria, Egypt, South Africa, and Lebanon, this paper analyses structural bottlenecks in corporate leadership, the misuse of Artificial Intelligence to mask incompetence, and the inadequacy of existing Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) frameworks. It proposes a new governance architecture including national Institutional Modernisation Authorities, Corporate Meritocracy Commissions, AI Governance Agencies, and mandatory annual policy renewal frameworks. The central thesis is that institutions which fail to evolve-in their leadership structures, hiring practices, and AI governance-will progressively lose their most capable young talent to disengagement, emigration, or entrepreneurial exit, with significant consequences for national competitiveness and social cohesion.

AI.tldr: 本文论证Z世代青年面临的危机本质是制度性危机，而非经济性危机。在巴基斯坦、印度、尼日利亚、埃及、南非和黎巴嫩等国家，企业领导结构僵化、AI被滥用以掩盖无能、CSR框架失效等问题导致高学历青年人才通过离职、移民或创业等方式"退出"制度。作者提出建立国家制度现代化管理局、企业精英治理委员会、AI治理机构等新治理架构来应对这一挑战。
AI.research_question: Z世代青年人才面临的危机本质是什么？现有制度（领导结构、招聘实践、AI治理）如何导致青年人才流失？
AI.motivation: Z世代是历史上受教育程度最高的一代，但他们在劳动市场和制度环境中遭遇的困境并非经济衰退所致，而是制度本身未能与时俱进，亟需解析这一结构性危机并提出系统性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度失灵理论；人才退出机制（disengagement, emigration, entrepreneurial exit）；精英治理与代际公平；AI治理理论
AI.method: 跨国比较分析（巴基斯坦、印度、尼日利亚、埃及、南非、黎巴嫩）；模式归纳与制度设计提案
AI.findings: 1）企业领导结构存在系统性瓶颈；2）AI被滥用以掩盖管理无能；3）现有CSR框架不足以解决制度问题；4）制度不进化将导致青年人才通过脱离、移民或创业三种方式"退出"
AI.theory_contributions: 将青年人才危机重新定义为制度性危机而非经济性危机，拓展了制度失灵理论在人才管理领域的应用；提出"制度退出"（institutional exit）概念框架
AI.practical_contributions: 提出具体的治理架构建议：国家制度现代化管理局、企业精英治理委员会、AI治理机构、年度政策更新框架，为发展中国家应对青年人才流失提供政策工具

title: Cross-Jurisdictional Compliance for Agentic AI Systems

detail.title: Cross-Jurisdictional Compliance for Agentic AI Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is a Principal Consultant in Cybersecurity GRC, Data Privacy and AI Governance at DTS Solution (Beyon Cyber), an organisation that provides cybersecurity advisory services in the Gulf Cooperation Council region. The author has no financial or other personal interest in any product, vendor, AI system, or regulatory framework discussed in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable; the study involved no human participants.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The work was conducted as part of the author's doctoral research at Walsh College.

detail.abstract:
Purpose. This paper analyses how four anchor jurisdictions, namely the European Union, the United States, the United Kingdom, and the Gulf Cooperation Council, with particular attention to the United Arab Emirates, allocate compliance responsibility across the layered agentic AI stack, and where their allocations conflict, overlap, or leave gaps for an organisation operating across all four. It advances the argument that the central compliance problem is not the stringency of any single regime but the misalignment between regulatory responsibility axes and the technical architecture of agentic systems, a misalignment that compounds under cross-jurisdictional operation.

Approach. The paper adopts a comparative legal and standards-review methodology, synthesising primary regulatory instruments, national-authority guidance, and the contemporary 2024 to 2026 practitioner and scholarly literature across the four jurisdictions. It maps each regime's allocation of obligations onto a three-layer model of the agentic stack derived from the AI Supply Chain Trust Boundary Model developed earlier in this series, and it analyses the provider-versus-deployer boundary as the principal fault line along which cross-jurisdictional divergence manifests.

Findings. Three findings emerge. First, every regime examined organises obligations around a developer-or-provider versus deployer-or-user distinction, but each draws the boundary differently and none maps it cleanly onto the three-layer agentic stack, so the same orchestration platform may be a deployer in one jurisdiction and a provider in another. Second, the reclassification trigger, whereby substantial modification or fine-tuning of a foundation model converts a deployer into a provider with heavier obligations, is the single most consequential and least harmonised mechanism, and it bears directly on orchestration platforms that adapt upstream models. Third, the GCC layered model, far from being a regulatory gap, functions as a distinct compliance architecture in which free-zone regimes such as the Dubai International Financial Centre impose binding obligations on autonomous systems while federal instruments set a baseline, creating an intra-jurisdictional layering that mirrors the cross-jurisdictional problem in miniature.

Implications. For practitioners operating multi-jurisdictional AI estates, compliance cannot be achieved by satisfying the single most stringent regime, because the regimes diverge on who bears which obligation rather than merely on how much. The paper proposes that organisations adopt an architecture-first compliance posture, mapping obligations onto the technical layer at which control actually resides and treat the provider-versus-deployer boundary as a governed decision rather than an incidental consequence of engineering choices. The analysis connects to the orchestration liability framework, which is the subject of the author's broader doctoral work, and a future extension will empirically validate these findings through a vignette-based practitioner survey, conducted with institutional ethics approval.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟、美国、英国及海湾合作委员会（特别是阿联酋）四个管辖区如何在分层自主智能体AI堆栈中分配合规责任，指出核心合规问题不在于单一制度的严格程度，而在于监管责任轴线与自主系统技术架构之间的错位，且这种错位在跨辖区运营中会被放大。
AI.research_question: 四个主要管辖区（欧盟、美国、英国、海湾合作委员会/阿联酋）如何在分层自主智能体AI堆栈中分配合规责任？这些分配在跨辖区运营的组织中何处存在冲突、重叠或空白？
AI.motivation: 当前不同司法管辖区对AI监管的合规责任分配存在显著差异，且这些差异并非简单地表现为"严格程度不同"，而是"责任归属谁"的根本性分歧。这种错位在跨辖区运营的自主智能体系统中尤为突出，现有研究对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: AI供应链信任边界模型（三层自主智能体堆栈模型）；提供者-部署者边界分析框架；跨辖区监管对齐理论。
AI.method: 比较法律与标准审查方法论，综合四个管辖区的初级监管工具、国家权威机构指南及2024-2026年实践与学术文献。
AI.findings: （1）各管辖区均围绕"开发者/提供者"与"部署者/用户"的区分组织义务，但边界划定各不相同，且无一能与三层自主智能体堆栈清晰对应；（2）"重新分类触发机制"（重大修改或微调将部署者转为承担更重义务的提供者）是影响最大且最不协调的机制；（3）海湾合作委员会的分层模式并非监管空白，而是一种独特的合规架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了监管责任轴线与自主系统技术架构之间的系统性错位，指出跨辖区合规的核心矛盾不是标准高低差异，而是"责任归属"的结构性分歧。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出"架构优先"合规策略：将义务映射到实际控制所在的技术层，将提供者-部署者边界视为被治理的决策而非工程选择的偶然结果；为跨辖区运营的AI组织提供了具体合规路径指引。

title: Proposing the Observability-Native Development Model: Redefining System Quality and the Final Equilibrium State in Socio-Technical Systems

detail.title: Proposing the Observability-Native Development Model: Redefining System Quality and the Final Equilibrium State in Socio-Technical Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is employed as a Lead Technical Support Engineer at New Relic, a provider of observability platforms. However, this paper was written as part of the author's personal and independent academic research activities and does not represent the official views, strategies, or endorsement of any specific products (SaaS) of New Relic. The theoretical considerations and model building regarding Observability and Application Performance Monitoring (APM) in this study were conducted from a vendor-neutral perspective. The author declares that there is no specific commercial Conflict of Interest (COI) related to this research.

detail.abstract: In modern cloud-native environments, the entropy of information systems is increasing exponentially, pushing the quality management models based on the "closed-system, static infallibility" premise of traditional software management engineering to their limits. This paper criticizes the quality paradigm encompassing the traditional "bug convergence curve" and "acceptance testing as a discrete event" from thermodynamic and control engineering perspectives. In its place, it proposes "Observability-Native Development (OND)" as a new post-agile software engineering paradigm. OND initially instruments an "autonomic nervous system" centered on Application Performance Monitoring (APM) within the system. By using the error budget consumption rate (Burn Rate) as the sole evaluation function, it redefines the release criteria as the continuous proof of "dynamic homeostasis" in the production environment. Furthermore, this paper demonstrates, using queueing theory, that the demands of this technological infrastructure (OND) cause the transaction costs in lump-sum contracts to diverge to infinity. It thus argues for the incentive structure that irreversibly promotes an organizational and contractual phase transition toward a symbiotic Managed Service Provider (MSP) 3.0 that provides continuous engineering.

AI.tldr: 本文批评了传统软件工程的“封闭系统、静态无误”质量范式，提出“可观测性原生开发（OND）”作为后敏捷新范式。OND通过APM构建系统“自主神经系统”，以错误预算燃烧率作为唯一评估函数，将发布标准重新定义为生产环境中“动态稳态”的持续证明。同时，利用排队论证明该技术基础设施导致总包合同交易成本发散至无穷，从而论证组织与合同应不可逆地向提供持续工程服务的共生型MSP 3.0转变。
AI.research_question: 在云原生环境下，传统软件质量管理和合同模式为何失效，以及如何构建新的技术范式与组织契约结构以适应系统的动态复杂性？
AI.motivation: 云原生环境下信息熵指数级增长，基于“封闭系统、静态无误”的传统软件质量范式（如bug收敛曲线、离散验收测试）已到极限，亟需新的质量管理和组织模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 热力学与控制系统工程（批评传统范式）、可观测性理论、排队论（证明交易成本发散）、契约理论（论证激励结构与组织相变）。
AI.method: 理论批判与演绎推理；运用排队论进行数学建模；跨学科理论整合（热力学、控制工程、契约经济学）。
AI.findings: OND以APM为“自主神经系统”，以错误预算燃烧率为唯一评估函数，将“无bug”静态目标替换为生产环境“动态稳态”持续证明；排队论证明该技术基础设施使总包合同交易成本发散，不可持续；因此需要向共生型MSP 3.0（持续工程服务）的组织与契约模式转变。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从热力学与控制系统视角批判传统软件质量范式；提出“可观测性原生开发（OND）”作为后敏捷软件工程新范式；将排队论与契约理论引入软件工程质量管理分析，论证技术基础设施对组织契约结构的决定性影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 为云原生环境下的工程团队提供了从“封闭式质量控制”向“开放式动态稳态管理”转型的技术路径（OND）；为企业与客户间的合同模式从总包合同转向MSP 3.0持续工程服务提供了理论基础和操作方向。

title: When Artificial Intelligence (AI) Writes Fact-Checks: Human Responses to AI-Generated Fact-Checks
affiliations: and Georgia State University - Department of Computer Information Systems

detail.title: When Artificial Intelligence (AI) Writes Fact-Checks: Human Responses to AI-Generated Fact-Checks
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) increasingly participates in fact-checking, but little is known about how crowds evaluate AI-generated fact-checks. Using note-level data from Twitter’s Community Notes program, we compare AI-generated and human-written notes across helpfulness, ideological extremity, rating engagement, time-to-consensus, and rating-reason content. AI-generated notes receive higher helpfulness scores, are less ideologically extreme, and are more frequently perceived as clear, well-sourced, claim-relevant, important, and unbiased. However, they attract fewer ratings and take longer to reach consensus. Conditional analyses further reveal that when AI-generated notes are rejected, they are more likely to be criticized as incorrect or irrelevant. These findings reveal a quality–engagement divergence in consensus-gated, AI-generated fact-checking and clarify both the promise and the boundary conditions of AI participation in crowdsourced misinformation correction.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Twitter社区笔记数据，比较AI生成与人类撰写的事实核查笔记。发现AI笔记帮助性评分更高、意识形态极端性更低、更常被视为清晰/有来源/相关/重要/无偏，但收到的评分更少且达成共识时间更长。被拒绝时更可能被批评为不正确或不相关。揭示了AI事实核查中"质量-参与度"的分歧。
AI.research_question: 大众如何评价AI生成的事实核查内容？AI生成与人类撰写的事实核查笔记在帮助性、意识形态极端性、评分参与度、达成共识时间和评分理由内容上有何差异？
AI.motivation: AI越来越多地参与事实核查，但公众如何评估AI生成的事实核查尚不明确，这对人机协作的 misinformation 纠正机制有重要影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人机协作理论、事实核查与共识形成机制、AI辅助决策的信任与采纳理论
AI.method: 利用Twitter社区笔记项目的笔记层面数据，对AI生成和人类撰写的笔记进行多维度比较分析，包括帮助性评分、意识形态极端性、评分参与度、共识达成时间及评分理由内容分析。
AI.findings: AI笔记帮助性评分更高、意识形态极端性更低、更常被感知为清晰/有来源/相关/重要/无偏；但收到的评分更少、达成共识时间更长；被拒绝时更可能被批评为不正确或不相关。揭示了AI事实核查中存在"质量-参与度"的分歧现象。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了共识门槛机制下AI生成事实核查的"质量-参与度"分歧，丰富了人机协作事实核查与AI信任采纳的理论理解，明确了AI参与众包错误信息纠正的边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为平台设计AI辅助事实核查系统提供实证依据，提示需关注AI内容虽质量高但参与度低的问题，以及如何优化共识达成机制以更好地整合AI与人类判断。

title: The Right to Exit: Against Ontological Compression

detail.title: The Right to Exit: Against Ontological Compression
detail.abstract:
This paper develops a theoretical critique of contemporary algorithmic governance by situating it within a broader historical trajectory of what may be described as discrete regimes of classification. From theological taxonomies of the soul to the quantification of labor in capitalist systems and, more recently, to affective computing, these regimes rely on the transformation of continuous human experience into finite, computable categories.

We argue that this process constitutes a form of ontological compression: the reduction of heterogeneous, dynamic, and context-dependent phenomena into stable and enumerable representations. Such systems are sustained by assumptions of optimization and predictability, often modeled through equilibrium-based frameworks that presuppose consistent and legible behavior.

Drawing on concepts from topology and measure theory in a heuristic sense, the paper proposes that affective experience resists full capture within discrete representational structures. Rather than being exhaustively decomposable, it exhibits properties of continuity, variability, and non-exhaustibility, which introduce persistent limits to classification and prediction.

On this basis, we introduce the notion of a Complementary Resonance Protocol as a conceptual framework for engaging with these limits. This framework emphasizes modes of expression and coordination—such as ambiguity, indeterminacy, and non-stabilized decision-making—that operate at the boundary of algorithmic legibility. Rather than offering a total escape, it foregrounds the ways in which behavior can remain only partially incorporated into predictive systems.

The paper concludes by considering the ethical implications of these findings, contrasting metric forms of well-being grounded in optimization with alternative orientations centered on existential intensity and the preservation of ambiguity. In doing so, it reframes the problem of algorithmic governance not as one of total control or total resistance, but as an ongoing negotiation shaped by structural limits.

AI.tldr: 本文从分类体制的历史演变出发，批判性地审视当代算法治理。作者提出算法治理是一种"本体论压缩"——将连续、异质的人类经验简化为可计算的离散类别。文章借鉴拓扑学和测度论概念，论证情感体验无法被完全离散化表征，并引入"互补共振协议"作为与算法治理边界共处的概念框架，最终将算法治理问题重新定义为一种受结构性限制的持续协商过程。
AI.research_question: 当代算法治理如何通过离散分类体制压缩人类经验？情感体验在何种程度上能够（或不能）被算法完全表征和预测？
AI.motivation: 现有对算法治理的批判多聚焦于权力或控制视角，缺乏对算法分类本身的认识论和本体论局限性的深入分析。作者试图从更长的历史谱系（从神学分类到资本主义劳动量化再到情感计算）揭示算法治理的深层结构性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）离散分类体制的历史谱系理论；2）本体论压缩概念（借鉴拓扑学与测度论）；3）连续性与非穷竭性理论；4）互补共振协议框架。
AI.method: 理论批判与概念分析，结合数学概念（拓扑学、测度论）的启发式运用进行哲学论证。
AI.findings: 1）算法治理构成对连续经验的本体论压缩；2）情感体验具有连续性、变异性和非穷竭性，无法被完全离散化；3）提出"互补共振协议"作为与算法边界共处的框架；4）算法治理不是完全控制或完全抵抗，而是结构性限制下的持续协商。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）将算法治理批判置于更长的分类体制历史谱系中；2）引入"本体论压缩"概念分析离散化过程的本质局限；3）提出"互补共振协议"作为替代性概念框架；4）重新定义算法治理问题为结构性限制下的协商而非二元对抗。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）揭示算法预测和分类的固有局限，提醒政策制定者和技术开发者警惕过度依赖优化框架；2）为在算法系统中保留模糊性、不确定性提供理论依据；3）将伦理关切从"优化型福祉"转向"存在强度与模糊性保护"。

title: UCP 600 Thirteen Years On: Is the Compliance Standard Working?

detail.title: UCP 600 Thirteen Years On: Is the Compliance Standard Working?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Business Law Review, volume 41, issue Issue 3, 2020[10.54648/bula2020100]

detail.abstract: On 1 July 2007, changes to the Uniform Customs and Practice for Documentary Credits (UCP) 600 came into effect which emphasized that documents need not be absolutely consistent or mirror images of each other (the 'strict approach'), merely that they must not be inconsistent (the 'substantial approach'). In this article, the author considers how both the strict and substantial approaches have worked in practice and suggests a new basis for the proper compliance standard.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了UCP 600关于单据审核标准的变更，分析了"严格相符"与"实质相符"两种标准在实际中的应用，并提出了新的合规标准基础。
AI.research_question: 信用证单据审核中应采用何种相符标准？"严格相符"与"实质相符"标准在实践中如何运作？
AI.motivation: UCP 600于2007年生效，改变了单据审核标准，强调单据不必绝对一致（严格相符），只需不相矛盾（实质相符）。这一变更需要被审视和评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信用证单据审核标准理论（严格相符原则 vs 实质相符原则）、UCP 600法律框架
AI.method: 规范性法律分析（ doctrinal legal analysis），结合实践案例的定性分析
AI.findings: 严格相符与实质相符两种标准在实践中均有其适用性和局限性；作者提出了新的合规标准基础。
AI.theory_contributions: 为信用证单据审核标准提供了新的理论基础，重新审视了"严格相符"与"实质相符"的二分法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行、进出口商和信用证从业者提供了关于UCP 600下单据审核标准的实践指导，有助于减少因单据不符点引发的争议。

title: Identifying Causal Effects and Analyzing Heterogeneity of User Growth Interventions on Digital Platforms: Evidence from Large-Scale Behavioral Data
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: Identifying Causal Effects and Analyzing Heterogeneity of User Growth Interventions on Digital Platforms: Evidence from Large-Scale Behavioral Data
detail.abstract: To address the challenge of accurately identifying the effectiveness of user growth strategies on digital platforms, this paper proposes a dual machine learning causal inference framework that integrates Orthogonal Representation Learning (ORL).Based on 18 consecutive months of operational data from a leading internet platform-comprising approximately 1.46 million users and 280 million behavioral logs (clicks, page views, conversions, and retention)-the study constructs a high-dimensional feature system (approximately 320 variables) that includes user attributes, exposure paths, content features, and time-series behavior.Methodologically, we first employ deep representation networks to perform dimensionality reduction and decorrelation on high-dimensional covariates, thereby mitigating estimation biases in traditional DML under highly correlated features. Subsequently, we construct causal estimation equations using orthogonalized residuals to achieve robust identification of the Average Treatment Effect (ATE) and the Conditional Treatment Effect (CATE).To enhance the reliability of causal identification, we introduce time-segmented instrumental variables (Temporal IV) and regression discontinuity designs (RDD) for cross-validation.Experimental results indicate that, compared to traditional regression and standard DML models, the proposed method reduces estimation bias in policy effects by 28.6% and identifies significant positive heterogeneity effects within the high-activity user subgroup. Further analysis reveals that different exposure frequencies and content combinations exert nonlinear causal influences on user conversion paths, providing quantifiable evidence for platform resource allocation and strategy optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种融合正交表示学习（ORL）的双机器学习因果推断框架，基于某头部互联网平台18个月约146万用户和2.8亿行为日志数据，通过深度表示网络降维去相关、正交化残差构建估计方程，并结合时序工具变量和断点回归进行交叉验证，相比传统方法将策略效应估计偏差降低28.6%，并发现了高活跃用户子群的显著正向异质性效应。
AI.research_question: 如何准确识别数字平台用户增长策略的有效性？具体而言，如何在高度相关的高维特征条件下，稳健地估计用户增长策略的平均处理效应（ATE）和条件处理效应（CATE）？
AI.motivation: 数字平台用户增长策略的效果识别面临两大挑战：一是观测数据中存在大量高维、高度相关的混杂变量，传统方法难以有效去偏；二是策略效应在不同用户群体间可能存在异质性，需要更精细的因果推断方法。现有DML方法在处理高度相关特征时存在估计偏差，亟需提出更稳健的框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双机器学习（DML）、正交表示学习（ORL）、深度表示网络、时序工具变量（Temporal IV）、断点回归设计（RDD）、平均处理效应（ATE）、条件处理效应（CATE）
AI.method: 1) 基于深度表示网络对高维协变量进行降维与去相关处理；2) 利用正交化残差构建因果估计方程，实现ATE和CATE的稳健识别；3) 引入时间分段工具变量（Temporal IV）和断点回归设计（RDD）进行因果识别的交叉验证；4) 数据来源：某头部互联网平台18个月运营数据，约146万用户、2.8亿行为日志、320维特征变量。
AI.findings: 1) 相比传统回归和标准DML模型，本文方法将策略效应估计偏差降低28.6%；2) 高活跃用户子群存在显著的正向异质性效应；3) 不同曝光频率和内容组合对用户转化路径产生非线性因果影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 提出ORL-DML融合框架，解决了传统DML在高相关特征下的估计偏差问题；2) 引入Temporal IV和RDD进行交叉验证，增强了因果识别的可靠性；3) 揭示了用户增长策略效应的非线性与异质性机制，丰富了数字平台因果推断的理论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为数字平台提供可量化的策略效果评估工具，支持平台根据用户活跃度等特征优化资源分配和策略组合，提升用户增长策略的投入产出效率。

title: Agent-Induced Cascades: The Seventh Indicator in Escalation Threshold Theory

detail.title: Agent-Induced Cascades: The Seventh Indicator in Escalation Threshold Theory
detail.abstract: Author Note. This paper extends the Sociotechnical Escalation Threshold (SET) model introduced in Prasad MK (2026), 'Escalation Threshold Theory in Sociotechnical Systems,' SSRN Working Paper. It was developed independently, outside of any employment obligations, using no proprietary or confidential resources. The views expressed are solely those of the author.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了Prasad MK (2026)提出的社会技术升级阈值（SET）模型，独立开发，未使用任何专有或机密资源，观点仅代表作者个人。
AI.research_question: 如何扩展社会技术升级阈值（SET）模型以更好地理解社会技术系统中的升级行为？
AI.motivation: 在Prasad MK (2026)的SET模型基础上，进一步深化对社会技术系统中升级阈值机制的理解，为相关研究提供新的理论视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会技术升级阈值（SET）模型，社会技术系统理论
AI.method: 理论扩展与概念建模，独立学术研究
AI.findings: 本文扩展了SET模型，提出了更全面的社会技术系统升级阈值分析框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 对社会技术升级阈值理论进行了扩展和深化，为后续研究提供了新的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解和管理社会技术系统中的升级行为提供了理论指导，但具体实践应用需进一步探索。

title: The Invisible Variable: Gender and Buyer-side Trust Formation in Indian B2B Sales
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Invisible Variable: Gender and Buyer-side Trust Formation in Indian B2B Sales
detail.abstract: Despite growing awareness of gender diversity in corporate India, gender remains an underexamined variable in business-to-business sales environments. Existing research has focused predominantly on seller-side experiences, leaving the formation of buyer-side trust largely unexplored. This paper argues that gender functions as an invisible variable on the buyer-side of trust formation in Indian B2B sales, operating not through overt discrimination but through hesitation, silence, and exclusion from informal relationship-building spaces. Drawing on autoethnographic observations spanning two years of field sales experience across three industries, this paper examines three anchoring moments: a handshake exclusion, informal network exclusion, and opportunity reassignment. These moments demonstrate how gender influences buyer behaviour before competence can even be assessed. The findings suggest that trust disruption for female salespersons begins at the earliest stage of interaction, with structural implications for how companies approach gender inclusion in sales roles.

AI.tldr: 本文通过自我民族志方法，揭示印度B2B销售中性别作为买方信任形成的隐形变量，女性销售人员在最早期互动阶段即遭遇信任中断，表现为握手排斥、非正式网络排斥和机会重新分配三种锚定时刻。
AI.research_question: 在印度B2B销售环境中，性别如何作为隐形变量影响买方信任的形成？
AI.motivation: 尽管印度企业界对性别多样性的意识日益增强，但性别在B2B销售中仍是未被充分检验的变量，且现有研究集中于卖方体验，买方信任的形成过程几乎未被探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别作为隐形变量的理论视角，关注非公开歧视（犹豫、沉默、排斥）而非显性歧视。
AI.method: 自我民族志（Autoethnography），基于跨三个行业、为期两年的实地销售经验，分析三个锚定时刻。
AI.findings: 女性销售人员在能力尚未被评估之前，即在最早期的互动阶段遭遇信任中断；信任中断表现为握手排斥、非正式网络排斥和机会重新分配三种形式。
AI.theory_contributions: 将性别研究拓展至B2B买方信任形成的前端阶段，提出"信任中断始于能力评估之前"的理论观点，揭示性别作为隐形变量的运作机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业如何促进销售岗位的性别包容提供结构性建议，提示需关注非正式关系建设空间中的性别排斥问题。

title: Advertising Scale Expansion and Diminishing Return Efficiency in Meta Advertising Systems An Empirical Analysis of Auction Pressure, Conversion Efficiency, and Return Dynamics

detail.title: Advertising Scale Expansion and Diminishing Return Efficiency in Meta Advertising Systems An Empirical Analysis of Auction Pressure, Conversion Efficiency, and Return Dynamics
detail.abstract: This study investigates the relationship between advertising scale expansion and performance efficiency within Meta advertising systems. Using 100 weekly observations from large-scale U.S. ecommerce advertising campaigns, the research evaluates how increasing advertising spend influences customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rate (CVR), and cost per mille (CPM). The analysis applies correlation and linear regression models to evaluate the directional and statistical relationships between advertising spend and performance variables. Findings indicate that increasing spend is significantly associated with rising CPM and CAC, alongside declining ROAS. Interestingly, conversion rate improves under higher spend levels, suggesting that Meta's algorithmic optimization systems partially offset scaling inefficiencies through improved targeting performance. The results suggest that while algorithmic optimization enhances conversion quality during scaling, auction cost inflation ultimately dominates efficiency gains, resulting in diminishing overall advertising returns at higher spend intensities. This research contributes to emerging literature on algorithmic advertising systems, digital auction economics, and performance marketing efficiency.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用Meta广告系统中大型美国电商广告活动的100周数据，发现广告支出增加虽然能提升转化率，但会导致CPM和CAC上升、ROAS下降，算法优化无法完全抵消竞价成本通胀带来的效率损失。
AI.research_question: Meta广告系统中，广告规模扩张与绩效效率之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 随着数字广告支出持续增长，广告主面临规模化投放时效率递减的痛点。现有研究对平台算法优化能否抵消竞价成本通胀尚缺乏实证证据，本研究旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数字拍卖经济学、算法广告系统理论、绩效营销效率理论
AI.method: 基于100周时间序列数据，运用相关性分析和线性回归模型，检验广告支出与CAC、ROAS、CVR、CPM等绩效指标之间的方向和统计关系。
AI.findings: 增加支出显著推高CPM和CAC，降低ROAS；但转化率随支出增加而提升，表明Meta算法优化能部分改善定向精准度；然而竞价成本通胀最终主导效率变化，导致整体广告回报递减。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 揭示了算法广告系统中"转化率提升"与"成本通胀"之间的权衡机制；2. 为数字拍卖经济学中竞价成本动态提供了实证支持；3. 拓展了绩效营销效率在平台算法优化情境下的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为广告主在Meta平台上制定预算策略提供实证依据，提示规模化投放需警惕回报递减；2. 帮助广告主理解算法优化的"双刃剑"效应——提升转化但推高成本；3. 指导广告主在追求规模与维持效率之间做出更理性的权衡决策。

title:
The Cognitive Void
When AI-dependent Militaries Lose the Systems they Cannot Fight without

detail.title:
The Cognitive Void
When AI-dependent Militaries Lose the Systems they Cannot Fight without
detail.abstract: Advanced militaries are integrating artificial intelligence into every layer of the operational stack including navigation, targeting, command decision-support and swarm coordination. Adversaries are developing the tools to destroy those layers at the same pace i.e electromagnetic pulse weapons, adversarial camouflage patches, training-data poisoning and GPS jamming architectures that the Ukraine, Gaza and Iran conflicts have demonstrated in live operational conditions. This paper argues that the central vulnerability thus created has not been theorised: the cognitive void. As AI systems absorb the navigational, perceptual and decision functions that soldiers once performed directly, the human neural infrastructure for performing those functions unaided is atrophying through disuse. When AI systems are neutralised by an EMP, jamming, spoofing, or adversarial attack, the force that remains is cognitively diminished relative to a pre-AI baseline. The paper further argues that this vulnerability is compounded by a second, structurally distinct threat: Splinternet epistemological divergence, whereby opposing sides in a future conflict may be operating AI decision-support systems trained on incompatible factual architectures, generating recommendations rooted in structurally different understandings of the battlefield, the enemy, and the history of the conflict. Together, these two dynamics constitute what this paper terms the dual void: a military operating without its AI systems, advised by AI systems that encode a fundamentally different version of reality than its adversary. Existing international humanitarian law, military doctrine, and AI governance frameworks address neither. The paper concludes by proposing a governance architecture for the dual void.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"认知虚空"与"分裂网认知分歧"两大威胁构成"双重虚空"：AI系统嵌入军事决策导致人类认知能力萎缩（被瘫痪后战斗力低于AI前基线）；敌对双方AI基于不同事实架构训练，生成根本性不同的战场认知。现有法律、军事学说与AI治理框架均未覆盖此问题，文章最后提出治理架构。
AI.research_question: 当军事AI系统被瘫痪或敌对双方AI基于不同事实架构运行，军队面临的认知安全漏洞是什么？现有国际法、军事学说与AI治理框架如何应对此漏洞？
AI.motivation: 当前AI已深度嵌入军事导航、目标锁定、指挥决策和蜂群协调各层面，而对手同时发展EMP、对抗补丁、数据中毒和GPS干扰等反制手段。乌克兰、加沙和伊朗冲突已证明这些手段的有效性，但学界尚未理论化由此产生的核心安全漏洞。
AI.theoretical_framework: 认知虚空（Cognitive Void）、分裂网认知分歧（Splinternet Epistemological Divergence）、双重虚空（Dual Void）
AI.method: 概念性理论建构，基于乌克兰、加沙、伊朗冲突的实地案例观察，结合认知科学与信息战理论进行推演分析。
AI.findings: （1）AI系统接管导航、感知和决策功能后，人类直接执行这些功能所需的神经基础设施因废用而萎缩；（2）AI被EMP、干扰、欺骗或对抗攻击瘫痪后，残留部队的认知能力低于AI前基线水平；（3）敌对双方AI基于不同事实架构训练，生成结构上根本不同的战场、敌人和冲突历史认知；（4）现有国际人道法、军事学说和AI治理框架均未覆盖上述双重漏洞。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次理论化"认知虚空"和"双重虚空"概念，填补了军事AI安全、认知科学和信息战交叉领域的理论空白，挑战了"人机协作增强能力"的单向叙事。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出针对"双重虚空"的治理架构方案，为军事AI系统部署、备用方案设计、国际人道法修订和AI监管政策制定提供实践指导。

title: Tourism Demand in a Small Island Economy: Evidence from Seychelles
affiliations: , Ministry of Finance, Economic Planning, Trade and Investment and Ministry of Finance, Economic Planning, Trade and Investment

detail.title: Tourism Demand in a Small Island Economy: Evidence from Seychelles
detail.abstract: Using data from 168 source countries spanning 2000 to 2024, we examine the determinants of inbound tourist arrivals in Seychelles. We find that past travel experience, origin country income, destination visibility, and air connectivity are the primary drivers of tourist arrivals. The income effect is asymmetric: arrivals respond to income gains but are resilient to declines. This pattern is consistent with a compositional mechanism, whereby rising incomes draw newly affluent travellers into the market while moderate declines leave Seychelles' wealthy core clientele largely unaffected. Disaggregating by region of origin reveals substantial heterogeneity: income accounts for 57.8 and 80.4 per cent of explained variation in arrivals from Europe and Africa respectively, while past travel experience accounts for 84.4 per cent of explained variation in Asian arrivals, pointing to a mature and loyal source market. These findings highlight the importance of visitor experience quality, targeted digital marketing, and air access development as policy levers for small island tourism destinations.

AI.tldr: 基于168个来源国2000-2024年的数据，研究塞舌尔入境旅游的决定因素，发现旅行经验、来源国收入、目的地可见度和航空连通性是主要驱动因素，且收入效应具有不对称性。
AI.research_question: 塞舌尔入境旅游的驱动因素是什么？不同来源地区的驱动因素是否存在异质性？
AI.motivation: 小型岛屿旅游目的地对旅游业高度依赖，但对其入境旅游决定因素的系统性研究不足，尤其是收入效应的不对称性和区域异质性尚未被充分探讨。
AI.theoretical_framework: 旅游需求理论、收入不对称效应（构成机制）、目的地选择理论
AI.method: 基于168个来源国2000-2024年的面板数据，采用计量回归方法分析入境旅游的决定因素，并进行区域异质性分解。
AI.findings: 1）旅行经验、来源国收入、目的地可见度和航空连通性是主要驱动因素；2）收入效应不对称：收入增长带动入境增长，但收入下降时影响有限；3）区域异质性显著：收入分别解释欧洲和非洲入境游客变异的57.8%和80.4%，而旅行经验解释亚洲入境游客变异的84.4%。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了旅游需求中收入效应的不对称性及其构成机制，丰富了旅游经济学中关于收入弹性非线性的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为塞舌尔等小型岛屿旅游目的地提供了政策启示：提升游客体验质量、开展针对性数字营销、发展航空连通性。

title: Balancing Faith and Fitness: Managing Muslim Footballers During Ramadan

detail.title: Balancing Faith and Fitness: Managing Muslim Footballers During Ramadan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Nothing to declare
declarations.ethicsApproval: No patients or participants were recruited
declarations.funderStatement: This is self-funded research

detail.abstract: The demands of modern football require athletes to consistently operate at high levels of physical intensity, cognitive concentration and emotional regulation. For Muslim footballers, the observance of Ramadan introduces additional physiological, psychological and logistical considerations that require careful management within high-performance sporting environments. This article examines the impact of Ramadan fasting on football performance through the lenses of sports science, recovery management, nutrition, psychology and leadership. It argues that successful Ramadan management is not solely the responsibility of the athlete but rather a shared organisational responsibility involving coaches, medical teams, nutritionists, strength and conditioning staff, and administrators. By adopting culturally-intelligent and athlete-centred approaches, football organisations can support both player wellbeing and competitive performance during Ramadan.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨斋月禁食对穆斯林足球运动员在生理、心理和后勤方面的影响，并提出成功的斋月管理应是俱乐部组织层面的共同责任，而非仅由运动员个人承担。
AI.research_question: 斋月禁食如何影响足球运动员的竞技表现？俱乐部组织应如何通过文化智慧和以运动员为中心的方式支持穆斯林球员在斋月期间的表现与福祉？
AI.motivation: 现代足球对运动员的身体强度、认知专注和情绪调节要求极高，而穆斯林球员在斋月期间的禁食增加了额外的生理、心理和后勤挑战，目前对此缺乏系统性的组织管理框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 体育科学、恢复管理、营养学、运动心理学、领导力理论，以及文化智慧（Cultural Intelligence）和以运动员为中心（Athlete-Centred）的管理理念。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，整合多学科视角（运动科学、营养学、心理学、领导力等）进行综合论述。
AI.findings: 斋月禁食对足球运动员的体能、认知和情绪均有显著影响；有效的斋月管理需要教练、医疗团队、营养师、体能教练和管理人员等组织各方的协同努力；采用文化智慧和以运动员为中心的方式有助于兼顾球员福祉与竞技表现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将斋月管理从个人责任视角拓展为组织共同责任框架，填补了体育管理学中关于宗教文化与高绩效运动管理交叉领域的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为足球俱乐部及其他运动组织提供了管理穆斯林运动员斋月期间训练、营养、恢复和心理支持的系统性实践指南，推动体育组织的文化包容性建设。

title: Fiscal Decentralization: A Review of Theories, Evidence, And Policy Implications

detail.title: Fiscal Decentralization: A Review of Theories, Evidence, And Policy Implications
detail.abstract: This study systematically reviewed theories, empirical evidence, and policy implications of fiscal decentralization through a comprehensive analysis of literature and case studies. Fiscal decentralization, which transfers fiscal responsibilities from central to subnational governments, aimed to enhance governance efficiency, improve public service delivery, and foster economic growth. The review drew on foundational theories by Oates (1972) and Tiebout (1956), which emphasized allocative efficiency and competitive federalism, as well as second-generation theories that highlighted institutional incentives and market-preserving federalism. Empirical findings revealed that decentralization improved service delivery in education and healthcare, particularly in middle-income countries with strong institutions, as seen in Bolivia and Argentina. However, its effectiveness varied across contexts, with developing nations often facing challenges such as weak administrative capacity, fiscal mismanagement, and regional disparities. The study identified key success factors, including balanced revenue-sharing mechanisms, hard budget constraints, and robust accountability systems, as demonstrated by Germany and China. Conversely, Latin American cases illustrated the risks of rapid decentralization without adequate safeguards, leading to fiscal instability and elite capture. The review also highlighted the importance of political decentralization in democratic settings, where it enhanced accountability but required careful design to avoid shorttermism and fragmentation. Policy implications emphasized the need for phased reforms, capacity building, and anti-corruption measures in developing countries, while advanced economies benefited from institutionalized equalization mechanisms. Emerging challenges, such as climate change and digital governance, underscore the necessity for adaptive fiscal frameworks. The study concluded that fiscal decentralization was not a universal solution but a context-dependent tool, requiring tailored approaches to achieve equitable and efficient outcomes. Future research directions include exploring digital tools, gender equity, and climate-responsive systems to address evolving governance needs.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了财政分权的理论、实证证据与政策启示，认为财政分权并非万能药，而是一个需根据具体情境量身定制的工具，其成功取决于制度质量、问责机制和平衡的财政安排。
AI.research_question: 财政分权如何在不同制度环境下影响治理效率、公共服务供给和经济增长？其成功实施的条件与挑战是什么？
AI.motivation: 财政分权在全球广泛推行，但效果参差不齐，亟需系统性梳理其理论基础与实证证据，为不同发展水平的国家提供情境化的政策指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 第一代理论：Oates（1972）的分配效率理论与Tiebout（1956）的竞争性联邦制理论；第二代理论：制度激励理论与市场维护型联邦制理论。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述与案例分析相结合。
AI.findings: 1）在中高收入且制度健全的国家（如玻利维亚、阿根廷），分权改善了教育和医疗等公共服务；2）发展中国家面临行政能力弱、财政管理不善和区域差距等挑战；3）成功的关键因素包括平衡的收入分享机制、硬预算约束和强大的问责体系（如德国、中国）；4）拉丁美洲案例表明，缺乏保障的快速分权会导致财政不稳定和精英俘获；5）政治分权在民主环境中增强问责，但需避免短视主义和碎片化。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合第一代与第二代财政联邦制理论，揭示了制度质量、问责机制与分权效果之间的理论联系，强调了情境依赖性的重要性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家提出分阶段改革、能力建设和反腐败措施等政策建议；为发达经济体提出制度化均衡机制的建议；指出气候变化与数字治理等新兴挑战需适应性财政框架。

reference: Harvard Business School Accounting & Management Unit Working Paper No. 26-083; Harvard Business School Working Paper No. 26-083
title: Generative AI and the Superstar Firm Effect
affiliations: Hong Kong University of Science & Technology (HKUST), Singapore Institute of Technology and Harvard Business School

detail.title: Generative AI and the Superstar Firm Effect

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Accounting & Management Unit Working Paper No. 26-083
publicationDetails.journalName: Harvard Business School: Accounting & Management Unit Working Paper Series

publicationDetails.detailsText: Harvard Business School Working Paper No. 26-083

detail.abstract: We examine how the emergence of Generative AI (GenAI) impacts the superstar firm effect across firms whose occupational tasks are more or less amenable to large-language-model automation. Using the release of ChatGPT as a market-wide shock to the availability of GenAI technologies, we find that investors value GenAI exposure among superstar firms. In the twelve months following the ChatGPT launch, high-GenAI superstars yield a 2.5% monthly characteristic-adjusted portfolio return, while high-GenAI non-superstars earn 0.6% and low-GenAI firms of both types cluster near zero. This premium among high-GenAI superstars continues to increase at the two-year horizon and is absent in the pre-ChatGPT period. Cross-sectionally, we find that this premium is concentrated among firms with high intangible capital, data capital, thick managerial hierarchies, and geographically dispersed workforces, consistent with GenAI creating value through complementary assets and coordination cost reduction. Lastly, we show that high-GenAI superstars exhibit higher profitability, as measured by return-on-assets, in the second fiscal year following the ChatGPT shock. Overall, our analysis points to a potential widening gap between superstar firms well-positioned to deploy GenAI and other firms.

AI.tldr: ChatGPT发布后，高GenAI暴露的超级明星公司月均超额收益达2.5%，而普通公司仅0.6%，且这一溢价集中在拥有互补资产（如无形资本、数据资本）和协调成本优势的企业中，预示着GenAI可能加剧超级明星企业与其他企业之间的差距。
AI.research_question: 生成式人工智能（GenAI）的兴起如何影响超级明星企业效应？具体而言，投资者是否对GenAI暴露程度不同的超级明星企业给予差异化的估值？
AI.motivation: GenAI技术（以ChatGPT为代表）的快速普及可能改变企业竞争格局，但现有文献对GenAI如何影响市场中的超级明星企业效应缺乏系统证据。本研究旨在检验GenAI是否以及如何放大超级明星企业的优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 超级明星企业效应（Superstar Firm Effect）；互补资产理论（Complementary Assets）；协调成本理论（Coordination Cost Reduction）；技术冲击与市场估值。
AI.method: 以ChatGPT发布（2022年11月）作为准自然实验，使用事件研究法构建多空投资组合，通过特征调整的月度组合收益率衡量GenAI暴露对超级明星企业和非超级明星企业的差异化影响，并进行横截面异质性分析和盈利表现检验。
AI.findings: （1）ChatGPT发布后，高GenAI暴露的超级明星企业月均特征调整收益率为2.5%，显著高于高GenAI非超级明星企业的0.6%，而低GenAI企业收益接近零；（2）这一溢价在两年期持续扩大，且在ChatGPT发布前不存在；（3）溢价集中在高无形资本、高数据资本、管理层级厚、员工地理分布分散的企业；（4）高GenAI超级明星企业在冲击后第二财年表现出更高的资产收益率（ROA）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次实证检验GenAI对超级明星企业效应的放大作用，揭示了技术冲击如何通过互补资产和协调成本机制加剧市场集中度，拓展了超级明星企业效应和技术变革对市场结构影响的理论边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者识别GenAI时代具有超额收益潜力的企业提供分析框架；为企业管理者明确互补资产（数据资本、组织层级等）的战略价值；为政策制定者关注GenAI可能加剧的市场不平等问题提供预警。

title: The Nexus of Creative Destruction in Entrepreneurship and Nigeria's Economic Development
affiliations: and University Of Delta, Agbor

detail.title: The Nexus of Creative Destruction in Entrepreneurship and Nigeria's Economic Development
detail.abstract: This study explores the nexus of creative destruction in entrepreneurship and Nigeria's economic development. Within Nigeria's entrepreneurial ecosystem, the idea of "creative destruction," which emphasizes innovation-driven replacement of outdated goods, procedures, and business models, is still not fully utilized. Many Nigerian businesses, especially small and medium-sized organizations (SMEs), function inside antiquated frameworks that stifle innovation, which limits their ability to upend ineffective processes and significantly advance economic development. This study uses a time-series econometric technique and a quantitative research design to investigate the relationship between Nigeria's economic progress and creative destruction in entrepreneurship. Because it allows the researcher to apply statistical tools to measure correlations among variables, the quantitative design is appropriate. Because the study uses pre-existing macroeconomic data and entrepreneurial indicators in Nigeria, it explicitly employs the ex-post facto research design. Numerous industries, including security, agriculture, energy, digital technology, and education, exhibit this pattern. Through innovations, entrepreneurs are rethinking how to change labor structures and introducing new technology, behaviors, and supply chains. This change is a purposeful model shift from the previous pattern to a new one that promotes economic growth and development and fosters entrepreneurial caution. According to the findings, entrepreneurs are constantly developing new technologies, such as artificial intelligence designed to perform human tasks. The educational system also demonstrated the steady advancement of crucial reconfigurations in response to the demands of the current labor market, especially in science-related sectors. Based on the findings, the study concludes that in developing economies, the shift from traditional to innovative thinking happens relatively slowly. Based on the findings, the study recommends that developing economies must alter the status quo and promote the establishment of new ventures as an agent of creative destruction.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了尼日利亚创业活动中"创造性破坏"与经济发展的关系，发现该国中小企业仍沿用过时框架，创新驱动不足。采用时间序列计量方法分析宏观数据，结果表明从传统思维向创新思维的转变在发展中经济体较为缓慢，建议发展中国家需改变现状，促进新创企业作为创造性破坏的推动力。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚创业活动中的创造性破坏与经济发展之间存在怎样的关系？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚创业生态系统中，创造性破坏的理念尚未得到充分利用，大量中小企业沿用抑制创新的过时框架，限制了其对经济发展的贡献。这一现实问题促使研究者探究两者之间的关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创造性破坏理论（Creative Destruction），强调创新驱动下旧产品、流程和商业模式的被替代过程。
AI.method: 采用定量研究设计，运用时间序列计量经济分析方法，具体使用事后的（ex-post facto）研究设计，利用尼日利亚现有的宏观经济数据和创业指标进行分析。
AI.findings: （1）企业家持续开发新技术，如执行人类任务的人工智能；（2）教育体系（尤其是科学领域）正根据劳动力市场需求进行稳步重构；（3）在发展中经济体，从传统思维向创新思维的转变相对缓慢。
AI.theory_contributions: 将创造性破坏理论应用于尼日利亚这一发展中经济体的创业情境，验证了该理论在新兴市场中的适用性，揭示了发展中国家中创新转型速度较慢这一理论现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议发展中国家必须改变现状，推动新创企业作为创造性破坏的代理人，以促进经济转型与发展。

affiliations: Islamic Azad University

detail.title: Examining the Impact of Organizational Culture on Corporate Governance: A Pathway to Reducing Business Failure Risk

publicationDetails.detailsText: American University, WCL Research Paper No. American University, WCL Research Paper No.
publicationDetails.journalName: American University Washington College of Law Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article investigates the relationship between organizational culture and corporate governance mechanisms and their combined effect on business failure risk. While prior research has extensively examined corporate governance as a formal system of rules, processes, and oversight mechanisms, the role of organizational culture-the informal, shared values, beliefs, and behavioral norms-has been largely underexplored. Drawing on the qualitative findings from an Iranian study that identified cultural factors as key components of business failure prediction, this conceptual article argues that organizational culture serves as both a foundation for and a complement to formal governance mechanisms. A strong ethical, transparent, and accountable culture enhances the effectiveness of governance structures such as board independence, audit committees, and internal controls. Conversely, a weak or dysfunctional culture undermines even the most well-designed governance systems. The article develops a theoretical framework linking organizational culture dimensions to governance effectiveness and business failure risk, and offers practical recommendations for managers, board members, and regulators in emerging markets.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨组织文化与公司治理机制如何共同影响企业失败风险，认为组织文化既是正式治理机制的基础，也是其补充。强伦理、透明、负责的文化能提升治理结构的有效性，而弱文化则会破坏治理系统，并提出了一个连接组织文化维度、治理有效性与企业失败风险的理论框架。
AI.research_question: 组织文化与公司治理机制如何共同影响企业失败风险？
AI.motivation: 以往研究广泛考察了作为正式规则系统的公司治理，但组织文化（非正式共享价值观、信念和行为规范）的作用在很大程度上未被充分探索。基于一项伊朗研究的定性发现（该研究识别出文化因素是商业失败预测的关键组成部分），本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织文化维度（伦理、透明、负责的文化）与治理有效性（董事会独立性、审计委员会、内部控制）之间的关系，以及它们对企业失败风险的联合影响。
AI.method: 概念性文章，基于一项伊朗研究的定性发现进行理论构建。
AI.findings: 1) 组织文化是正式治理机制的基础和补充；2) 强伦理、透明、负责的文化能增强董事会独立性、审计委员会和内部控制等治理结构的有效性；3) 弱或功能失调的文化会破坏设计再好的治理系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织文化维度与公司治理有效性以及企业失败风险进行理论连接，发展了整合性理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场的管理者、董事会成员和监管者提供实践建议，强调在完善正式治理机制的同时，需要培育强大的组织文化。

title: An Elegant Edifice on a Faulty Foundation: A Critique of the Neoclassical Theory of the Firm
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Independent Scholar

detail.title: An Elegant Edifice on a Faulty Foundation: A Critique of the Neoclassical Theory of the Firm
detail.abstract: This study critiques the neoclassical theory of the firm by examining several foundational assumptions that continue to shape mainstream microeconomic analysis. It argues that price should not be treated as an independent variable in a market economy, that marginal cost cannot be analytically separated from average variable cost under a given technology, and that the conventional upward-sloping marginal cost curve lacks both logical and empirical support. The study also challenges marginal product theory where production requires coordinated combinations of heterogeneous inputs and argues that standard models give insufficient attention to profit, entrepreneurship, advertising, technological differentiation, and strategic market behavior. In place of the conventional framework, the study develops an entrepreneurial-analytic theory of the firm based on average-cost pricing, with cost understood to include the opportunity cost of capital; the equivalence of marginal cost and average variable cost; and the average total cost curve as the basis of firm supply. On the demand side, it treats customers' monetary budgets for specific goods and services as the operative source of demand and interprets demand curves as hypothetical pricequantity combinations constrained by expenditure. The study introduces the hoe-shaped supply curve, the demand band, the demand gravitational axis, and the concept of protective cover to explain price variation, product differentiation, advertising, research and development, firm growth, and the persistence of noncompetitive market structures.

AI.tldr: 本文批判新古典企业理论的核心假设，提出以平均成本定价、边际成本与平均可变成本等价为基础的创业-分析型企业理论，并引入锄形供给曲线、需求带、需求引力轴和保护罩等新概念来解释价格变异、产品差异、广告、研发、企业成长及非竞争市场结构的持续性。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种替代新古典企业理论的分析框架，以更好地解释现实市场中的价格决定、企业行为与非竞争市场结构？
AI.motivation: 新古典企业理论的多项基础假设存在逻辑和经验缺陷，包括将价格视为独立变量、边际成本与平均可变成本的错误分离、上倾边际成本曲线缺乏支撑、边际产品理论的局限性，以及对利润、企业家精神、广告、技术差异和战略行为等关键因素的忽视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 创业-分析型企业理论（entrepreneurial-analytic theory of the firm），基于平均成本定价、边际成本与平均可变成本等价、平均总成本曲线作为企业供给基础；需求侧以消费者货币预算作为需求的操作性来源，将需求曲线解释为受支出约束的假设性价格-数量组合。
AI.method: 理论批判与理论建构相结合，基于逻辑分析和概念推演。
AI.findings: 提出了锄形供给曲线、需求带、需求引力轴和保护罩等新概念，用以解释价格变异、产品差异化、广告、研发、企业成长以及非竞争市场结构的持续性。
AI.theory_contributions: 对新古典企业理论的基础假设进行了系统性批判；构建了以平均成本定价为核心的替代性分析框架；提出了多个原创性概念工具（锄形供给曲线、需求带、需求引力轴、保护罩），为分析企业行为和市场竞争提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解现实市场中企业定价行为、产品差异化策略、广告与研发投入、企业成长路径以及非竞争市场结构的形成与维持提供了更具解释力的理论工具。

detail.abstract: Broad-based equity compensation gives rank-and-file employees a financial claim on firm value, but it does not clarify how employees should act on that claim. We ask whether communication around an equity plan can clarify these actions and motivate workers. In a field experiment at a building-materials supply company, locations were randomly assigned to receive shareholder letters framing stock appreciation rights around concrete behavioral norms or around abstract organizational values. Norms-based communication reduced turnover by 13.2 percentage points relative to values-based communication and increased employees’ self-reported cultural identification. The retention advantage of norms-based communication was concentrated during a period of operational disruption, Hurricane Helene, when behavioral clarity was likely to be especially valuable. A pre-registered online study with construction-sector employees provides controlled evidence consistent with the field patterns, benchmarks norms and values communication against equity-only communication, and identifies message concreteness as the primary measured mechanism. These results suggest that internal communication is a complementary control mechanism that affects the implementation of broad-based equity incentives by clarifying the behaviors through which rank-and-file employees can act on ownership.

AI.tldr: 通过实地实验发现，基于具体行为规范的股东信沟通比基于抽象价值观的沟通更能降低员工离职率（降低13.2个百分点），尤其是在运营混乱时期（如飓风海伦期间）效果更显著。预先注册的在线研究证实了这些发现，并识别出信息具体性是主要作用机制。
AI.research_question: 围绕股权激励计划的内部沟通（基于行为规范的沟通 vs. 基于抽象价值观的沟通）如何影响普通员工的行为和留任意愿？
AI.motivation: 广泛基础的股权激励虽然赋予员工财务索取权，但并未明确员工应如何行动来行使这一权利。因此，沟通方式可能成为补充控制机制，帮助员工理解如何通过具体行为来体现"主人翁"意识。
AI.theoretical_framework: 股权激励理论、内部控制理论、沟通清晰度理论、行为规范与价值观框架
AI.method: 实地实验（建筑材料公司各门店随机分配）+ 预先注册的在线实验（建筑业员工样本）
AI.findings: 1）基于行为规范的沟通相比价值观沟通降低离职率13.2个百分点；2）提升员工文化认同感；3）在飓风海伦等运营混乱期，规范沟通的留人优势更显著；4）在线实验确认信息具体性是主要机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 将内部沟通识别为股权激励实施的补充控制机制，揭示了沟通的具体性如何帮助员工将所有权转化为具体行为，拓展了股权激励与内部控制交叉领域的理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计股权激励计划的配套沟通策略提供实证依据，建议管理者采用具体行为规范而非抽象价值观来引导员工理解和执行股权激励计划。

detail.abstract: Generative AI has the potential to transform productivity and reduce inequality, but only if adopted broadly. In this paper, we synthesize evidence from 76 sources from over 100 countries and analyze web traffic data to show that gender gaps in generative AI use are nearly universal and persistent. Focusing on the 318,924 respondents from sources that report usage rates for both men and women, we estimate an AI adoption rate of 47.8% for men versus 39.3% for women, a relative gap of 22%. While this relative gap has shrunk over time, it has stabilized at roughly 16% since early 2025. These patterns hold in global web traffic data on the ten most visited AI tools. This data also reveals that women generally spend less time using AI and that the gaps are largest for frontier tools. Our findings are consistent with a view that as AI diffuses, the gap shrinks as women are exposed to and gain familiarity with AI, but that institutional, organizational, and social frictions will likely lead to persistent gaps in who uses AI.

AI.tldr: 本文通过综合分析来自100多个国家76篇文献的31.8万受访者数据及网络流量数据，发现生成式AI使用存在普遍且持续的性别差距（男性47.8% vs 女性39.3%，相对差距22%），且差距在2025年初稳定在约16%。女性使用AI时间更少，前沿工具差距更大，表明制度、组织和社会摩擦可能导致差距持续存在。
AI.research_question: 生成式AI的使用是否存在性别差距？这种差距是否具有普遍性和持续性？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI有潜力提升生产力和减少不平等，但前提是广泛采用。如果采用本身存在性别差距，则可能加剧而非缩小不平等，因此需要系统评估AI采用的性别差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术扩散理论；性别与技术采用差距的摩擦理论（包括制度、组织和社会层面的摩擦因素）
AI.method: 综合分析法：对来自100多个国家的76篇文献进行元分析，涵盖318,924名受访者数据；同时分析十大最常用AI工具的网络流量数据，进行交叉验证。
AI.findings: 男性AI采用率47.8%，女性39.3%，相对差距22%；相对差距随时间缩小但2025年初稳定在约16%；女性使用AI时间更短；前沿工具性别差距最大；差距在各国普遍存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI采用中性别差距的稳定性和普遍性，验证了技术扩散初期差距扩大、后期收窄但难以完全消除的理论预期，并指出制度/组织/社会摩擦是差距持续存在的关键机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了AI性别差距的系统证据，提示需要针对性干预措施（如提升女性AI接触机会和熟悉度）以促进AI的包容性采用，避免技术加剧性别不平等。

title: Shadow AI in Judicial Chambers: Mapping the Hidden Use of Consumer-Grade Large Language Models by Judicial Staff and Proposing a Risk-Based Traffic Light Protocol

detail.title: Shadow AI in Judicial Chambers: Mapping the Hidden Use of Consumer-Grade Large Language Models by Judicial Staff and Proposing a Risk-Based Traffic Light Protocol
detail.abstract: Generative artificial intelligence is entering judicial chambers not through formal adoption decisions, but through the everyday choices of law clerks, externs, and administrative staff who reach for consumer-grade large language models to keep pace with mounting workloads. This paper introduces the concept of Shadow AI in the judicial context, adapting the well-established organizational literature on Shadow IT to the specific governance environment of Article III and state court chambers. While an explosion of recent literature addresses AI use in law firms and formal court technology procurement, this paper presents the first systematic framework specifically addressing the internal human-operational risk of judicial chambers, the gap that existing clerk-level policy leaves unaddressed. Drawing on publicly available court policies, ethics opinions, recent disciplinary proceedings, and behavioral research on unauthorized technology adoption, the paper argues that current judicial AI governance is trapped in a binary logic: either an outright ban or a general permit. Both approaches fail to account for the spectrum of risk that different AI use cases actually present. To address this gap, we propose a Risk-Based Traffic Light Protocol that classifies chamber AI use into three tiers: Green (administrative support, minimal oversight required), Yellow (research assistance, mandatory human verification), and Red (substantive adjudication, impermissible delegation). The framework is mapped against the Model Code of Judicial Conduct and emerging multi-jurisdictional guidance. We outline a survey-based empirical methodology for validating the framework with current and former judicial clerks. The paper concludes with policy recommendations for court administrators, judicial education programs, and bar associations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"影子AI"概念，借鉴影子IT的组织学文献，分析法官助理、实习生和行政人员私下使用消费级大语言模型的现象。当前司法AI治理陷入"全面禁止"或"全面允许"的二元困境。作者提出基于风险的交通信号灯协议（红/黄/绿三级），并建议通过问卷调查验证该框架。
AI.research_question: 在司法环境中，"影子AI"（法官助理等非正式使用消费级大语言模型）如何产生，现有治理框架为何失效，以及如何构建更有效的分级治理方案？
AI.motivation: 法官助理等人员为应对日益繁重的工作量，私自使用消费级AI工具，但现有政策（要么全面禁止要么全面允许）无法覆盖不同AI用例的风险差异，存在治理空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 影子IT（Shadow IT）的组织学理论；风险分类治理逻辑；《司法行为示范守则》及多司法管辖区伦理指引。
AI.method: 基于公开法院政策、伦理意见、近期纪律处分程序、以及未经授权技术采纳的行为研究；提出基于风险的交通信号灯协议（三级分类）；建议采用问卷调查法对当前和前任法官助理进行实证验证。
AI.findings: 1）影子AI在司法系统中真实存在且被忽视；2）当前治理陷入二元逻辑（禁止或允许），无法应对不同风险等级；3）提出三级分类：绿色（行政支持，最低监督）、黄色（研究辅助，强制人工复核）、红色（实质性裁判，禁止委托）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将影子IT理论系统引入司法情境，提出司法影子AI的概念框架，填补了现有文献中关于法院内部人机操作风险的研究空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为法院管理者、司法教育项目和律师协会提供可操作的政策建议；提出可落地的交通信号灯分级协议，帮助司法系统在不全面禁止也不全面放任的前提下管理AI使用风险。

detail.abstract: This study aims to analyze the impact of audit quality on accounting anomalies in companies listed on the Tehran Stock Exchange (TSE). A mixed-methods sequential exploratory design was employed. In the qualitative phase, using grounded theory and semi-structured interviews with 12 experts, audit quality dimensions were identified as auditor-specific characteristics, audit processes, and audit outcomes. In the quantitative phase, data collected from 164 financial managers and accountants were analyzed using structural equation modeling (SmartPLS). The findings indicate that auditor-specific characteristics (including independence, expertise, tenure, and firm size) have a significant negative effect on accounting anomalies. Furthermore, audit outcomes (such as reducing information asymmetry, enhancing financial statement reliability, and detecting material misstatements) also significantly reduce accounting anomalies. However, the audit process dimension showed no significant effect. These results highlight that strengthening auditor characteristics and improving audit outcomes can effectively constrain earnings management and other accounting distortions.

AI.tldr: 本研究采用混合方法（定性扎根理论与定量结构方程模型），发现审计师特征和审计结果能显著降低伊朗上市公司会计异常，但审计流程维度无显著影响。
AI.research_question: 审计质量如何影响德黑兰证券交易所上市公司的会计异常？
AI.motivation: 新兴市场（伊朗）审计质量与会计异常之间的关系尚不明确，现有研究多集中于发达市场，缺乏针对新兴市场的系统性混合方法研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 审计质量理论（从审计师特征、审计流程、审计结果三个维度）、代理理论（信息不对称与盈余管理）、信号传递理论。
AI.method: 混合方法顺序探索设计：定性阶段采用扎根理论对12位专家进行半结构化访谈；定量阶段对164名财务经理和会计师进行问卷调查，使用SmartPLS进行结构方程模型分析。
AI.findings: （1）审计师特征（独立性、专业性、任期、事务所规模）显著负向影响会计异常；（2）审计结果（降低信息不对称、增强财务报告可靠性、发现重大错报）显著减少会计异常；（3）审计流程维度对会计异常无显著影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 将审计质量分解为三个维度并实证检验其对会计异常的不同影响，揭示了审计流程与会计异常之间关系的非显著性，丰富了新兴市场审计治理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场监管机构提供了政策依据：应重点强化审计师独立性、专业能力和事务所规模等特征，并注重审计结果的产出质量，而非单纯规范审计流程。

title: Neuroleadership Research in HRM: A Systematic Review
affiliations: Southern Cross University - Gold Coast Campus, Southern Cross University and Southern Cross University

detail.title: Neuroleadership Research in HRM: A Systematic Review
detail.abstract: Neurocognitive patterns in leadership shape employee behavior and organizational outcomes, offering important insights for advancing human resource management (HRM) theory and practice. Using a focused, theory-driven journal-based content analysis of ten high-ranked HRM and organizational journals, this review synthesizes neuroleadership research published between 2005 and 2025. The analysis is guided by six integrated neuroleadership themes (decision-making, emotional regulation, motivation and reward processing, social cognition, stress resilience, and attentional control) across six core HRM domains and interpreted through performance-oriented and sustainability-oriented HRM perspectives. The findings suggest that neuroleadership research predominantly emphasizes sustainability-oriented HRM, with decision-making and emotional-cognitive themes most frequently examined within learning and development, followed by employee engagement and well-being and organizational development. In contrast, performance-oriented HRM emphases, such as performance control and transactional management, receive comparatively less attention. The review highlights the need to expand research on motivation, stress resilience, and attentional control to address the demands of an increasingly digitalized workforce.

AI.tldr: 本文通过系统综述2005-2025年间发表于10本高排名HRM和组织学期刊中的神经领导力研究，发现该领域主要关注可持续导向型HRM，决策和情绪-认知主题在学习与发展领域研究最多，而绩效导向型HRM（如绩效控制、交易型管理）关注较少。研究呼吁加强对动机、压力韧性和注意力控制的研究，以应对数字化劳动力需求。
AI.research_question: 神经领导力研究在HRM领域中的分布格局如何？不同HRM领域（绩效导向 vs 可持续导向）对神经领导力主题的关注有何差异？
AI.motivation: 神经领导力研究为理解领导行为如何影响员工行为和组织结果提供了重要见解，但现有文献缺乏对该领域研究主题分布的全面梳理，特别是从HRM理论视角（绩效导向与可持续导向）进行系统分类和分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 六项整合神经领导力主题（决策、情绪调节、动机与奖赏加工、社会认知、压力韧性、注意力控制）；六项核心HRM领域；绩效导向HRM与可持续导向HRM双重视角。
AI.method: 基于理论驱动的期刊内容分析法，对2005-2025年间10本高排名HRM与组织学期刊中的神经领导力研究进行系统综述。
AI.findings: 1）神经领导力研究主要关注可持续导向型HRM；2）决策和情绪-认知主题在学习与发展领域研究最多，其次是员工敬业度与幸福感以及组织发展；3）绩效导向型HRM（绩效控制、交易型管理）关注较少；4）动机、压力韧性和注意力控制等主题需进一步拓展研究。
AI.theory_contributions: 1）构建了神经领导力主题与HRM领域的系统性映射框架；2）揭示了神经领导力研究在HRM中的分布偏好（偏重可持续导向）；3）为未来研究提供了明确的研究空白和方向指引。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为HRM实践者提供了神经领导力研究成果的应用指南；2）指出企业在数字化转型中应加强对领导者动机、压力韧性和注意力控制的培养；3）提示组织在绩效管理与员工发展之间寻求平衡。

title: Enforcing Ethics in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: Circular 230 and AI-Assisted Tax Practice

detail.title: Enforcing Ethics in the Age of Artificial Intelligence: Circular 230 and AI-Assisted Tax Practice
detail.abstract:
As generative artificial intelligence tools become embedded in U.S. tax advisory practice, a fundamental governance question arises: does the existing Circular 230 disciplinary framework adequately regulate practitioners who rely on AI-generated guidance? This study provides an empirical investigation of this question through a two-phase research design grounded in regulatory lag theory.

In Phase 1, a content analysis of 187 disciplinary actions issued by the IRS Office of Professional Responsibility (OPR) against Certified Public Accountants and Enrolled Agents from 2020 through 2025 is conducted. Coding of cases against Circular 230 provisions reveals that 78.1 percent of sanctions are issued under §10.82(b), the expedited suspension provision used for externally verifiable triggers such as criminal convictions, professional license suspension or revocation, or violations of prior disciplinary conditions, while zero cases cite §10.22 (due diligence), §10.35 (competence), or §10.37 (written advice standards). This enforcement pattern holds consistently across all years of the sample, including the post-2022 period during which AI-assisted tax tools achieved widespread adoption.

In Phase 2, ten tax advisory scenarios drawn from Phase 1 violation categories are submitted to three publicly accessible AI tools: ChatGPT (GPT-5.3 Instant), Microsoft Copilot, and Google Gemini (as accessed in March 2026). Outputs are evaluated against a seven-dimension Circular 230 compliance rubric. Results reveal that AI tools achieve relatively strong accuracy scores (mean 3.33 out of 4.0) but received lower scores on disclaimer adequacy (mean 1.70 out of 4.0) and written advice standards (mean 2.40 out of 4.0). Only 26.7 percent of outputs are rated fully compliant.

Together, these findings suggest a potential regulatory alignment gap: AI-generated advisory outputs may implicate the Circular 230 provisions most relevant to practice quality, while the published OPR enforcement record during the sample period is concentrated in provisions unrelated to written advice, competence, and due diligence. The study discusses implications for tax practitioners, professional standard-setters, and regulatory bodies as AI-assisted tax advisory practices continue to evolve.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过两阶段实证设计，发现美国IRS对税务从业者AI行为的监管存在"监管滞后"：OPR的制裁集中在与AI输出质量最不相关的条款（如刑事定罪），而AI工具在尽职调查、胜任能力和书面建议标准等核心质量条款上的合规性表现不佳，形成监管错位。
AI.research_question: 现有Circular 230纪律框架能否有效监管依赖AI生成指导的税务从业者？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI工具已深度嵌入美国税务咨询实践，但监管框架是否能够跟上技术发展尚不明确，存在监管滞后风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 监管滞后理论（Regulatory Lag Theory）
AI.method: 两阶段研究设计：阶段1对2020-2025年IRS职业责任办公室187项纪律处分进行内容分析；阶段2将10个税务咨询场景提交给ChatGPT、Microsoft Copilot和Google Gemini，并按Circular 230合规标准七维度评估。
AI.findings: 阶段1：78.1%的制裁依据§10.82(b)（快速暂停条款，用于刑事定罪等外部可验证触发因素），零案例引用§10.22（尽职调查）、§10.35（胜任能力）或§10.37（书面建议标准）。阶段2：AI工具准确性得分较高（均值3.33/4.0），但免责声明充分性（1.70/4.0）和书面建议标准（2.40/4.0）得分较低，仅26.7%的输出完全合规。
AI.theory_contributions: 为监管滞后理论提供了实证证据，揭示了技术发展速度与监管响应之间的结构性错位。
AI.practical_contributions: 对税务从业者、专业标准制定机构和监管机构提出警示：现有监管框架需更新以适应AI辅助税务实践的演进；建议加强AI输出在尽职调查、胜任能力和书面建议标准方面的合规性。

title: Fiscal Capacity, Institutional Quality, and Economic Development in Developing Economies: Bootstrap Mediation Evidence from a GSEM Framework
affiliations: ,  and University of Ghana

detail.title: Fiscal Capacity, Institutional Quality, and Economic Development in Developing Economies: Bootstrap Mediation Evidence from a GSEM Framework

declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this paper.

keywords: developing economies Paper type: Research paper JEL Classification: H20

detail.abstract: Purpose-This study examines how fiscal capacity translates into economic development through institutional quality in developing economies. Design/methodology/approach-Using an unbalanced panel of 90 developing and emerging economies from 2000 to 2022, the study employs Generalised Structural Equation Modelling (GSEM) with 5,000-replication cluster bootstrap inference. Two institutional channels are tested: rule of law and control of corruption. Findings-Both channels yield significant indirect effects with bootstrap confidence intervals excluding zero. The rule of law channel produces an indirect effect of 0.287 (95% CI: [0.087, 0.487], p = 0.005). The corruption control channel produces an indirect effect of 0.188 (95% CI: [0.006, 0.370], p = 0.043). In both cases the direct effect of tax revenue on GDP per capita is not significant, classifying both as indirect-only mediation. The rule of law channel is fully robust across all robustness checks. The corruption control channel is more sensitive to governance measurement specification. Both channels fail when GDP per capita growth rate replaces income level as the outcome, confirming institutional inertia. Practical implications-The developmental dividend of tax revenue is not automatic. Governments should invest in institutional reform alongside revenue mobilisation. Tax administration reform is simultaneously institutional state-building. The rule of law channel offers a more reliable policy target than the corruption control channel. Originality/value-This study provides the first formal bootstrap mediation decomposition of the fiscal capacity-institutional quality-economic development nexus in a large developing country panel, using GSEM and the contemporary mediation inference framework.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用90个发展中国家的面板数据（2000-2022），通过广义结构方程模型（GSEM）检验财政能力通过制度质量（法治和腐败控制）对经济发展的间接效应，发现法治渠道的间接效应稳健且显著，而税收的直接效应不显著，属于完全中介。
AI.research_question: 财政能力如何通过制度质量（法治和腐败控制）转化为发展中国家的经济发展？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家在提升财政收入的同时，未必能自动实现经济发展，需要探究制度质量在其中发挥的传导作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财政能力—制度质量—经济发展中介模型，基于法治和腐败控制两个制度渠道。
AI.method: 采用90个发展中和新兴经济体2000-2022年的非平衡面板数据，运用广义结构方程模型（GSEM）结合5000次重复聚类自助法推断，测试法治和腐败控制两个中介渠道。
AI.findings: 两个渠道均产生显著的间接效应（法治：0.287，95% CI [0.087, 0.487]；腐败控制：0.188，95% CI [0.006, 0.370]），税收对人均GDP的直接效应不显著，属于完全中介。法治渠道在所有稳健性检验中均稳健，腐败控制渠道对治理测量指标更敏感。以GDP增长率为结果变量时两个渠道均不显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在大样本发展中国家面板数据中，使用正式的自助法中介分解框架验证了财政能力通过制度质量影响经济发展的传导机制，区分了法治与腐败控制两个渠道的不同稳健性。
AI.practical_contributions: 税收的发展红利并非自动获得，政府应在增加财政收入的同时投资于制度改革，特别是法治建设；税收征管改革本身就是制度能力建设，法治渠道比腐败控制渠道更可靠的政策目标。

Military Fragmentation and State Failure in Sudan
A Structural Analysis of Disintegration, Theoretical Frameworks, Future Scenarios, and the Role of Leadership (2019–2026)
