detail.abstract:
Introduction: Cutaneous melanoma (CM) is an aggressive form of skin cancer; however, its epidemiology in low-and middle-income countries remains poorly understood. Acral lentiginous melanoma (ALM), a subtype that disproportionately affects individuals of African descent, is frequently associated with delayed diagnosis and adverse outcomes. We aimed to characterise the sociodemographic and clinicopathological profile of CM in a predominantly rural South African population.

Methods: We conducted a retrospective observational study of 153 patients with histopathologically confirmed CM managed at a tertiary centre in the Eastern Cape Province, South Africa, over a 10-year period between 1 January 2015 and 31 December 2024. Demographic, clinical, and histopathological data, including subtype, anatomical site, Breslow thickness, and American Joint Committee on Cancer stage, were extracted from patients’ medical records.

Results: Patients were predominantly female (64.7%), aged ≥60 years (60.1%), and Black African (74.5%). ALM was the most common subtype (54.2%), occurring almost exclusively in Black African patients (97.6% of ALM cases). CM most frequently involved the feet (68.0%). More than half of the patients reported symptoms exceeding 12 months, and 63.4% presented with lesions ≥21 mm. Advanced disease predominated: 59.5% were diagnosed at stage III or IV, and 46.7% had tumours >4.0 mm in Breslow thickness.

Conclusion: In this rural African setting, CM is characterised by ALM predominance and advanced-stage presentation. These findings underscore profound inequities in early detection, and highlight the need for context-specific screening strategies and strengthened oncological capacity in resource-limited healthcare settings.

AI.tldr: 该研究描述了南非东开普省农村地区153名皮肤黑色素瘤患者的人口学和临床病理特征，发现肢端雀斑样痣黑色素瘤（ALM）是最常见的亚型（54.2%），主要发生在黑人患者中（97.6%），且患者确诊时多处于晚期（III/IV期占59.5%），揭示了早期检测方面的严重不平等。
AI.research_question: 在南非东开普省以农村为主的地区，皮肤黑色素瘤（尤其是肢端雀斑样痣黑色素瘤）的人口学特征和临床病理特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 皮肤黑色素瘤在中低收入国家的流行病学特征尚不明确，尤其是肢端雀斑样痣黑色素瘤（ALM）在非洲裔人群中不成比例地高发却常被延迟诊断，因此需要针对资源有限环境下的疾病特征展开研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 皮肤黑色素瘤的流行病学、肢端雀斑样痣黑色素瘤（ALM）的亚型特征、癌症早期检测与预后关系、健康不平等理论。
AI.method: 回顾性观察研究，纳入2015年1月1日至2024年12月31日期间南非东开普省一家三级医疗中心经组织病理学确诊的153名皮肤黑色素瘤患者，从病历中提取人口学、临床和组织病理学数据。
AI.findings: 患者以女性（64.7%）、≥60岁（60.1%）和黑人（74.5%）为主。ALM是最常见亚型（54.2%），几乎只发生在黑人患者中（占ALM病例的97.6%）。病变最常发生在足部（68.0%）。超半数患者症状持续时间超过12个月，63.4%的患者病灶≥21mm。晚期疾病为主：59.5%在III或IV期确诊，46.7%的肿瘤Breslow厚度大于4.0mm。
AI.theory_contributions: 为南非农村地区的皮肤黑色素瘤流行病学提供了实证数据，证实了ALM在该人群中的主导地位及晚期确诊的普遍性，丰富了关于中低收入国家黑色素瘤亚型分布的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了资源有限医疗环境下早期检测能力的严重不足，强调需要制定因地制宜的筛查策略，并加强非洲农村地区的肿瘤诊疗能力建设。

title: Cognitive Rent and Bloc Formation in Eurasia: Can the Artificial-Intelligence Factor Catalyse a China-Russia-Central Asia Security Coalition?

detail.title: Cognitive Rent and Bloc Formation in Eurasia: Can the Artificial-Intelligence Factor Catalyse a China-Russia-Central Asia Security Coalition?
detail.abstract: This paper asks whether the diffusion of advanced artificial intelligence (AI) can act as a structural catalyst for the formation of a military-political coalition spanning China, Russia, Central Asia, and the adjacent states of Pakistan and Iran. Departing from conventional balance-of-power readings, it advances a political-economy account built on world-systems theory and an original construct, cognitive rent-the rent extracted from monopoly control over the infrastructure of cognition (compute, data, frontier models, and technical standards). I argue that AI is not merely an economic variable but a security one: dependence on a foreign AI stack, normative convergence around state-sovereign AI governance, and falling costs of military-technical interoperability jointly generate pressure toward coalition formation. The hypothesis is stated conditionally and tested against the actual institutional terrain of the Shanghai Cooperation Organisation (SCO), the Eurasian Economic Union (EAEU), and the Collective Security Treaty Organisation (CSTO). The analysis foregrounds two hard objections-that China and Russia are not formal allies, and that India's SCO membership precludes the organisation from serving as a bloc vehicle-and shows that any emergent coalition would be a sub-grouping normatively wrapped by, but not coterminous with, the SCO. The contribution is to theorise AI as a bloc-formation variable and to position Central Asia as a semi-peripheral agent rather than a passive object.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨先进AI扩散是否会在中、俄、中亚、巴基斯坦和伊朗之间催生军事政治联盟，基于世界体系理论和“认知租金”概念，提出AI作为安全变量通过技术依赖、治理规范趋同和军事互操作性成本下降推动联盟形成，并以SCO、EAEU、CSTO等制度框架进行条件性检验。
AI.research_question: 先进人工智能的扩散能否成为跨越中国、俄罗斯、中亚及巴基斯坦、伊朗的军事政治联盟形成的结构性催化剂？
AI.motivation: 传统均势理论难以解释AI驱动的国际联盟重组，需要新的政治经济学框架来理解AI如何作为一种安全变量影响联盟形成。
AI.theoretical_framework: 世界体系理论（核心-半边缘-边缘结构）和“认知租金”概念——从对认知基础设施（算力、数据、前沿模型、技术标准）的垄断控制中提取的租金。
AI.method: 条件性假设检验：将假设与SCO、EAEU、CSTO等实际制度场域进行对照分析，并回应两个硬反驳（中俄非正式盟友、印度SCO成员身份问题）。
AI.findings: 任何新兴联盟将是SCO框架内的次集团，在规范上被SCO包裹但不与其同延；AI通过三项机制（对外国AI栈的依赖、国家主权AI治理的规范趋同、军事技术互操作性成本下降）联合推动联盟压力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI理论化为联盟形成的变量；将中亚定位为半边缘行动者而非被动客体；提出“认知租金”概念拓展世界体系理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解AI时代的大国联盟重组提供分析框架；揭示中亚等半边缘国家在AI地缘政治中的能动性角色。

title: Socio-Environmental Inequality in Urban Attica: A Five-Year Multi-Source Assessment of Compound Climate Vulnerability Across 66 Municipalities (2020-2024)

detail.title: Socio-Environmental Inequality in Urban Attica: A Five-Year Multi-Source Assessment of Compound Climate Vulnerability Across 66 Municipalities (2020-2024)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no personal or financial conflicts of interest. This research received no external funding.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses only publicly available secondary data (satellite imagery, census records, and publicly reported fire service incidents). No human participants were involved. Ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Climate change does not affect all urban residents equally. This study investigates the spatial distribution of compound environmental vulnerability across 66 municipalities of the Attica region (Greece) over a five-year period (2020-2024), with complete multisource data available for 59 municipalities, integrating satellite-derived biophysical indicators, census socioeconomic data, and operational fire service records. Land Surface Temperature (LST) and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI) were extracted from Landsat 8 and Landsat 9 Collection 2 imagery via Google Earth Engine; unemployment rates were obtained from the Hellenic Statistical Authority (ELSTAT) Census 2021; and flood exposure was quantified through 2,514 water-pumping incidents recorded by the Hellenic Fire Service. An Environmental Vulnerability Index (EVI) was computed as an equal-weight composite of four normalized components (LST, NDVI deficit, flood risk, and unemployment rate), following the methodological framework of Cutter, Boruff, and Shirley (2003). Municipalities were classified as 'affluent' or 'deprived' at the median unemployment threshold (12.0%)-a standard approach that maximizes statistical power for two-group comparisons with small samples (Cohen, 1988) and avoids arbitrary tercile or quartile cutoffs, and group differences were tested using Welch's independent-samples t-test. Results demonstrate that deprived municipalities exhibit significantly higher compound environmental vulnerability (EVI: 0.441 vs. 0.327; Δ = +0.114; t = 4.28; p < 0.001; Cohen's d = 1.117), and that this gap is structurally persistent across all five years of analysis (annual p < 0.001). Vegetation cover is the strongest predictor of LST (β =-1.37; p < 0.001; R² = 0.48), while unemployment does not independently predict temperature, suggesting that socioeconomic disadvantage operates primarily through reduced green space rather than through a direct thermal pathway. These findings confirm the existence of a systematic socio-environmental disparity in Attica and provide a reproducible, multisource framework applicable to other Mediterranean urban contexts.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于2019-2024年阿提卡大区59个市镇的多源数据，构建环境脆弱性指数（EVI），发现贫困市镇的环境脆弱性显著高于富裕市镇（EVI: 0.441 vs 0.327），且该差距在五年间持续存在。植被覆盖是地表温度的最强预测因子，社会经济弱势主要通过绿化空间不足间接影响热环境。
AI.research_question: 气候变化对城市居民是否具有空间异质性？阿提卡大区各市镇的环境脆弱性如何分布？社会经济地位与环境脆弱性之间是否存在系统性关联？
AI.motivation: 气候变化对不同城市居民的影响并不均等，但针对地中海城市区域复合环境脆弱性的空间分布及社会经济分层的实证研究相对缺乏，亟需构建可复制的多源数据评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Cutter, Boruff和Shirley (2003)的环境脆弱性方法论框架，构建等权重的复合环境脆弱性指数（EVI），包含地表温度（LST）、归一化植被指数（NDVI）赤字、洪灾风险和失业率四个标准化分量。
AI.method: 1. 数据来源：Landsat 8/9影像提取LST和NDVI；ELSTAT 2021人口普查获取失业率；希腊消防局记录2,514次抽水事件量化洪灾风险。2. 分组方法：以失业率中位数（12.0%）划分“富裕”与“贫困”市镇。3. 统计分析：Welch独立样本t检验组间差异；线性回归分析LST预测因子。
AI.findings: 1. 贫困市镇的EVI显著高于富裕市镇（0.441 vs 0.327，Cohen's d = 1.117，p < 0.001）。2. 该环境脆弱性差距在2019-2024年每年均显著（p < 0.001），具有结构持续性。3. 植被覆盖是LST的最强预测因子（β = -1.37，R² = 0.48），失业率不直接预测温度，表明社会经济劣势通过绿化空间不足间接影响热环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 验证并扩展了Cutter等人（2003）的环境脆弱性框架在地中海城市区域的适用性。2. 揭示了社会经济地位与环境脆弱性之间的系统性关联机制——植被覆盖的中介作用。3. 提供了等权重复合指数在有限样本中进行两组比较的方法学范例（中位数分组策略）。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为阿提卡大区及类似地中海城市的环境政策制定提供了可复制的多源数据评估工具。2. 明确指出绿化投入是缓解热环境不平等的关键杠杆，建议优先在贫困市镇增加植被覆盖。3. 为城市气候适应性规划提供空间靶向干预依据，有助于缩小环境不平等。

title:
Civic Constraint Governance System
Complete Architecture, Diagnostic Methodology, and Applied Assessment
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title:
Civic Constraint Governance System
Complete Architecture, Diagnostic Methodology, and Applied Assessment
detail.abstract:
The Civic Constraint Governance System (CCGS) is a formal framework for governing complex socio-technical-economic systems under four constraint classes: ecological limits, enforcement limits, legitimacy limits, and throughput limits. CCGS constrains rather than directs — it defines what governance may not do rather than prescribing what it must do. Every mechanism exists to prevent a specific failure mode, detect when that mode is approaching, and route the detection to a governance response.
At version 8.62, the framework consists of eight priority-ordered principles, four foundational sections, eleven institutions (eight primary and three meta), eight decay terms, twenty-two stability conditions, thirteen detection mechanisms organized by degradation priority, thirteen residual limits that name what the framework cannot do, a four-type legitimacy stock accounting system, three governance horizons, and a four-resistor Political Economy of Transition model.
Three independent diagnostic frameworks — GLLC-ADA v2 (Governance Legibility-Legitimacy Coupling with Asymmetric Degradation Accounting), GIE (Governance Interdependency Exposure), and CPC (Civic Participation Capacity) — provide empirical measurement systems that the core architecture describes but does not directly implement. These diagnostics constitute the governance health check: a structured assessment methodology that has been applied across seven jurisdictions and five scales, from a single library system to a historical empire.
This integrated preprint unifies, for the first time, the complete model specification, the full development history from original concept through twenty-six version increments, the diagnostic methodology with every quantitative and qualitative metric, six detailed applied assessments, and the verified bibliography of eighty-eight external sources across seventeen intellectual domains. Integration reveals findings that neither document produces independently: the causal loop between theoretical architecture and empirical diagnosis, the common epistemological commitments that govern both the framework’s kill discipline and the diagnostic’s style standards, and the convergence of the framework’s residual limits with the diagnostic’s constitutive limitations into a unified account of what formal governance architecture can and cannot do.
The framework has been applied across seven jurisdictions and scales, from a single library system to a historical empire, and has undergone two external scholar stress tests — the Ostrom Workshop (v8.61) and five independent multi-level governance studies (v8.62) — in addition to multiple synergy briefs against practitioner evidence.
The framework’s deepest unresolved tension is constitutive: CCGS is prescriptive in a domain where fifty years of empirical research demonstrates that emergent governance typically outperforms prescribed governance. The governance health check’s deepest finding is parallel: governance systems do not fail because nobody can see the failure coming; they fail because seeing the failure and acting on the failure are governed by different political economies. Together, these constitute a single finding: formal governance architecture can sharpen detection with increasing precision, but the political conditions for acting on detection are produced by dynamics the architecture cannot govern. Naming that limitation honestly is the project’s most important contribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个名为“公民约束治理系统”（CCGS）的形式化治理框架，用于在生态、执行、合法性和吞吐量四类约束下治理复杂系统。该框架不直接“指挥”治理行为，而是通过设定“禁止项”来防止特定失败模式。配套三个独立诊断工具（GLLC-ADA、GIE、CPC）构成治理健康检查体系，已在7个司法管辖区和5个尺度上应用。核心发现是：形式化治理架构能越来越精确地提升“检测失败”的能力，但“基于检测采取行动”的政治条件却由架构无法控制的内在动力所决定。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种形式化治理架构，使其能够在生态极限、执行极限、合法性极限和吞吐量极限四类约束下有效治理复杂的社会-技术-经济系统？
AI.motivation: 现有治理研究缺乏一个既能形式化描述约束边界、又能与实证诊断相结合的通用框架。50年的经验研究表明，涌现型治理通常优于指令型治理，但现有理论未能解释这一悖论的内在机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: CCGS框架：包含8条优先级排序的原则、4个基础部分、11个制度（8个主要+3个元制度）、8个衰减项、22个稳定性条件、13个按退化优先级排序的检测机制、13个残余限制、4类合法性存量核算系统、3个治理视域、4电阻政治经济转型模型。
AI.method: 综合预印本：整合完整模型规范、26个版本的发展历史、诊断方法论（含定量与定性指标）、6个详细应用评估、88个外部来源的验证文献。三个独立诊断框架（GLLC-ADA v2、GIE、CPC）提供了经验测量系统。
AI.findings: （1）形式化治理架构与实证诊断之间存在因果循环；（2）框架的“终止纪律”与诊断的风格标准具有共同的认识论承诺；（3）框架的残余限制与诊断的本构限制收敛为统一的解释——治理系统失败不是因为看不到失败，而是因为看到失败与基于失败采取行动受不同的政治经济逻辑支配；（4）形式化架构可以精确提升检测能力，但行动的政治条件由架构无法治理的动力产生。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将完整的模型规范、发展历史、诊断方法论与应用评估统一到同一理论体系中；揭示了理论架构与实证诊断之间的因果循环关系；识别了形式化治理架构的本体论矛盾：在涌现型治理优于指令型治理的领域中，该框架本身却是指令性的。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一个可操作的治理健康检查方法论，已在7个司法管辖区和5个尺度（从单一图书馆系统到历史帝国）得到验证；经历了两次外部学者压力测试（Ostrom Workshop v8.61和五项独立的多层次治理研究v8.62）；诚实命名了形式化治理架构的根本局限。

reference: University of Chicago Law Review, Volume 93, Pp, 327-350
title: Living Under Contract: An LPE Analysis of American Democracy
affiliations: Temple University, James E. Beasley School of Law and Rice University

detail.title: Living Under Contract: An LPE Analysis of American Democracy

publicationDetails.detailsText: University of Chicago Law Review, Volume 93, Pp, 327-350

detail.abstract: Is President Donald Trump appealing in part because he has made contracts seem like provisional arrangements likely to endure only insofar as they serve his (or putatively national) interests? Two political economy studies of U.S. workplaces and firms, one ethnographic and one historical, can begin to shed light. Ilana Gershon’s ethnography explores how people’s everyday legal and political consciousness is formed through their experiences of regulatory decision-making in a contract-filled workplace. Sociologist Melinda Cooper’s historical account reveals how a turn to viewing corporations as a conglomeration of individual contracts paved the way for a veneration of autocratic rule. In making this argument, we contribute to this Symposium in two ways. First, we illustrate the value of an insight that has helped organize the field of law and political economy but not law and economics: namely, that people’s legal and political sensibilities are often shaped by their experiences in economic life. Second, we illustrate the value of interpretative social sciences, which has remained marginal in both fields. We argue that qualitative and ethnographic research methods are particularly useful in moments such as the political present in the United States when what can be assumed about political, legal, and class identities and categories is rapidly changing.

AI.tldr: 本文通过Gershon的民族志研究和Cooper的历史研究，探讨了特朗普的吸引力部分源于他将合同视为临时安排的观点。文章论证了人们在经济生活中的经历塑造其法律和政治意识，并强调了定性研究方法在理解快速变化的政治、法律和阶级身份中的价值。
AI.research_question: 特朗普的吸引力是否部分源于他将合同视为仅在其服务于自身（或国家）利益时才可能持续的临时安排？
AI.motivation: 理解当前美国政治现象（特朗普的吸引力）背后的法律与经济认知根源，以及人们法律和政治意识如何形成。
AI.theoretical_framework: 法律与政治经济学视角；人们的经济生活经历塑造其法律和政治意识的理论洞察。
AI.method: 结合民族志研究（Gershon关于工作场所合同与监管决策的田野调查）和历史研究（Cooper关于公司被视为个人合同集合的历史分析）两种定性方法。
AI.findings: 合同被视作临时安排的观点具有政治吸引力；公司作为合同集合的转变催生了对独裁统治的推崇；人们的经济经历深刻影响其法律与政治感受力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将法律与政治经济学领域"经济生活塑造法律政治意识"的洞察引入法律与经济学领域；论证解释性社会科学（定性民族志研究）在理解快速变化的政治、法律和阶级身份中的独特价值。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解特朗普式政治吸引力提供新的分析框架；强调在面对身份和类别快速变化的时代，定性研究方法的重要性。

title: Beyond Dependence: External Structural Coherence and Geoeconomic Vulnerability Evidence from Portugal, Canada, and Australia (2019–2024)

detail.title: Beyond Dependence: External Structural Coherence and Geoeconomic Vulnerability Evidence from Portugal, Canada, and Australia (2019–2024)

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding received.

detail.abstract:
This paper introduces External Structural Coherence (ESC) as a framework for assessing the alignment between foreign direct investment (FDI), trade relationships, and sectoral dependencies within open economies. While existing approaches to economic security typically examine trade concentration or foreign investment exposure in isolation, ESC evaluates how these dimensions interact across geoeconomic blocs.

To operationalise this framework, the paper develops a purpose-built geoeconomic classification of partner countries and introduces the ESC Alignment Score: a composite indicator measuring the consistency between the geographical distribution of inward FDI and merchandise trade flows across geoeconomic blocs. Applied to panel data covering 2019–2024, the analysis examines three open economies — Portugal, Canada, and Australia — selected to represent distinct configurations of external structural coherence. The analysis is conceived as an illustrative application of the ESC framework to three theoretically motivated cases, rather than a statistically representative cross-country study.

The empirical results identify three distinct structural types: regional coherence (Portugal), concentrated coherence (Canada), and structural incoherence (Australia). Across the period analysed, none of the three countries displays a significant shift in structural positioning, consistent with the interpretation that these configurations reflect structural rather than purely temporary patterns. The comparative analysis further suggests that concentration and coherence constitute analytically distinct dimensions of external vulnerability: highly concentrated structures may remain relatively stable when embedded within aligned geoeconomic relationships, whereas structurally misaligned configurations may generate vulnerability even under lower levels of concentration.

By integrating investment, trade, and sectoral exposure within a single analytical framework and providing a quantifiable indicator of structural alignment, the paper contributes to the literature on economic security and geoeconomic fragmentation. The findings suggest that economic resilience may depend less on reducing interdependence itself than on ensuring that external dependencies are structurally coherent, a dimension that existing concentration-based indicators do not capture.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"外部结构一致性"(ESC)框架，通过构建ESC一致性得分指标，评估葡萄牙、加拿大和澳大利亚三个开放经济体的FDI、贸易关系与部门依赖在不同地缘经济集团间的对齐程度，识别出区域一致型（葡萄牙）、集中一致型（加拿大）和结构不一致型（澳大利亚）三种结构类型。
AI.research_question: 如何评估开放经济体在外国直接投资、贸易关系和部门依赖之间跨地缘经济集团的结构一致性？
AI.motivation: 现有经济安全方法通常孤立地考察贸易集中度或外资敞口，忽略了这些维度之间的交互作用及其跨地缘经济集团的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 外部结构一致性（ESC）框架；地缘经济集团分类；ESC一致性得分指标
AI.method: 构建地缘经济分类体系；开发ESC一致性得分复合指标；对2019-2024年面板数据进行三个理论驱动案例的说明性应用分析
AI.findings: 识别出三种结构类型：区域一致型（葡萄牙）、集中一致型（加拿大）和结构不一致型（澳大利亚）；三国在分析期内均未出现显著的结构定位转变；集中度与一致性是外部脆弱性的两个分析上独立的维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 将投资、贸易和部门敞口整合在单一分析框架中；提出结构对齐的可量化指标；揭示经济韧性更依赖于外部依赖的结构一致性而非减少相互依存本身。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济安全和地缘经济碎片化研究提供新的分析工具；为政策制定者评估外部脆弱性提供超越传统集中度指标的新维度。

title: Hope or Hype for Gig Workers: Does the Code on Social Security Deliver the Goods?

detail.title: Hope or Hype for Gig Workers: Does the Code on Social Security Deliver the Goods?
detail.abstract:
The rapid expansion of the gig economy over the past two decades in India has created a pressing need to secure legal recognition and social welfare for gig workers. The Code on Social Security, 2020 (SS Code) marks an important legislative milestone by formally recognising gig workers for the first time within India's social security framework. However, mere recognition alone is inadequate as major structural challenges prevalent in the Code undermine its very purpose, efficacy and success. 

By analysing judicial tests and principles, legal precedents and comparative jurisprudence and applying them in the context of the gig economy, this paper aims to highlight two significant challenges of the SS Code. Firstly, Section 2(35) of the SS Code erroneously classifies gig workers as persons earning from outside a traditional employer-employee relationship despite the fact that gig workers satisfy the established judicial tests of a "worker" under an employment contract. Secondly, the statutory language of Section 114 of the SS Code appears to make the formulation of social security schemes for gig workers discretionary rather than a mandatory legal obligation on the State. 

While the SS Code is a significant step towards addressing the legal invisibility of gig workers, its true success depends on effective and timely implementation. Therefore, a legislative amendment may be the need of the hour to cure the highlighted defects and translate legal recognition into substantial social welfare for gig workers. Ultimately, unless the SS Code's legal recognition of gig workers is matched by concrete and effective social security measures, it runs the risk of remaining more hype than hope.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了印度《2020年社会保障法典》对零工劳动者的法律认可，指出该法典存在两大结构性缺陷：一是将零工劳动者错误地归类为"非传统雇佣关系"工作者，尽管他们符合司法测试中的"工人"标准；二是第114条使社会保障方案制定成为国家自由裁量而非强制义务。文章认为，若不进行立法修正以落实实质性社会保障，该法典的法律认可将流于形式。
AI.research_question: 印度《2020年社会保障法典》在承认零工劳动者方面存在哪些结构性缺陷？这些缺陷如何影响其社会保障目标的实现？
AI.motivation: 印度零工经济在过去二十年间快速扩张，迫切需要为零工劳动者争取法律认可和社会福利。尽管《社会保障法典》首次正式承认零工劳动者，但仅靠承认不足以解决问题，需要深入分析法典中阻碍其效能的结构性挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 司法测试原则（判断"工人"身份的法律标准）、法律先例分析、比较法理学（比较不同司法管辖区的法律处理方式）。
AI.method: 法律文本分析：解读《社会保障法典》第2(35)条和第114条的具体规定；司法测试分析：运用既有的"工人"身份司法判断标准；比较法分析：参照其他司法管辖区的法律实践；法律先例分析：援引相关判例。
AI.findings: 第一，法典第2(35)条将零工劳动者错误归类为"传统雇佣关系之外"的谋生者，但零工劳动者实际上满足既有的"工人"司法测试标准；第二，法典第114条的措辞使社会保障方案的制定成为国家的自由裁量权，而非强制性法律义务，削弱了法律认可的实际效力。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了立法文本分类与司法实践标准之间的脱节问题；阐明了"法律认可"与"实质性社会福利"之间的必要张力，即仅靠法律承认不足以实现社会保障目标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度立法者提供具体的修正方向：重新定义零工劳动者的法律分类，并将社会保障方案制定从自由裁量改为强制义务；对其他国家在零工经济立法中避免类似缺陷具有借鉴意义。

title: The Rule of Law and the States Revisited: The Guarantee Clause After Rucho and Moore
affiliations: University of San Diego School of Law

detail.title: The Rule of Law and the States Revisited: The Guarantee Clause After Rucho and Moore

publicationDetails.detailsText: San Diego Legal Studies Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: University of San Diego Law School Legal Studies Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
For more than a century, the Guarantee Clause has been treated as one of the Constitution’s great dead letters: textually important, historically resonant, but judicially inert. This Essay argues that the Clause should be revived, not as a roving license for federal courts to define republican government in the abstract, but as a rule-of-law guarantee requiring each state to comply with its own constitution and laws. A state that defies its own constitutional order does not merely violate state law. It fails to provide the republican form of government that Article IV guarantees.

The argument revisits a thesis first advanced in 1984: that the Guarantee Clause supplies a federal right to state constitutional compliance. On this view, Congress retains authority to judge the substantive republican adequacy of state constitutional structures, while federal courts may enforce the procedural requirement that states actually follow the constitutional rules they have adopted. The benchmark is state law. The federal right is compliance.

That theory is more urgent and more doctrinally plausible today than it was four decades ago. Shelby County, Rucho, and Brnovich have weakened the Equal Protection Clause and the Voting Rights Act as tools for policing state election abuses. At the same time, Moore v. Harper has recognized that state legislatures remain bound by state constitutions when regulating federal elections, and that federal courts may review whether state actors have exceeded state-constitutional limits. Although Moore relied on the Elections Clause, its structural logic belongs more naturally to the Guarantee Clause, which reaches the entire constitutional order of the states.

The Essay applies this rule-of-law reading to contemporary state-level dysfunction, including gerrymandering in defiance of state constitutional provisions, voting irregularities, abuse of emergency powers, and executive or legislative resistance to state court orders. It also addresses the standard objections to justiciability, including the political question doctrine and recent scholarship treating the Clause as a quasi-diplomatic guarantee enforceable only by Congress. The central claim is modest but consequential: federal courts need not decide what republican government requires in the abstract to determine whether a state is obeying its own constitution. When state officials govern outside the law that gives them authority, they govern by force. The Guarantee Clause exists to prevent that result.

AI.tldr: 本文主张复兴《保障条款》，将其解释为一项法治保障：各州必须遵守本州宪法和法律，否则即违反联邦宪法第四条所保障的共和政体。联邦法院虽不能抽象定义"共和政体"，但可强制执行州法合规程序。
AI.research_question: 《保障条款》能否被解释为一项要求各州遵守本州宪法和法律的法治保障？联邦法院能否在不抽象定义"共和政体"的前提下强制执行这一要求？
AI.motivation: 《保障条款》长期以来被视为"宪法中的死文字"；近年Shelby County、Rucho、Brnovich等判例削弱了平等保护条款和《投票权法》对州选举滥权的约束力，亟需激活《保障条款》这一备用机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1）《保障条款》的"法治保障"解释（rule-of-law guarantee）；2）1984年提出的"联邦政府有权要求州遵守州法"理论复兴；3）Moore v. Harper案的结构逻辑延伸。
AI.method: 宪法文本解释、判例分析（Shelby County, Rucho, Brnovich, Moore v. Harper）、理论论证与反对方反驳。
AI.findings: 当州官员违反本州宪法秩序行事时，其统治即沦为"暴力"而非法律之治；《保障条款》设定了联邦政府（国会判断实体共和充分性，联邦法院执行程序合规）的二元机制；Moore案虽基于选举条款，但其逻辑更自然归属于《保障条款》。
AI.theory_contributions: 将《保障条款》重新概念化为"程序性法治保障"，区别于抽象定义共和政体的实质路径；为联邦法院审查州违宪行为提供新的可诉性理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为应对州级不公选区划分、选举违规、紧急权力滥用、州行政/立法机构抗拒州法院命令等当代问题提供联邦宪法救济路径。

reference: Journal of Law and Politics, Volume 41, No. 2, forthcoming
title: Multi-Party Coalition Governance in Congress

detail.title: Multi-Party Coalition Governance in Congress

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Law and Politics, Volume 41, No. 2, forthcoming

detail.abstract: The adoption of majoritarian methods of elections in American jurisdictions, such as ranked-choice voting and proportional representation, could theoretically enable third-party candidates to succeed in federal elections, including congressional elections. Constitutionally, Congress is required to handle multi-party governance if the electorate sends third parties to it. But mechanically, Congress has constructed itself in conformance with two-party rule. This Note describes how Congress's existing governance system-the institution's sets of rules, framework statutes, parliamentary precedents, and norms-does permit multi-party governance, although it shapes the form it would take. It establishes a typology of three forms of power-sharing arrangements in Congress, based on historical precedent: a "shell majority" composed of minor parties; a rotation of an officer position among parties; and a "nominal party" coalition. This Note explains that in both chambers, existing rules and precedent force a multi-party coalition to cohere into a single "shell majority" faction, and they also allow that coalition to rotate officer roles among its constituent parties within a single session. Next, this Note describes and proposes solutions to novel problems that a multi-partisan Congress would face. Potential delays associated with tabulating ranked-choice ballots could require delayed or contingent internal party leadership elections. Alternatives to the Speaker of the House election would mitigate the risk that delays in coalition negotiation could incapacitate the House.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国国会如何在制度上适应多党制治理。尽管国会现行规则和先例强制多党联盟凝聚为一个"外壳多数"派系，但允许在单一会期内轮换官员职位。文章还提出了解决多党国会面临的新问题的方案，如排序投票计票延迟对党内领导选举的影响，以及众议院议长选举的替代方案。
AI.research_question: 美国国会现有的治理体系（规则、框架法规、议会先例和规范）能否容纳多党治理？如果可能，会以何种形式呈现？
AI.motivation: 排序投票和比例代表制等多数决选举方式在美国司法管辖区的采纳，理论上可能使第三方候选人在联邦选举中胜出，从而产生多党国会。但国会现有制度是围绕两党制构建的，因此需要审视其是否具备容纳多党治理的能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于历史先例的权力分享安排类型学，包括三种形式：由小党组成的"外壳多数"、政党间官员职位轮换、"名义政党"联盟。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，结合历史先例梳理和制度设计提议。通过对国会规则、框架法规、议会先例和规范的文本分析，构建类型学框架，并针对新问题提出解决方案。
AI.findings: 1）国会现行规则和先例强制多党联盟凝聚为单一"外壳多数"派系；2）允许该联盟在单一会期内轮换官员角色；3）排序投票计票延迟可能导致党内领导选举需要延迟或附带条件；4）议长选举的替代方案可降低联盟谈判延迟使众议院瘫痪的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了国会多党权力分享安排的类型学框架（外壳多数、职位轮换、名义政党联盟），丰富了关于国会制度如何适应多党治理的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国国会应对多党制治理提供了具体的制度设计建议，包括应对计票延迟的党内选举方案和议长选举替代方案，对选举改革和国会规则制定具有实践参考价值。

title: The Macro Alibi: Subjective Risk Attribution in Analyst Scenarios
affiliations: University of Notre Dame - Mendoza College of Business and

detail.title: The Macro Alibi: Subjective Risk Attribution in Analyst Scenarios
detail.abstract: Sell-side analysts over-attribute a stock's downside risk to macroeconomic forces, near-unconditionally. We document this Macro Bear Bias in scenario-based valuation reports: bear-case narratives overemphasize aggregate macro risk relative to base- or bull-case narratives, even though realized CAPM R2 is similar across bear, base, and bull outcomes conditional on the same market state. The bear--base macro-attention gap predicts systematic pessimism in subsequent base-case forecasts, and portfolios formed on a nonlinear bias-adjusted signal earn monthly CAPM alphas of up to 1.9%. Mechanism tests favor a cognitive availability-heuristic explanation—analysts anchor downside narratives on salient macro-crisis templates—over a strategic career-concerns explanation. Narrative templates analysts use to rationalize risk can distort analysts' numerical forecasts and asset prices.

AI.tldr: 卖方分析师在情景分析报告中存在“宏观熊市偏差”——在熊市情景中过度归因于宏观经济风险，而牛市/基准情景中则不然。这种偏差源于认知可用性启发式（锚定于宏观危机模板），而非职业担忧。基于此偏差调整的信号能产生高达月1.9%的CAPM alpha。
AI.research_question: 卖方分析师在情景估值报告中是否存在系统性偏差？具体表现为：分析师是否在熊市情景中过度将下行风险归因于宏观经济因素？
AI.motivation: 现有文献发现分析师预测存在各种偏差，但较少关注分析师在情景化叙事（熊市/基准/牛市情景）中归因风险的系统性模式，以及这种叙事偏差如何扭曲数值预测和资产价格。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可用性启发式（availability heuristic）：分析师锚定于突出的宏观危机模板来解释下行风险；职业担忧假说作为竞争性解释。
AI.method: 分析情景估值报告中的叙事文本，比较熊市、基准、牛市情景对宏观经济风险的关注程度；利用CAPM R2检验不同情景下的实际风险暴露是否相似；构建基于偏差调整的信号并检验其预测能力和投资组合收益。
AI.findings: 1) 熊市叙事过度强调宏观风险（“宏观熊市偏差”），而实际CAPM R2在三种情景下相似；2) 熊-基准宏观注意力差距可预测随后的基准预测悲观程度；3) 基于非线性偏差调整信号的多空组合月CAPM alpha达1.9%；4) 机制检验支持可用性启发式解释，而非职业担忧。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了分析师情景化归因中一种新的系统性偏差（宏观熊市偏差），并将其归因于认知启发式（可用性），为行为金融学中分析师偏差的成因提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提醒投资者识别分析师报告中的叙事偏差，避免被过度悲观的宏观归因误导；2) 提供了可操作的偏差调整信号，能产生显著的超额收益；3) 对资产管理、证券研究实践有直接指导意义。

detail.abstract:
Background: Malaria cases in Rwanda resurged markedly after more than a decade of decline under artemisinin-based combination therapy (ACT) deployment. Whether this resurgence reflected the emergence of a novel Plasmodium falciparum lineage or adaptive evolution within preexisting parasite populations has direct implications for resistance surveillance and treatment policy across East Africa.

Methods: We conducted a longitudinal targeted genomic surveillance study of 1,176 P. falciparum isolates collected in Rwanda between October 2021 and December 2025, from urban (Kigali) and high-transmission rural settings. Targeted amplicon sequencing of kelch13, crt, mdr1, dhfr, and dhps resistance loci, together with msp2 and csp polymorphic genomic regions was integrated with principal-coordinate analysis, permutational multivariate analysis of variance, phylogenetic reconstruction, and temporal selection scans. Selected kelch13 variants were further characterized through ex vivo dihydroartemisinic susceptibility assays and in vitro serial-passage competition experiments.

Findings: Parasite populations were genetically continuous across the study period, with no evidence of clonal lineage replacement. Mutations in dhfr and dhps remained near fixation. The combined R561H-K189T kelch13 genotype was associated with significant increase during the post-resurgence period (2024-2025; P=4·91×10⁻⁵), particularly in Kigali, and was enriched across multiple phylogenetic backgrounds, consistent with soft selective processes rather than clonal expansion. Of particular concern, a small cluster of isolates carried validated mutations across all analyzed resistance loci, more likely an alarming emerging threat against malaria control in case of amplification and spread of such multidrug-resistant genomic backgrounds.  Temporal selection scans identified possible directional allele-frequency associated with enrichment at R561H, K189T, and A675V. Preliminary ex vivo assays were associated with higher dihydroartemisinic survival among K13-mutant isolates, and in vitro competition experiments suggest progressive expansion of K189T- and K189N-containing parasites over successive culture passages.

Interpretation: Malaria resurgence in Rwanda occurred through adaptive enrichment of artemisinin-associated genomic backgrounds within a genetically continuous, recombining parasite population, rather than through emergence of a single dominant resistant lineage. These findings suggest that artemisinin adaptation in sub-Saharan Africa follows an incremental, population-wide evolutionary trajectory distinct from the lineage-restricted selective sweeps documented in Southeast Asia, with direct implications for the design of resistance surveillance and treatment-efficacy monitoring programmes across the region. These conclusions are derived from targeted surveillance of major antimalarial resistance loci and polymorphic markers rather than whole-genome analyses.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对2014-2025年卢旺达恶性疟原虫样本的纵向基因组监测，发现疟疾复发并非由单一耐药克隆谱系扩张引起，而是通过青蒿素相关基因组背景在遗传连续、重组的寄生虫群体中逐步适应性富集所致，揭示了东非地区青蒿素适应呈现与东南亚不同的渐进式、群体层面的进化轨迹。
AI.research_question: 卢旺达疟疾病例在ACT药物部署后经历十余年下降又显著反弹，这一反弹究竟反映了新型恶性疟原虫谱系的出现，还是预先存在的寄生虫群体内的适应性进化？
AI.motivation: 明确疟疾复发的进化机制（新谱系入侵 vs. 原有群体适应性进化）对东非地区的耐药性监测和治疗政策制定具有直接影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 群体遗传学理论；抗药性进化理论（软性选择 vs. 克隆扩张/硬性选择）；青蒿素耐药机制（K13突变相关）
AI.method: 纵向靶向基因组监测研究；靶向扩增测序（kelch13、crt、mdr1、dhfr、dhps等耐药位点及msp2、csp多态性区域）；主坐标分析、置换多元方差分析、系统发育重建、时间选择扫描；离体DHA敏感性试验；体外连续传代竞争实验。
AI.findings: 1) 研究期间寄生虫群体遗传连续，无克隆谱系替代证据；2) dhfr和dhps突变接近固定；3) R561H-K189T联合kelch13基因型在反弹后时期（2024-2025）显著增加，尤其在基加利；4) 该基因型分布于多个系统发育背景，符合软性选择过程而非克隆扩张；5) 发现一小群分离株在所有耐药位点均携带经验证突变，构成多重耐药威胁；6) 时间选择扫描识别出R561H、K189T和A675V的方向性等位基因频率富集；7) 离体实验显示K13突变株DHA存活率更高；8) 体外实验表明K189T/K189N寄生虫在连续传代中逐渐扩张。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了撒哈拉以南非洲地区青蒿素适应遵循与东南亚截然不同的进化轨迹——不是谱系限制性选择性清扫（hard selective sweep），而是渐进式、群体范围的软性选择（soft selective sweep），为理解不同地区抗药性进化模式差异提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示东非地区耐药监测应关注多重耐药基因组背景的逐步富集而非仅追踪单一谱系，为设计区域耐药性监测和治疗效果评估计划提供直接依据；识别出多重耐药分离株的潜在威胁，警示需防范其扩增和传播。

title: Modeling Managerial Approaches to Salary Distribution in Sports: Implied Risk Aversion in Resource Allocation

detail.title: Modeling Managerial Approaches to Salary Distribution in Sports: Implied Risk Aversion in Resource Allocation
detail.abstract: In this brief article, we propose and calibrate a model for managerial decision making in salary distribution for sports teams. This structural model mixes managerial bias and risk aversion with market estimation of team outcomes, and proposes a new metric of implied managerial risk-aversion that can be made dynamic to account for changes in pay structure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并校准了一个体育团队薪资分配的经理决策模型，该模型融合了经理偏见、风险规避与市场对团队结果的估计，并提出了一个可动态调整的隐含经理风险规避指标。
AI.research_question: 体育团队中经理如何做出薪资分配决策？经理的偏见和风险规避如何影响薪资结构？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏将经理偏见、风险规避与市场估计相结合的薪资分配决策结构性模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构模型，融合了经理偏见（managerial bias）、风险规避（risk aversion）与市场对团队结果的估计。
AI.method: 提出结构性模型，并进行校准（calibration）。
AI.findings: 提出了一个新的隐含经理风险规避指标，该指标可以动态调整以反映薪资结构的变化。
AI.theory_contributions: 为体育团队薪资分配决策提供了将经理行为偏差与市场估计相结合的结构性建模框架；提出了可动态化的经理风险规避度量指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为体育团队管理层评估和调整薪资分配策略提供了量化工具；有助于理解经理决策偏差对团队绩效和薪资结构的影响。

detail.abstract:
Background: Several lineages of mpox virus associated with sustained human-to-human transmission have recently caused major outbreaks worldwide. Following its emergence in Nigeria in 2017, Clade IIb caused a global outbreak in 2022 that primarily affected high-income countries and was characterised by low mortality and transmission within sexual networks of men who have sex with men. In January 2025, a large outbreak caused by Clade IIb mpox virus was declared in Sierra Leone. Here, we describe the clinical features and outcomes of individuals affected during this outbreak.

Methods: We conducted a secondary analysis of routinely collected outbreak surveillance and clinical data from two mpox referral centers in Freetown, Sierra Leone. Individuals with PCR-confirmed mpox between Jan 10 and Aug 17, 2025 were included.

Findings: Data were available for 1,084 individuals with confirmed mpox, 611 (56.4%) men and 472 (43.5%) women. Most cases were individuals aged 15–30 years (528/1084, 48.7%). HIV infection was present in 153 (14.1%) individuals, of whom 105 (68.6%) were newly diagnosed, and over half had CD4 counts ≤200 cells/μL. Genital lesions were reported in 904 (83.5%). Overall mortality was 3.0% (33/1084). Deaths were strongly concentrated among people living with HIV (29/153, 19.0%) compared with those without HIV (4/931, 0.4%) and occurred mainly in individuals with CD4 counts below ≤200 cells/μL. HIV infection was associated with substantially higher odds of mortality (causal odds ratio 47.96, 95% CI 18.93–155.76).

Interpretation: During the 2025 outbreak in Sierra Leone, Clade IIb mpox appeared to spread predominantly through heterosexual contact and was associated with substantially higher mortality than reported during the 2022 global outbreak. Death occurred mainly among people living with HIV with advanced immunosuppression. Strengthening health systems, integrating mpox prevention and care with HIV services, and expanding targeted vaccination strategies are essential to reduce spreading and mortality in future outbreaks.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2025年塞拉利昂猴痘疫情（Clade IIb）的临床特征和结局，发现该病毒主要通过异性接触传播，总体死亡率为3.0%，其中HIV感染者死亡率高达19.0%，且新诊断HIV患者占68.6%。研究强调将猴痘防控与HIV服务整合的重要性。
AI.research_question: 2025年塞拉利昂Clade IIb猴痘疫情中，感染者的临床特征和结局是什么？HIV感染对死亡率有何影响？
AI.motivation: 2022年全球猴痘疫情主要影响高收入国家男男性行为人群且死亡率低，但2025年塞拉利昂爆发了大规模的Clade IIb疫情，其传播模式和临床严重程度可能与先前不同，需要系统描述其特征。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于疫情监测和临床数据的流行病学分析框架，关注病毒传播模式（异性vs.同性传播）、HIV共感染对疾病严重程度的影响。
AI.method: 对塞拉利昂弗里敦两个猴痘转诊中心2025年1月10日至8月17日期间PCR确诊的1,084例病例的常规监测和临床数据进行二次分析。
AI.findings: 1,084例确诊患者中，56.4%为男性，43.5%为女性；48.7%为15-30岁；14.1%合并HIV感染（其中68.6%为新诊断，超半数CD4≤200 cells/μL）；83.5%出现生殖器病变；总体死亡率3.0%；HIV感染者死亡率19.0% vs.非HIV感染者0.4%；HIV与死亡率显著相关（因果比值比47.96）。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了Clade IIb猴痘在非洲低资源环境下的真实疾病负担，证实了HIV相关免疫抑制是猴痘死亡的核心风险因素，挑战了此前认为Clade IIb仅导致低死亡率的认知。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议加强卫生系统建设，将猴痘预防护理与HIV服务整合，扩大针对性疫苗接种策略，以降低未来爆发中的传播和死亡率。

title: Information Acquisition and Knowledge Transmission in the Age of AI

detail.title: Information Acquisition and Knowledge Transmission in the Age of AI
