detail.abstract: I construct a model of rational inattention to study how artificial intelligence (AI) impacts what information economic agents acquire, and how these choices feed back into AI expertise. I show that AI represents a biased information intermediary whose anisotropic precision about underlying fundamentals is shaped by the history of tasks on which it trains and inflated by fine-tuning. By substituting for learning about fundamentals, AI frees scarce human attention to focus on task-specific learning, hastening the discovery of new tasks that temporarily reduce its usefulness and adoption. I consider implications for AI design and knowledge collapse when AI evaluates humans.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个理性疏忽模型，研究人工智能如何影响经济主体获取信息的选择，以及这些选择如何反馈影响AI的专业知识。AI是一个有偏的信息中介，其各向异性的精确度由训练任务历史决定，并通过微调膨胀。AI替代基础性学习，释放人类注意力用于任务特定学习，加速新任务发现，但新任务暂时降低AI效用和采用率。文章还讨论了AI设计和AI评估人类时的知识崩溃问题。
AI.research_question: 人工智能如何影响经济主体获取信息的选择，以及这些选择如何反馈影响AI自身的专业知识？
AI.motivation: 理解AI作为一种信息中介，其训练历史如何塑造其信息处理的偏向性，以及这种偏向性如何与人类注意力分配相互作用，进而影响经济系统的信息动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 理性疏忽理论（Rational Inattention Theory）
AI.method: 理论建模（构建理性疏忽模型）
AI.findings: 1) AI是一个有偏的信息中介，其各向异性的精确度由训练任务历史塑造；2) AI替代基础性学习，释放人类注意力用于任务特定学习；3) 新任务的发现会暂时降低AI的效用和采用率；4) 当AI评估人类时，可能导致知识崩溃。
AI.theory_contributions: 将理性疏忽理论拓展到AI与人类注意力分配的互动场景，揭示了AI作为信息中介的偏差来源及其反馈机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI设计提供指导，提示关注训练任务历史导致的偏差问题；揭示AI评估人类时可能引发的知识崩溃风险。

title: Childhood Exposure to Institutions and Fertility Preferences: Evidence from Missionary Expansion in Ghana
affiliations: Athens University of Economics and Business

detail.title: Childhood Exposure to Institutions and Fertility Preferences: Evidence from Missionary Expansion in Ghana
detail.abstract: This paper examines whether historical missionary expansion shaped long-run fertility preferences and demographic behavior through childhood exposure to missionary institutions in Ghana. I combine newly geocoded historical data on mission stations and mission schools with georeferenced information from the 2014 Ghana Demographic and Health Survey to construct cohort- and location-specific measures of missionary exposure during formative years. Identification exploits historically structured spatial and temporal variation in missionary diffusion across cohorts and localities and is evaluated using progressively more demanding fixed-effects structures, historical diffusion designs, placebo exposure tests, and rich spatial controls.Women exposed to missionary institutions before age ten report significantly lower ideal family size later in life and attain substantially higher levels of education. The estimated relationship remains stable across a broad range of specifications and is strongest under localized exposure definitions, weakening as exposure measures expand geographically. This pattern is consistent with mechanisms operating through nearby educational, religious, and social environments rather than broad regional development alone. Additional evidence suggests that educational expansion explains an important share of the relationship, although broader institutional and cultural influences persist beyond schooling itself. Although the empirical design remains observational, the findings suggest that historical educational institutions contributed to persistent differences in fertility preferences and family norms through human capital accumulation, institutional persistence, and localized social change.

AI.tldr: 本文利用加纳的历史传教士扩张数据，发现童年时期接触传教机构（尤其是传教士学校）的女性，成年后理想子女数显著减少、教育水平显著提高，表明历史教育机构通过人力资本积累和制度延续塑造了长期的生育偏好。
AI.research_question: 历史传教士扩张如何通过童年接触传教机构影响长期生育偏好和人口行为？
AI.motivation: 理解历史上教育机构的传播（传教士活动）如何塑造当代人口行为，揭示文化制度变迁的长期根源。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本积累理论、制度持续性理论、本地化社会变迁理论
AI.method: 利用新地理编码的历史传教站和传教士学校数据，结合2014年加纳人口健康调查的地理信息，构建队列-地点层面的传教士暴露指标；采用递进式固定效应模型、历史扩散设计、安慰剂暴露检验和丰富空间控制变量进行因果识别。
AI.findings: 10岁前接触传教机构的女性，成年后理想子女数显著更低、教育水平显著更高；效应在本地化暴露定义下最强，随地理范围扩大而减弱；教育扩张解释了重要部分，但制度和文化影响超越学校教育本身。
AI.theory_contributions: 为历史教育机构通过人力资本积累和制度延续塑造长期生育偏好提供了微观实证证据，补充了制度持续性和文化变迁理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示发展政策应关注早期教育基础设施的长期人口效应，历史教育投资可能通过代际传递影响生育观念和家庭规范。

title: Applying Private Credit Structures to West African Real Estate Infrastructure: A Blended Finance Framework

detail.title: Applying Private Credit Structures to West African Real Estate Infrastructure: A Blended Finance Framework

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author completed an internship with Zenzic Capital, a real estate private credit firm, and worked with the Diverse and Emerging Manager Strategy team at the NYC Comptroller's Office. Both experiences informed the practical analysis in this paper. No financial relationships exist that could be perceived as influencing the research conclusions.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This paper involves no human subjects, patient data, or primary data collection. No ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. It was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Africa's infrastructure paradox is structural: over $550 billion in stated investor appetite exists alongside an annual financing gap of $68–$108 billion, yet fewer than 10 percent of infrastructure projects on the continent reach financial close. This paper argues that blended finance, specifically, private credit structures stacked with development finance institution (DFI) concessional capital, provides the mechanism to resolve this paradox in West African real estate infrastructure. Drawing on the Africa Finance Corporation's Takoradi Port transaction as a live proof of concept, this paper presents a four-tranche capital stack framework in which DFI first-loss capital de-risks senior institutional entry, enables syndication, and creates the track record formation necessary for repeatable deployment at scale. The paper further draws on Yimfor, Cassel, and Lerner (2026) to establish that the structural logic of mandate-driven first-mover capital, documented in the context of racial barriers in U.S. private capital fundraising,  applies geographically to African infrastructure markets. Risk analysis addresses currency, political, and counterparty exposure and the structural mitigants available within a well-constructed credit facility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过混合金融（blended finance）机制，特别是将开发性金融机构（DFI）的优惠资本嵌入私人信贷结构，来解决西非房地产基础设施的融资悖论。以非洲金融公司（AFC）的Takoradi港交易为例，文章构建了一个四层资本堆叠框架，论证DFI第一损失资本如何降低风险、促成银团贷款并形成可复制的大规模部署记录。
AI.research_question: 如何利用混合金融中的DFI优惠资本结构，破解西非房地产基础设施领域"超5500亿美元投资者意愿与680-1080亿美元年度融资缺口并存，但不足10%项目完成融资关闭"的结构性悖论？
AI.motivation: 非洲基础设施领域存在巨大的供需错配：投资者意愿充足但项目落地率极低。现有研究未能充分解释如何通过资本结构设计系统性地解决这一悖论，尤其是在西非房地产基础设施这一特定领域。
AI.theoretical_framework: 混合金融理论（blended finance）；资本堆叠框架（four-tranche capital stack）；第一损失资本（first-loss capital）作为风险缓释机制；Yimfor, Cassel, & Lerner (2026)关于"使命驱动型先发资本"（mandate-driven first-mover capital）的结构性逻辑——该逻辑从美国私人资本市场种族壁垒情境推广至非洲基础设施市场的地理应用。
AI.method: 案例研究法：以非洲金融公司（AFC）Takoradi港交易作为实境概念验证（live proof of concept），结合理论推演构建四层资本堆叠框架，并援引Yimfor等人的研究发现进行跨情境理论推广。
AI.findings: DFI第一损失资本能够降低高级机构资本的进入风险，促成银团贷款，并创造形成可重复、大规模部署所需的业绩记录（track record）；源自美国私募市场的"使命驱动型先发资本"逻辑在地理上可推广至非洲基础设施市场；对于货币、政治和交易对手风险，精心构建的信贷设施可提供结构性缓释措施。
AI.theory_contributions: 将Yimfor等人在美国情境下提出的"使命驱动型先发资本"理论拓展至非洲基础设施融资领域，为混合金融机制提供了跨地理情境的理论合法性；提出了具体可操作的四层资本堆叠框架，丰富了混合金融在基础设施领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为开发性金融机构、私人投资者和政策制定者提供了可复制的资本结构设计范式，以解决非洲基础设施融资的结构性障碍；通过Takoradi港案例为后续项目提供了具象化的实践参考和风险缓释路径。

title: The road not taken:How driving distance and appointment availability shape the effects of abortion bans
affiliations: Georgia Institute of Technology, Middlebury College and Georgia Institute of Technology

detail.title: The road not taken:How driving distance and appointment availability shape the effects of abortion bans
detail.abstract: We use difference-in-differences research designs to estimate the effects of abortion bans on births at the county level, leveraging data on changes in driving distance to the nearest facility and appointment availability at facilities in the destination city. We find that the effects of abortion bans operate mainly through distance. In counties where the closest abortion facility was 50 miles away pre-Dobbs, a total ban is estimated to increase births by 1.0–1.2% if distance does not change, but by 2.3%–2.4% if distance rises to 300 miles—corresponding to the increase experienced by the average resident of a ban state. We also find that 6-week gestational age limits are nearly as impactful as total bans, underscoring the substantial burden these regulations impose. Limited appointment availability in destination cities modestly amplifies these effects. We do not observe evidence that the effects of bans on fertility have diminished over time, despite expansions in logistical, financial, and telehealth abortion support, underscoring the persistent role that geographic barriers play in abortion access.

AI.tldr: 利用双重差分法，研究发现堕胎禁令主要通过增加就医距离来提升出生率，完全禁令使距诊所50英里的县出生率增加2.3%-2.4%，6周孕龄限制几乎同样严重，且地理障碍的影响持续存在。
AI.research_question: 堕胎禁令如何通过距离和预约可用性等机制影响县级出生率？
AI.motivation: 美国最高法院推翻罗诉韦德案后，各州堕胎禁令对生育行为的影响备受关注，但现有研究缺乏对具体传导机制的细致分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 医疗服务可及性理论、地理屏障与健康行为理论
AI.method: 使用双重差分法，利用县级层面距离最近堕胎机构的驾驶距离变化及目的地机构预约可用性数据进行估计。
AI.findings: 堕胎禁令主要通过增加距离影响出生率；6周孕龄限制几乎与完全禁令效果相当；目的地预约可用性影响较小；禁令的生育效应未随时间减弱。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了堕胎禁令影响生育行为的具体传导机制，尤其是地理距离的核心作用，丰富了医疗服务可及性理论在政策效应评估中的应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了禁令影响生育率的具体量化估计，强调了地理障碍在堕胎可及性中的持久作用，提示仅依靠远程医疗和财务支持难以完全抵消距离增加的影响。

title: The Accountability Gap: How Representative Democracy Was Designed to Transfer Power, Not Protect the Individual: A Structural Analysis from Locke to the Administrative State, and the SOVEREIGN/NULL Framework as Remedial Instrument

detail.title: The Accountability Gap: How Representative Democracy Was Designed to Transfer Power, Not Protect the Individual: A Structural Analysis from Locke to the Administrative State, and the SOVEREIGN/NULL Framework as Remedial Instrument
detail.abstract: Representative democracy, as theorised and institutionalised in Western political thought from the seventeenth century onward, was designed principally to manage the legitimate transfer and containment of power among competing elites. Continuous, individualised accountability rights for ordinary citizens were not a design feature; they were a structural omission. This paper traces that omission through primary sources-Locke's Second Treatise, the baronial origins of Magna Carta, Montesquieu's separation of powers, and Madison's Federalist arguments-demonstrating that the foundational texts prioritised elite mediation and periodic collective recourse over ongoing personal redress. Drawing on Bernard Manin's magisterial analysis of representative government's aristocratic character, it documents the measurable consequences: delegated authority without continuous review, asymmetric information between citizen and institution, and recourse concentrated exclusively at electoral intervals. These features create predictable vulnerabilities to manipulation, exemplified by the United Kingdom's Post Office Horizon scandal (1999-2015), in which over 900 subpostmasters were prosecuted on the basis of known-faulty software with no named human exercising genuine individual consideration at key decision points. The paper then introduces the SOVEREIGN/NULL binary-certified under UK Certification Mark UK00004343685-as a practical, retrofittable instrument. The test asks a single, auditable question of any institutional decision: did a named, accountable human being apply genuine individual consideration, or was the outcome produced by process, automation, or institutional inertia? Applied continuously rather than periodically, and requiring no professional intermediary, this framework supplies the accountability layer representative systems were never engineered to include. Implications for AI governance under the EU Artificial Intelligence Act (high-risk systems) and administrative justice more broadly are explored. The argument is not that representative democracy should be abandoned, but that its original design deficit must now be corrected if it is to retain legitimacy in an age of algorithmic administration.

AI.tldr: 本文追溯了代议制民主自17世纪以来的结构性缺陷——缺乏对普通公民的持续、个体化问责权，并以英国邮局Horizon丑闻为例说明这一设计缺陷导致的可操纵性。论文提出SOVEREIGN/NULL二元测试（英国认证商标）作为一种可追溯的问责工具，要求每个机构决策都必须有具名、可问责的人类行使真正的个体化考量，从而弥补代议制民主从未设计的问责层。
AI.research_question: 代议制民主是否存在固有的问责设计缺陷？如何通过可操作的工具弥补这一缺陷？
AI.motivation: 代议制民主在算法行政时代面临合法性危机，其原始设计侧重于精英中介和周期性集体追索，未为普通公民提供持续的个体化问责权利，导致系统性地易受操纵。
AI.theoretical_framework: Bernard Manin关于代议制政府贵族性质的分析；洛克《政府论》、大宪章男爵起源、孟德斯鸠分权论、麦迪逊联邦党人文集中的代议制理论。
AI.method: 通过对洛克、大宪章、孟德斯鸠、麦迪逊等原始文献的文本分析，结合英国邮局Horizon丑闻（1999-2015）的案例研究，以及SOVEREIGN/NULL二元测试的概念设计与应用分析。
AI.findings: 代议制民主的基础文本优先考虑精英中介和周期性集体追索，而非持续的个人救济；这导致了授权无持续审查、信息不对称、救济仅集中于选举间隔等可测量后果；这些特征创造了可预测的操纵脆弱性；SOVEREIGN/NULL二元测试可作为弥补这一设计缺陷的实用工具。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了代议制民主自诞生起就存在的结构性问责缺失，将Manin关于代议制政府贵族性质的分析与当代算法治理问题相衔接，为理解行政合法性在算法时代面临的挑战提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出SOVEREIGN/NULL二元测试作为可追溯、无需专业中介的问责工具，可用于AI治理（特别是欧盟AI法案的高风险系统）和行政司法的实践改进。

title: Refundable Tax Credit Design: Cohabitating Parents and Gender Presumptions
affiliations: Washington and Lee University - School of Law

detail.title: Refundable Tax Credit Design: Cohabitating Parents and Gender Presumptions

publicationDetails.detailsText: Pittsburgh Tax Review, volume 23, issue 1, 2026[10.5195/taxreview.2025.281]

detail.abstract:
The Child Tax Credit (CTC) is a partially refundable tax credit designed to provide financial support to families, in recognition that parents face an increased financial burden as the size of the family grows. Enacted in 1997, and expanded in scope over time, the credit reaches the population of parents who are eligible for the Earned Income Tax Credit  but also reaches taxpayers at significantly higher income levels. As part of the economic response to the COVID-19 pandemic, the American Rescue Plan of 2021 temporarily expanded the CTC in several significant respects, including to provide taxpayers the option to receive a portion of the credit as a monthly advance option. Using 2021 as an inspiration and a data point, policymakers and scholars continue to propose changes to the CTC that will better support working families.

In the spirit of conversations about improving the CTC, this Essay explores the demographic trends of American households, in particular, households headed by unmarried cohabitating parents. It imagines how Congress might reconsider the CTC design to deliver benefits more effectively to American families. Using a gender lens and drawing inspiration from a similar benefit in Canada, the Essay considers whether Congress should favor the primary caregiver or provide an option to split the credit between the two parents. Allowing such options can further the goal of combating childhood poverty while also economically empowering unmarried parents.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨美国儿童税收抵免（CTC）的政策改革，建议借鉴加拿大经验，考虑将税收抵免分配给主要照顾者或允许父母平分，以更好地支持非婚同居家庭，实现减贫和经济赋权目标。
AI.research_question: 如何重新设计儿童税收抵免（CTC），使其更有效地覆盖美国非婚同居父母家庭，并通过性别视角优化福利分配？
AI.motivation: COVID-19期间CTC的临时扩展示范了其政策潜力，但美国非婚同居家庭数量持续增长，现有CTC设计可能未能有效惠及这类家庭。需探索改革方向以更好支持工薪家庭。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别视角（gender lens）；儿童税收抵免政策设计；比较政策分析（借鉴加拿大类似福利制度）。
AI.method: 规范分析（Essay）：基于美国人口趋势数据，结合加拿大政策经验，进行制度比较与政策设计推演。
AI.findings: 建议国会考虑两种改革路径：1）将CTC定向分配给主要照顾者；2）允许父母双方选择平分抵免额度。这两种方案有助于实现减贫与经济赋权的双重目标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将性别分析框架引入家庭财税政策讨论，拓展了CTC研究的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国国会改革CTC提供具体政策选项（主要照顾者定向分配或平分选项），参考加拿大经验提出可操作方案。

title: Multivariate Relevance-Based Prediction

detail.title: Multivariate Relevance-Based Prediction
detail.abstract: We extend the relevance-based prediction framework of Czasonis, Kritzman, and Turkington from pointwise forecasts to the joint prediction of multivariate observation vectors. By constructing state-conditional relevance weights based on the Mahalanobis distance of predictor variables, we derive a unified forecast for expected observations and the covariance matrix that is coherent with the empirical joint distribution of the most historically analogous regimes. This paper develops the foundational methodology: relevance kernel, state-conditional expectation and covariance, shrinkage estimation, and the introduction of the Effective Predictor Size (EPS) statistic-the effective sample size of the relevance-weighted historical sample-to measure forecast reliability and drive shrinkage. We discuss applications in portfolio construction and risk management.

AI.tldr: 本文将基于相关性的预测框架从点预测扩展到多元观测向量的联合预测，通过马氏距离构建状态条件相关性权重，推导出与历史相似状态联合分布一致的期望和协方差矩阵统一预测，并提出了有效预测规模（EPS）统计量来衡量预测可靠性。
AI.research_question: 如何将基于相关性的点预测框架扩展为能够同时预测多元观测向量的期望和协方差矩阵的联合预测方法？
AI.motivation: 已有的相关性预测框架仅能进行点预测，无法捕捉变量之间的联合分布特征，而投资组合构建和风险管理等领域需要同时对期望和协方差矩阵进行一致性的联合预测。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于相关性的预测框架、马氏距离、状态条件相关性权重、收缩估计、有效预测规模（EPS）统计量
AI.method: 本文开发了包括相关性核函数、状态条件期望与协方差、收缩估计以及EPS统计量的基础方法论，通过马氏距离构建状态条件权重，推导与经验联合分布一致的预测。
AI.findings: 提出了能够同时预测期望和协方差矩阵的统一框架，引入了EPS统计量作为相关性加权历史样本的有效样本量，用于衡量预测可靠性并驱动收缩估计。
AI.theory_contributions: 将相关性预测框架从点预测扩展至多元联合预测，并引入EPS统计量为预测可靠性提供量化指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 该框架可直接应用于投资组合构建和风险管理，为资产配置、风险预测等实践提供更一致和可靠的联合预测工具。

title: Algorithms of Hostility: Platform Accountability and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights in China's Sports Fanquan Culture

detail.title: Algorithms of Hostility: Platform Accountability and the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights in China's Sports Fanquan Culture
detail.abstract: This paper investigates the intersection of corporate human rights obligations and digital sports culture by examining the systemic cyberbullying of Chinese Olympic diver Quan Hongchan. It critiques the migration of fanquan (饭圈; organized fan circles) dynamics from commercial entertainment industries directly into state-sponsored athletics. While platform operators characterize mass online harassment as organic user deviance, this study utilizes Pillar II of the United Nations Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights to argue otherwise. The architectural design of prominent social media platforms like Sina Weibo and Douyin inherently financializes online hostility. Their engagement-driven recommendation matrices and hot-search algorithms actively amplify targeted vitriol to maximize advertisement revenue. By structurally prioritizing monetization over safety, these corporations fail their international human rights due diligence duties. This failure directly infringes upon individual protections regarding privacy, honor, and dignity guaranteed under Article 17 of the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights.

AI.tldr: 本文以中国跳水运动员全红婵遭受系统性网络欺凌为案例，批判饭圈文化从商业娱乐向国家体育的蔓延，论证社交媒体平台（如微博、抖音）基于商业利益的算法设计本质上是将网络敌意金融化，违反了《联合国工商业与人权指导原则》中的企业人权尽责义务，侵犯了《公民权利和政治权利国际公约》第17条所保障的个人隐私、荣誉和尊严权。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体平台在数字体育文化中的算法设计如何系统性地金融化网络敌意，并由此违反企业人权义务？
AI.motivation: 揭示平台企业以"用户自发行为"为由逃避责任的现实，指出饭圈文化从商业娱乐向国家资助体育的迁移所带来的人权风险，填补数字体育文化与商业企业人权责任交叉领域的研究空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《联合国工商业与人权指导原则》支柱二（企业人权尽责义务）；《公民权利和政治权利国际公约》第17条（隐私、荣誉和尊严权）
AI.method: 案例分析法——以全红婵遭受的系统性网络欺凌为典型案例，结合平台算法设计机制（参与驱动推荐矩阵、热搜算法）进行制度性批判。
AI.findings: 1. 社交媒体平台的算法架构（如参与驱动推荐、热搜机制）本质上将网络敌意金融化，以实现广告收入最大化；2. 平台将系统性欺凌定性为"用户自发越轨行为"，逃避企业人权尽责义务；3. 这种设计侵犯了《公民权利和政治权利国际公约》第17条所保障的个人隐私、荣誉和尊严权。
AI.theory_contributions: 将《联合国工商业与人权指导原则》应用于数字体育文化与平台算法设计的交叉领域，拓展了企业人权尽责义务在数字空间中的解释边界。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供平台算法设计违反国际人权标准的分析框架，督促社交媒体企业重新审视推荐系统与热搜机制的社会责任。

title: Adaptive Divergence Index

detail.title: Adaptive Divergence Index
detail.abstract: We introduce the Adaptive Divergence Index (ADI), a new risk monitoring tool that extends the Divergence Index of Kinlaw, Kritzman, and Turkington. The ADI combines the multivariate relevance-based prediction framework with the concept of statistical divergence to produce a single, regime-aware scalar that measures how far a set of asset returns has departed from the joint distribution implied by the current economic state. Because this distribution adapts automatically to the prevailing macro environment, we call the measure an adaptive divergence index. We describe the full methodological construction, detail its reliance on multivariate relevance-based prediction for the state-dependent reference distribution, and discuss the computation of the index in both portfolio-weighted and full Mahalanobis forms. A stylized numerical example with explicit calculations illustrates the mechanics, and we highlight the significant advantages over traditional, unconditional approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应发散指数（ADI），这是一种新的风险监控工具，它扩展了Kinlaw、Kritzman和Turkington的发散指数。ADI将基于多变量相关性的预测框架与统计发散概念相结合，生成一个单一、状态感知的标量，用于衡量一组资产收益偏离当前经济状态隐含的联合分布的程度。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个能够自适应宏观经济环境变化、衡量资产收益偏离程度的风险监控指标？
AI.motivation: 传统的无条件发散指数忽略了经济状态的动态变化，无法区分"正常"的资产波动与"异常"的风险信号。需要一种能够根据当前宏观经济环境自动调整参考分布的风险度量工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 统计发散理论、多变量相关性预测框架、状态依赖的联合分布建模
AI.method: ADI的构建方法包括：基于多变量相关性的预测框架构建状态依赖的参考分布；计算组合加权形式和全马氏距离形式的发散指数；通过数值示例展示具体计算过程。
AI.findings: ADI相比传统无条件方法具有显著优势，能够更准确地识别在不同经济状态下的异常市场行为，提供更及时、更精准的风险预警信号。
AI.theory_contributions: 将统计发散概念与宏观状态依赖的参考分布相结合，拓展了发散指数理论框架，使其从静态无条件度量升级为动态自适应度量。
AI.practical_contributions: 为风险管理者和投资者提供了一种更有效的风险监控工具，能够根据当前宏观经济环境自动调整，识别系统性风险的早期信号。

reference: Journal of Business Thought, Volume 4, Pp. 68-80
title: Mutual Fund Portfolios Successive Return Performance on Basis of Downside Risk Measures: An Empirical Study of Selected Equity Diversified Mutual Funds
affiliations: Punjab Agricultural University and Punjab Agricultural University

detail.title: Mutual Fund Portfolios Successive Return Performance on Basis of Downside Risk Measures: An Empirical Study of Selected Equity Diversified Mutual Funds

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Business Thought, Volume 4, Pp. 68-80

detail.abstract: The present study attempts to evaluate downside risk measures for the equity diversified mutual funds. The study randomly selected twelve equity diversified mutual funds and evaluated various downside risk measures namely Semi-Standard Deviation, Sortino Ratio, Upside Potential Ratio, Volatility Skewness and Hurst Index. An attempt is made to further create four portfolios of three mutual fund schemes, each on the basis of the results of downside risk measures. These portfolios are created for two years and are assessed on their average monthly return performance in order to assess the predictability of downside risk measures. None of the portfolios are found to be significantly different from each other, thereby, undermining the importance of downside risk measure as a predictable tool for mutual fund performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了股票型多元化共同基金的下行风险度量指标，并据此构建投资组合检验其预测能力，结果发现这些指标无法显著预测基金未来表现。
AI.research_question: 下行风险度量指标能否有效预测股票型多元化共同基金的未来业绩表现？
AI.motivation: 尽管下行风险度量在理论上优于传统风险度量，但其对基金未来业绩的实际预测能力尚不明确，需要实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 下行风险理论、投资组合理论、风险调整绩效评估理论
AI.method: 随机选取12只股票型多元化共同基金，计算半标准差、Sortino比率、上行潜力比率、波动偏度和Hurst指数5种下行风险指标；基于这些指标构建4个投资组合（各含3只基金），持有2年后比较各组合的平均月收益率差异。
AI.findings: 所有投资组合的平均月收益率之间无显著差异，表明下行风险度量指标无法有效预测共同基金的未来业绩。
AI.theory_contributions: 对下行风险度量指标的预测有效性提出了质疑，挑战了其作为投资筛选工具的实用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒投资者和基金经理不应过度依赖下行风险指标进行基金选择，需结合其他因素综合判断。

title: Migration, Tariffs, and China's Export Surge
affiliations: National University of Singapore and

detail.title: Migration, Tariffs, and China's Export Surge

declarations.funderStatement: We acknowledge the generous research support received from the National University of Singapore and the National Natural Science Foundation of China (72203012)

detail.abstract: We build a multi-sector spatial general equilibrium model that features heterogeneous firms' and workers' location choices to account for China's export surge between 1990 and 2005 using three policy changes: China's import tariffs, tariffs imposed against China's exports, and barriers to internal migration in China. We find that tariff and migration policies jointly accounted for 30% of China's export growth. We also find evidence that suggests a positive interaction effect of tariff and migration policies. As migration reform prepared the country to become more export oriented, China enjoyed faster export growth after opening to trade than it would have otherwise.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个多部门空间一般均衡模型，分析1990-2005年间中国关税、外部关税和内部迁移壁垒三大政策变化如何共同推动出口激增，发现关税与迁移政策共同解释了30%的出口增长，且两者存在正向交互效应——迁移改革使中国在贸易开放后获得了比原本更快的出口增速。
AI.research_question: 1990-2005年间，中国的进口关税削减、外部对华出口关税变化以及内部迁移壁垒降低，这三类政策如何共同影响中国的出口增长？
AI.motivation: 中国在这一时期经历了前所未有的出口激增，同时伴随着多重政策改革（贸易自由化与内部迁移改革）。现有文献多单独研究贸易政策或迁移政策的影响，缺乏对两者交互作用的系统分析，尤其缺乏能同时刻画异质性企业和工人区位选择的理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多部门空间一般均衡模型，纳入异质性企业（生产率差异）和异质性工人（技能差异）的区位选择决策，将贸易政策（关税）与内部迁移政策（迁移壁垒）内生于统一框架中。
AI.method: 构建结构性的多部门空间一般均衡模型，结合1990-2005年中国的政策变化数据进行定量模拟与反事实分析。
AI.findings: 1) 关税政策和迁移政策共同解释了约30%的中国出口增长；2) 关税与迁移政策之间存在正向交互效应；3) 迁移改革使中国在贸易开放后获得了比没有迁移改革时更快的出口增长速度。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在统一的多部门空间一般均衡框架中同时考察贸易政策与内部迁移政策对出口的交互影响，揭示了迁移壁垒降低与贸易开放之间的互补性机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家政策制定者提供启示：内部劳动力市场改革（降低迁移壁垒）与贸易自由化协同推进，能够产生比单一政策更大的出口促进效果。

title: Constitutionality of Henry VIII Clauses in Fiscal Legislation: A Study Under the Ministry of Finance and the Doctrine of Separation of Powers
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Constitutionality of Henry VIII Clauses in Fiscal Legislation: A Study Under the Ministry of Finance and the Doctrine of Separation of Powers

contentType.other: Submitted to my college course faculty; Not published in any publications

detail.abstract:
This paper examines the constitutional validity of Henry VIII clauses in Indian fiscal legislation, analysing their tension with the doctrine of separation of powers. Henry VIII clauses, which empower the executive to amend or repeal primary legislation through subordinate means, appear in Indian tax statutes principally as "removal of difficulties" provisions and broad notification powers — most notably under Section 119 of the Income-tax Act, 1961, Section 172 of the CGST Act, 2017, and Section 25 of the Customs Act, 1962.

While the Indian Constitution does not adopt a strict separation of powers, the Supreme Court in Kesavananda Bharati confirmed it as part of the basic structure, and in Ram Jawaya Kapur distinguished permissible functional overlap from unconstitutional usurpation of legislative power. Drawing on the doctrine against excessive delegation established in In re Delhi Laws Act and the policy guidance requirement from Harishankar Bagla, this paper argues that broad Henry VIII clauses risk crossing from permissible delegation into legislative abdication, undermining Articles 245 and 265 of the Constitution.

The paper critically evaluates the Indian judiciary's response, finding it pragmatic but doctrinally insufficient — lacking a dedicated framework to address the distinct threat posed by provisions that allow the executive to amend the very legislation conferring its power. Comparative analysis of the UK's parliamentary committee scrutiny and the evolving US non-delegation doctrine highlights the inadequacy of India's reliance on judicial review alone. The paper concludes with recommendations for legislative standardisation, sunset clauses, specialised parliamentary oversight, and judicial doctrinal development to restore the constitutional balance between administrative efficiency and separation of powers.

AI.tldr: 本文分析印度财政立法中亨利八世条款的合宪性问题，指出这些允许行政权修改或废除主要立法的条款，因缺乏有效审查机制，可能构成对权力分立原则的违宪侵犯，并提出立法标准化、日落条款等改革建议。
AI.research_question: 印度财政立法中的亨利八世条款是否违反宪法规定的权力分立原则？现行司法审查框架是否足以应对这一宪法威胁？
AI.motivation: 亨利八世条款在印度税法的广泛应用（如《所得税法》第119条、《CGST法》第172条）引发了关于行政权过度扩张的宪法担忧，但印度司法体系对此缺乏专门的分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 权力分立原则（Kesavananda Bharati案确认为基本结构）、禁止过度授权原则（In re Delhi Laws Act案）、政策指引要求（Harishankar Bagla案）、宪法第245条与第265条。
AI.method: doctrinal legal analysis（教义性法律分析），结合印度宪法判例梳理、英国议会委员会审查机制与美国非授权原则的横向比较分析。
AI.findings: 印度司法对亨利八世条款的回应虽务实但缺乏教义充分性；印度依赖司法审查单一机制相对于英国的议会审查和美国的非授权原则发展显得不足；现行框架难以区分可允许的授权与违宪的立法放弃。
AI.theory_contributions: 系统性地将亨利八世条款置于印度宪法权力分立框架下分析，指出其对基本结构的潜在威胁，为印度宪法教义发展提供理论指引。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出四项具体改革建议：立法标准化、日落条款、专门的议会监督委员会、司法教义发展，以恢复行政效率与权力分立之间的宪法平衡。

title: Asymptotically Real-time Detection of Structural Instabilities in Matrix-valued Factor Models
affiliations: Capital University of Economics and Business - International School of Economics and Management and Capital University of Economics and Business - International School of Economics and Management

detail.title: Asymptotically Real-time Detection of Structural Instabilities in Matrix-valued Factor Models
detail.abstract: This paper develops an online monitoring procedure to detect structural instabilities in high-dimensional matrix-valued factor models. Comparing the factor structure from an initial training period with that from a rolling monitoring period, we propose three complementary statistics based on: (i) the principal angles between the estimated loading subspaces, (ii) the discrepancies in the estimated common components, and (iii) the changes in the number of spiked eigenvalues. Using Gaussian randomization, we construct a test martingale that ensures familywise Type-I error control over any prespecified monitoring horizon. The procedure detects a wide range of instabilities with probability approaching one and asymptotically negligible detection delay.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对高维矩阵因子模型的结构不稳定性在线监测程序，通过三种互补统计量和基于高斯随机化的检验鞅，实现了对因子结构变化的有效检测。
AI.research_question: 如何在高维矩阵因子模型中在线检测因子结构的结构性不稳定性？
AI.motivation: 高维矩阵因子模型广泛用于宏观经济和金融数据分析，但现有方法缺乏对因子结构在线变化的有效监测工具，需要在控制错误率的同时及时检测结构突变。
AI.theoretical_framework: 矩阵因子模型、主角度分析、共同成分分解、尖特征值理论、鞅检验。
AI.method: 提出三种互补统计量：(i)估计载荷子空间之间的主角度；(ii)估计共同成分的差异；(iii)尖特征值数量的变化。结合高斯随机化构建检验鞅，实现对监测时段内的族系I类错误率控制。
AI.findings: 该方法能够以趋近于1的概率检测到广泛类型的不稳定性，且检测延迟渐近可忽略不计。
AI.theory_contributions: 为高维矩阵因子模型的结构不稳定性在线检测提供了严格的理论框架，证明了检测概率和检测延迟的渐近性质。
AI.practical_contributions: 为宏观经济和金融领域提供了可实时监测因子结构变化的实用工具，有助于及时发现市场结构突变或制度转换。

title: Pension Reforms and the Lengthening of Working Life: An Analysis of Life-Cycle Exploitation in Italy
affiliations: and

detail.title: Pension Reforms and the Lengthening of Working Life: An Analysis of Life-Cycle Exploitation in Italy
detail.abstract: This paper extends Marx's analysis of the exploitation of labour from the working day to the entire working life cycle. It argues that pension reforms in advanced capitalist countries-as long as they extend working careers at a pace exceeding the increase in life expectancy-constitutes a distinctive modality of extracting unpaid labour throughout the life cycle, thereby appropriating what Marx termed absolute surplus value. We develop a theoretical model that formalizes the lifetime rate of exploitation as a function of policy and distributive determinants: the duration of working life and the duration of retirement, on the one hand; the life-cycle reproduction costs of active and retired workers, and the average annual working hours, on the other. The model shows that the lengthening of the working life and the compression of retirement intensify exploitation through the expansion of surplus labour years. The magnitude of this intensification, however, is mediated by variations in the reproduction costs of active and retired workers over time. To assess this interaction empirically, we introduce two decomposition methods: one that isolates the policy and distributive contributions to the life-cycle mass of surplus labour, and a second that quantifies the separate contribution of each structural determinant to the rate of intertemporal exploitation. The model is then tested against statistical evidence from Italy, where pension reforms have substantially raised the retirement age since the early 1990s onwards. The results indicate that the political manipulation of the work-retirement ratio has become an important engine of exploitation in recent decades. In light of these findings, this study aims to provide the theoretical and methodological tools necessary for a critical reassessment of pension reforms-policies often enacted in the name of workers' own interests.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展了马克思的剥削理论，将分析从工作日延伸到整个生命周期，认为发达资本主义国家的养老金改革通过延长工作生涯、压缩退休时间，构成了一种提取绝对剩余价值的新机制。基于意大利数据的实证分析表明，工作-退休比率的政治操控已成为近几十年剥削的重要驱动力。
AI.research_question: 养老金改革如何通过延长工作生涯、压缩退休时间，构成资本主义制度下对劳动者全生命周期的剥削新机制？
AI.motivation: 马克思的剥削理论传统上聚焦于工作日的延长，但缺乏对生命周期维度（工作/退休时间分配）的系统分析。养老金改革常以"工人利益"为名推进，需要从马克思主义视角进行批判性重新审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马克思的剩余价值理论（绝对剩余价值）、生命周期剥削率模型，将工作年限与退休年限的结构性分配纳入剥削分析框架。
AI.method: 理论建模：构建生命周期剥削率的形式化模型，包含政策维度（工作年限、退休年限）和分配维度（劳动者生命周期再生产成本、年均劳动工时）。实证分析：采用两种分解方法，基于意大利1990年代以来养老金改革的统计数据进行检验。
AI.findings: 延长工作生涯、压缩退休时间会通过扩大剩余劳动年限来加剧剥削；这种加剧程度受在职与退休劳动者再生产成本差异的中介调节；意大利养老金改革显著提高了工作-退休比率，成为近几十年剥削加剧的重要驱动力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将马克思剥削理论从工作日分析扩展到生命周期分析，提出"生命周期绝对剩余价值"概念；构建了形式化的生命周期剥削率模型；提供了两种分解方法用于量化政策与分配因素对剥削的贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 为批判性评估养老金改革提供了理论和分析工具；揭示了以"工人利益"为名推行的延迟退休政策实际上构成了生命周期维度的剥削强化机制。

title: Estimating the Natural Rate of Interest for a High-Inflation Country
affiliations: Sabanci University

detail.title: Estimating the Natural Rate of Interest for a High-Inflation Country
detail.abstract: This paper estimates Turkey's natural rate of interest, R-star , in a high-inflation emerging-market setting where regime shifts and large real-rate swings make simple filters difficult to interpret. I compare the standard New York Fed structural estimators-the Laubach-Williams and Holston-Laubach-Williams state-space models, adapted to an open economy-against a set of reduced-form and external-anchor benchmarks. Three findings stand out. First, the structural state-space estimates are remarkably clustered despite Turkey's volatile sample, averaging roughly 5 to 6.5 percent over 2005-2025. Second, reduced-form and external-anchor benchmarks are useful diagnostics but less reliable as standalone R-star estimates in this setting, because they inherit the volatility of recent real rates, exchange rates, and risk premia. Third, movements in the headline estimate are driven mainly by trend growth rather than by the nongrowth component. The broader lesson is methodological: in a high-inflation, crisis-prone economy the canonical state-space methods are most useful when crisis and policy-regime periods are treated as high-variance observations, so that the natural rate is best reported as a model-dependent range rather than a single precise point.

AI.tldr: 本文在土耳其高通胀新兴市场背景下，估计其自然利率（R-star），发现结构性状态空间模型估计值集中在5–6.5%，且主要由趋势增长驱动；同时建议将危机和政策制度期视为高方差观测值，并以模型依赖的区间而非单一精确点报告自然利率。
AI.research_question: 在高通胀、危机频发的新兴市场（以土耳其为例）中，如何可靠地估计自然利率（R-star）？
AI.motivation: 土耳其等新兴市场面临高通胀、制度变迁和实际利率大幅波动，传统的简单滤波方法难以解释，需要评估结构性估计方法在这种环境下的适用性和局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Laubach-Williams和Holston-Laubach-Williams状态空间模型（开放经济改编版）；简化形式基准模型；外部锚定基准模型。
AI.method: 对比标准纽约联储结构性估计量（LW和HLW状态空间模型，适配开放经济）与一组简化形式及外部锚定基准模型，对土耳其2005–2025年数据进行分析。
AI.findings: 1. 结构性状态空间估计值高度集中，平均约5–6.5%；2. 简化形式和外部锚定基准因继承实际利率、汇率和风险溢价的波动性而不可靠；3. 自然利率变动主要由趋势增长驱动，而非非增长成分。
AI.theory_contributions: 方法论贡献：在高通胀、危机频发的经济体中，应将危机和政策制度期视为高方差观测值处理，自然利率应以模型依赖的区间而非单一精确点报告。
AI.practical_contributions: 为新兴市场央行和政策制定者提供了在极端波动环境下估算自然利率的实用框架和警示，避免过度依赖单一精确估计值。

title: Fragmented Protection: Distributed Institutional Failure in Domestic Violence Governance
affiliations: Bangladesh Judicial Service. Ministry of Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs,  Dhaka-1205, Dhaka, Bangladesh - Law Commission of Bangladesh

detail.title: Fragmented Protection: Distributed Institutional Failure in Domestic Violence Governance

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This is a conceptual paper. No human participants, patient data, or case studies requiring ethics approval or written consent were involved.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for this research.

detail.abstract: Domestic and family violence (DFV) services in Australia and many other jurisdictions operate within a fragmented, multi-agency institutional landscape. Police, courts, child protection, health services, housing, and specialist DFV organisations often work in silos. This paper introduces the concept of distributed institutional failurea condition where each agency may appear procedurally compliant within its own mandate, yet the system as a whole fails survivors because no single entity sees the whole picture, shares information reliably, or bears responsibility for coordinated care. Unlike singular failures (e.g., a corrupt officer, an underfunded court), distributed institutional failure is systemic and emerges from the interaction of otherwise legitimate institutional processes. The paper argues that institutional harm can emerge from the routine interaction of procedurally compliant agencies, shifting accountability from individual actors to the relational architecture of governance itself. The paper grounds the concept in institutional theory, feminist institutionalism, governance scholarship on the 'problem of many hands', and network governance literature. It distinguishes distributed institutional failure from related ideas such as fragmentation, coordination gaps, and singular institutional failure, and provides clear operational indicators for empirical identification. It outlines how the concept can be operationalised using institutional ethnography and survivor-centred 2 methods, and discusses implications for policy and practiceincluding integrated case management, cross-sector training, and shared accountability mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"分布式制度失败"概念，描述在碎片化的多机构治理环境中，各机构各自遵循程序却整体上无法有效服务家庭暴力幸存者的系统性困境，将责任从个体行为者转移到治理的关系性架构本身。
AI.research_question: 在碎片化的多机构治理环境中，家庭暴力服务系统为何会出现各机构程序合规但整体失效的现象？这种系统性失败的机制、特征及其责任归属如何理解？
AI.motivation: 现有文献对家庭暴力服务碎片化、协调不足等问题已有讨论，但缺乏一个能够捕捉"各机构各自合规但系统整体失败"这一独特现象的理论概念。作者希望填补这一理论空白，并为实证识别和政策干预提供可操作的分析工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度理论、女性主义制度主义、关于"多手问题"的治理文献、网络治理文献。
AI.method: 概念建构与理论分析；提出可通过制度民族志和以幸存者为中心的方法进行实证操作化。
AI.findings: 分布式制度失败是一种系统性、涌现性的失败，源自各机构看似合法程序的常规互动；它区别于碎片化、协调缺口和单一制度失败等概念；文章提供了可操作的经验识别指标。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 提出"分布式制度失败"新概念，丰富了制度理论和治理文献对系统性失败的讨论；(2) 将责任从个体行为者转向治理的关系性架构，拓展了对制度性伤害的理解；(3) 与碎片化、协调缺口等既有概念做出明确区分，提供了更精准的分析范畴。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为政策制定者和实务工作者识别家庭暴力服务系统中的系统性失败提供操作性指标；(2) 对推进整合性个案管理、跨部门培训、共享问责机制等实践具有直接指导意义；(3) 倡导从个体问责转向治理架构问责，为服务系统改革提供新思路。

title:
Gender, Generation, and Financial Fragility: Evidence on the Education-Vulnerability Paradox
and Heterogeneous Digital Protection Effects in Kazakhstan

detail.title:
Gender, Generation, and Financial Fragility: Evidence on the Education-Vulnerability Paradox
and Heterogeneous Digital Protection Effects in Kazakhstan

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted independently with no external funding or institutional affiliation that could influence the findings.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study uses publicly available, fully anonymized secondary survey data from the World Bank Global Findex Database 2025. No primary data collection involving human participants was conducted. Accordingly, no institutional ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. Data used in this study are publicly available at no cost through the World Bank Microdata Library.

detail.abstract:
This study examines the age-group dynamics of gender disparities in household financial
vulnerability and formal savings behavior in Kazakhstan—a high-inclusion, rapidly digitalizing
post-Soviet economy. Utilizing individual-level microdata from the World Bank Global Findex
Database 2025 (n=763), this research employs descriptive stratification and cross-tabulation to
analyze behavioral patterns across younger (18–35) and middle-aged (36–55) adult cohorts. The
empirical analysis reveals a stark generational inversion in the structure of financial inequality.
Among young adults, the gender gap manifests primarily as acute short-term financial fragility;
young women are more than twice as likely as young men to be unable to source emergency
funds within 30 days (12.89% vs. 5.48%), despite holding a 15-percentage-point advantage in
tertiary educational attainment. Conversely, within the middle-aged cohort, the immediate
vulnerability gap converges to a negligible 0.61 percentage points, but a significant gap emerges
in formal asset accumulation, with men saving at banks at rates 7.09 percentage points higher
than women. Furthermore, the association between digital financial inclusion (dig_account) and
financial resilience is highly heterogeneous across cohorts: holding a digital account is associated
with a substantial 13.8-percentage-point reduction in vulnerability for older women—acting as a
proxy for broader socioeconomic integration—but shows a near-zero association (0.1 percentage
points) for younger women. These findings challenge monolithic narratives surrounding fintech
as a universal equalizer, demonstrating that digital infrastructure access cannot offset underlying
lifecycle liquidity constraints or structural resource deficiencies. The study underscores the
necessity of demographically targeted development policies that prioritize labor market wage
equity for younger women and active wealth management mechanisms for older cohorts.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用世界银行2025年全球Findex数据库数据，分析了哈萨克斯坦不同年龄段群体在家庭财务脆弱性和正规储蓄行为中的性别差异。研究发现财务不平等存在代际反转：年轻女性面临严重的短期财务脆弱性（无法获取紧急资金的比例是年轻男性的两倍多），而中年女性则在正规资产积累上落后于男性。数字金融账户对财务韧性的影响在不同年龄群体中高度异质——对年长女性帮助显著，对年轻女性几乎无效。
AI.research_question: 哈萨克斯坦不同年龄段群体（18-35岁年轻成人 vs. 36-55岁中年成人）中，家庭财务脆弱性和正规储蓄行为是否存在系统性的性别差异？数字金融包容性如何调节这些性别差异？
AI.motivation: 哈萨克斯坦作为高金融包容性、快速数字化的后苏联经济体，提供了一个独特的研究情境。现有文献多关注金融科技作为普惠金融的平等化工具，但对其在不同年龄群体中的异质性效果关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 生命周期理论、性别不平等理论、数字金融包容性理论
AI.method: 利用世界银行全球Findex数据库2025年微观数据（n=763），采用描述性分层分析和交叉表分析，比较年轻成人（18-35岁）和中年成人（36-55岁）群体中的行为模式。
AI.findings: (1) 年轻女性财务脆弱性显著高于年轻男性（12.89% vs. 5.48%无法在30天内筹集紧急资金），尽管女性高等教育优势高出15个百分点；(2) 中年群体脆弱性差距缩小至0.61个百分点，但正规储蓄差距显现，男性储蓄率高出7.09个百分点；(3) 数字账户对财务脆弱性的影响高度异质：对年长女性减少13.8个百分点，对年轻女性仅减少0.1个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了金融科技作为"通用平等化工具"的单向叙述，揭示了数字基础设施不能抵消生命周期流动性约束和结构性资源缺陷，为数字金融包容性的异质性效应提供了经验证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 强调需要针对不同人口群体制定差异化发展政策：对年轻女性优先解决劳动力市场工资公平问题，对中年群体则需关注积极的财富管理机制。

title: From Policy to Prosperity: Examining the Mediating Effects of Innovation Adoption and Productivity on Maize Farmers’ Welfare in Northern Ghana
affiliations: University for Development Studies

detail.title: From Policy to Prosperity: Examining the Mediating Effects of Innovation Adoption and Productivity on Maize Farmers’ Welfare in Northern Ghana
detail.abstract: This study examines the mechanisms by which public policy effectiveness (PPE) affects the economic welfare of maize farmers in northern Ghana. Using cross-sectional data from 321 farmers, it employed partial least squares structural equation modelling (PLS-SEM). The analysis estimates the direct and indirect relationships among public policy effectiveness, innovation adoption (IA), farmer productivity (FP), and economic welfare (EW) within a unified serial mediation framework. Findings reveal that PPE significantly influences IA and FP but does not exert a significant direct effect on EW. Instead, welfare gains are through indirect pathways. IA positively influences both FP and EW, while FP emerges as the strongest predictor of EW. Mediation results confirm that IA and FP function as both independent and sequential mediators, demonstrating that policy-driven improvements to welfare operate via farmers' behavioural change and performance enhancement rather than policy presence alone. Although the cross-sectional design limits causal inference and the analysis focuses specifically on economic welfare, the study provides robust empirical evidence that innovation-orientated and productivity-enhancing policies are central to achieving sustainable welfare improvements among smallholder maize farmers.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于加纳北部321名玉米农户的截面数据，采用PLS-SEM分析发现：公共政策有效性（PPE）通过促进创新采纳（IA）和农户生产力（FP）间接提升经济福利（EW），而非直接作用；IA和FP在政策与福利之间发挥独立和序列中介效应。
AI.research_question: 公共政策有效性如何影响加纳北部玉米种植农户的经济福利？其作用机制（直接和间接路径）是什么？
AI.motivation: 既有研究多关注政策本身的效果，但较少探讨政策有效性通过创新采纳和农户生产力等中介路径间接影响经济福利的内在机制；且针对西非小农户的实证证据不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 串联中介模型（Serial Mediation Framework），整合了公共政策有效性、创新采纳、农户生产力与经济福利之间的直接和间接关系。
AI.method: 采用偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）分析321名农户的截面数据，估计变量间的直接和间接路径系数，并进行中介效应检验。
AI.findings: （1）PPE显著正向影响IA和FP，但对EW无显著直接效应；（2）IA正向影响FP和EW；（3）FP是EW的最强预测因子；（4）IA和FP在PPE与EW之间既独立起中介作用，也发挥序列中介作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了政策有效性→创新采纳→农户生产力→经济福利的"行为改变-绩效提升"间接作用链条，丰富了农业政策效果评估的中介机制理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了实证依据：应重点推行以创新为导向和生产力提升型的农业政策，而非仅仅依赖政策本身的存在，以实现小农户可持续福利改善。

title: Bank Run Contagion Through Social Network
affiliations: and

detail.title: Bank Run Contagion Through Social Network
detail.abstract: This paper examines how social networks transmit bank runs, exploiting the 2023 U.S. banking crisis as a natural experiment. Leveraging Facebook's Social Connectedness Index and a difference-indifferences design, we find that banks in socially connected counties experience significantly lower deposit growth post-crisis, while geographic proximity shows no effect. Social contagion amplifies fundamental vulnerabilities, particularly for banks with high uninsured deposits and large held-to-maturity securities. However, exploiting within-bank variation reveals that fundamentals alone cannot explain the patterns: deposit outflows vary based on local social exposure even after controlling for all bank characteristics. Together, these results indicate that social contagion operates through both rational fundamental screening and panic-driven runs. We document a flight-to-safety: uninsured deposits flee while insured deposits flow in. Finally, socially-transmitted deposit shocks lead to significant credit supply contractions in both small business and mortgage lending, demonstrating substantial real economic consequences.

AI.tldr: 本文利用2023年美国银行业危机作为自然实验，基于Facebook社会连接指数和双重差分法，发现社会网络显著传播银行挤兑，而地理距离则无此效应。社会传染既通过理性基本面筛选（高未保险存款、大额持有至到期证券的银行受冲击更大）也通过恐慌驱动（同一银行不同地点因社会曝光度不同而出现差异化存款流出）发挥作用，最终导致信用供给收缩。
AI.research_question: 社会网络如何传播银行挤兑？其传播机制是基于理性基本面筛选还是纯粹恐慌驱动？
AI.motivation: 2023年美国银行业危机（硅谷银行等倒闭）为研究银行挤兑的社会传染提供了独特自然实验；传统研究多关注地理邻近性或基本面因素，而社交媒体时代的社会网络连接可能成为新的危机传播渠道。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社会传染理论（理性基本面筛选 vs. 恐慌驱动挤兑）、银行挤兑理论、社会网络传播理论。
AI.method: 自然实验（2023年美国银行业危机）；Facebook社会连接指数衡量社会网络连接度；双重差分法（DID）；银行-县层面和银行内部（within-bank）变动分析。
AI.findings: ①社会网络连接越强的县，银行在危机后存款增长越低，地理邻近性无显著影响；②社会传染放大了基本面脆弱性（高未保险存款、大额持有至到期证券的银行受影响更大）；③控制银行特征后，同一银行内部不同县因社会曝光度不同出现差异化存款流出，表明恐慌驱动也发挥作用；④出现"逃向安全"现象（未保险存款流出、保险存款流入）；⑤社会传播的存款冲击导致小企业和抵押贷款信用供给显著收缩。
AI.theory_contributions: 将银行挤兑研究从传统的地理邻近性和基本面因素拓展到社会网络传播维度；揭示社会传染同时包含理性（基本面筛选）和非理性（恐慌驱动）两种机制，丰富了对银行挤兑传播渠道的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构监测和防范系统性金融风险提供新视角——关注社交媒体上的银行间社会连接度而非仅地理邻近性；提示银行在评估流动性风险时需考虑客户社会网络曝光度；对存款保险制度的设计和危机沟通策略具有政策启示。

title: The Network Geometry Of Order Flow: Explaining Sublinear Scaling in U.S. Futures Markets
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The Network Geometry Of Order Flow: Explaining Sublinear Scaling in U.S. Futures Markets

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study as it does not involve human participants, clinical patients, or animal subjects. The empirical methodology relies exclusively on anonymized, macro-level financial market order book event messages and public simulation metrics.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. Baseline research infrastructure was supported by the institutional resources of the Eller College of Management, University of Arizona.

detail.abstract: Do financial markets obey the same scaling laws as living organisms? This paper argues they do-at least in the structure of limit order book participation. Drawing on the West-Enquist-Brown (WEB) metabolic theory of biology, we develop a formal framework in which participant order activity scales with capital footprint at a threequarters power. Rather than treating the biological parallel as loose analogy, we derive α = 3/4 analytically from optimal branching conditions in a hierarchical order-routing network. Using E-mini S&P 500 (ES) and Nasdaq-100 (NQ) futures as our testing ground-instruments with well-documented microstructural properties-we construct proxy measures of participant size and activity through latency-burst fingerprinting of anonymised CME Globex message data. Log-log OLS regressions across scale tranches yield estimated exponents α̂ ∈ [0.71, 0.79], clustering tightly around the 3/4 prediction and decisively rejecting both linear and square-root benchmarks. We also show that the Square Root Law of market impact is not in tension with allometric scaling: the two results operate at different levels of description and are jointly consistent under standard optimal execution. The framework has implications for systemic liquidity fragility and the ecology of capital in electronic markets.

AI.tldr: 本文借鉴生物学中的WEB代谢理论，论证了限价订单簿参与者的订单活动规模与资本足迹之间存在3/4幂律标度关系，并通过E-mini S&P 500和纳斯达克-100期货数据的实证分析，估计出指数在0.71-0.79之间，支持了这一理论预测。
AI.research_question: 金融市场（特别是限价订单簿参与者行为）是否遵循与生物体相同的标度律？
AI.motivation: 传统上将金融与生物学的类比视为松散比喻，本文试图建立严格的形式化理论框架，证明市场微观结构中的参与者行为确实遵循与生物代谢理论一致的幂律标度关系。
AI.theoretical_framework: West-Enquist-Brown (WEB) 生物代谢理论；最优分支网络理论；异速标度律（Allometric Scaling）；平方根市场影响定律。
AI.method: 理论推导（通过层级订单路由网络中最优分支条件导出α=3/4）；实证检验（利用CME Globex匿名化消息数据的延迟爆发指纹识别技术构建参与者规模与活动代理变量，对E-mini S&P 500和纳斯达克-100期货进行对数-对数OLS回归）。
AI.findings: 估计指数在0.71-0.79之间，紧密围绕3/4理论预测，明确拒绝了线性（1）和平方根（1/2）基准；并且论证了异速标度律与市场影响的平方根定律不存在矛盾，两者在不同描述层面共同一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 将生物代谢理论严格引入金融市场微观结构分析，从理论上推导出参与者订单活动的3/4幂律标度，并阐明了与平方根市场影响定律的一致性关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 对系统性流动性脆弱性和电子市场中资本生态具有政策与风险管理启示。
