title: Narrative Dynamics and Carbon Market Legitimacy: Distortion, Asymmetry, and Advocacy-driven Closure in Market-based Climate Mechanisms
affiliations: Taita Taveta University, Taita Taveta University and Taita Taveta University

detail.title: Narrative Dynamics and Carbon Market Legitimacy: Distortion, Asymmetry, and Advocacy-driven Closure in Market-based Climate Mechanisms

keywords: Type A/Type B Civil Society Actors

publicationDetails.detailsText: East African Journal of Business and Economics, volume 9, issue 2, 2026[10.37284/eajbe.9.2.4966]

detail.abstract: This study examines how narrative dynamics influence the legitimacy and stakeholder perceptions of market-based climate mechanisms (MBMs), including voluntary carbon markets, compliance systems, Article 6 cooperative approaches, and nature-based solutions. Employing qualitative discourse analysis of 108 purposively sampled documents (2021 to 2025) across investigative media, governance documents, policy literature, civil society reports, corporate communications, and market intelligence, the study delineates three primary discursive formations: crisis-oriented, reform-oriented, and technical-neutral. Three dominant mechanisms are identified: narrative distortion, which amplifies and generalises project-level findings into system-wide critique; narrative asymmetry, which structurally marginalises Global South perspectives; and advocacy-driven narrative closure, where inquiry is structured to confirm predetermined conclusions, thereby precluding differentiated empirical assessment. An inductively derived fourth mechanism, narrative extraction, describes the recursive use of communities and projects as discursive material without recognition of their agency. These mechanisms contributed to the contraction of voluntary carbon markets from USD 1.9 billion in 2021 to USD 723 million in 2023, a decline attributed primarily to reputational risk, rather than project quality. This study introduces the Narrative Distortion and Governance Response Model (NDGRM), a cyclical framework integrating legitimacy, institutional, and strategic narrative theories, and distinguishing between openinquiry and closure-driven civil society actors. The analysis recommends that governance bodies prioritise strategic communication, actively amplify Southern-authored co-benefit evidence, and avoid conflating project-level critique with system-wide failures. This integrated analytical framework advances understanding of legitimacy dynamics in reputation-sensitive climate markets and offers actionable pathways for governance reform.

AI.tldr: 本研究考察了叙事动态如何影响市场型气候机制（如自愿碳市场、合规体系、第6条合作方法及基于自然的解决方案）的合法性与利益相关者认知。通过对2021至2025年间108份有目的抽样的文件（涵盖调查媒体、治理文件、政策文献、公民社会报告、企业沟通和市场情报）进行质性话语分析，识别出三种主要话语形态（危机导向、改革导向、技术中立）和四种叙事机制（叙事扭曲、叙事不对称、倡导驱动的叙事封闭、叙事提取），并提出了"叙事扭曲与治理响应模型（NDGRM）"。
AI.research_question: 叙事动态如何影响市场型气候机制（MBMs）的合法性与利益相关者认知？具体包括自愿碳市场、合规体系、第6条合作方法及基于自然的解决方案。
AI.motivation: 自愿碳市场从2021年的19亿美元萎缩至2023年的7.23亿美元，这一显著下降主要归因于声誉风险而非项目质量。理解叙事机制如何驱动这一合法性危机，对于改进气候治理至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了合法性理论（legitimacy theory）、制度理论（institutional theory）和战略叙事理论（strategic narrative theory），构建了"叙事扭曲与治理响应模型（NDGRM）"这一循环分析框架。
AI.method: 质性话语分析（qualitative discourse analysis）。对2021至2025年间108份有目的抽样文件（包括调查媒体、治理文件、政策文献、公民社会报告、企业沟通和市场情报）进行系统分析。
AI.findings: 识别出三种主要话语形态（危机导向、改革导向、技术中立）和四种叙事机制：叙事扭曲（将项目层面发现放大为系统层面批评）、叙事不对称（结构性边缘化全球南方视角）、倡导驱动的叙事封闭（预设结论导向的调查，排除差异化实证评估）、叙事提取（将社区和项目递归利用为话语素材而不承认其主体性）。这些机制导致碳市场声誉风险驱动的萎缩。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"叙事扭曲与治理响应模型（NDGRM）"，将合法性、制度与战略叙事理论整合为循环分析框架；区分了"开放探究型"与"封闭驱动型"公民社会行为者；归纳性地提出了第四种机制——"叙事提取"。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议治理机构优先进行战略沟通，积极放大全球南方撰写的共同效益证据，避免将项目层面批评与系统层面失败混为一谈。为声誉敏感型气候市场的治理改革提供了可操作的路径。

title: Nhaufinance: A Domain-Adapted NLP Benchmark for African Central Bank Discourse and Sovereign Risk Analysis

detail.title: Nhaufinance: A Domain-Adapted NLP Benchmark for African Central Bank Discourse and Sovereign Risk Analysis

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests that would bias the research findings.

detail.abstract:
African central bank communications remain analytically inaccessible to standard financial NLP tools: ProsusAI/FinBERT scores zero F1 on CURRENCY entity recognition for African monetary terminology (ZiG, RTGS dollar, cedi), confirming a vocabulary-level domain gap that motivates the present work.

We introduce NhauFinance, the first domain-adapted language model and annotated benchmark dataset targeting African central bank discourse. NhauFinance-v2 is pre-trained on 40 million tokens of policy text from five African monetary authorities: the Central Bank of Nigeria (CBN), South African Reserve Bank (SARB), Central Bank of Kenya (CBK), Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe (RBZ), and Bank of Ghana (BOG), evaluated on monetary policy sentiment classification, financial distress detection, policy event classification, and named entity recognition. Annotations were produced via an LLM-assisted expert simulation protocol spanning emerging-market practitioner, quantitative research, academic, and central bank validator perspectives across three labelling rounds yielding 1,876 annotated examples. Independent human validation of a stratified subset is in progress and will be reported in the journal submission prior to peer review.

The primary finding is a data efficiency advantage of 6× on financial distress detection: NhauFinance-v2 achieves 0.62 macro F1 with 50 labelled examples, a level FinBERT requires approximately 300 examples to match. On policy event classification, NhauFinance-v2 achieves 0.5491 macro F1 versus FinBERT's 0.4713 (Δ = +0.0778); on distress detection, 0.7209 versus 0.6790 (Δ = +0.0420). These two tasks represent the core policy signal extraction use case for which the model was designed, with applications to emerging-market sovereign risk analysis and contagion early warning systems.

Analysis of annotation patterns reveals that 96.2% of African CB policy event announcements are embedded in institutional survival framing, a structural feature of African sovereign communication absent from developed-market NLP frameworks, with direct implications for how EM sovereign risk signals should be extracted from African CB text.

We document two limitations with full statistical transparency. Sentiment classification exhibits initialisation sensitivity attributable to cold-start classifier adaptation on small datasets, characterised via a 7-seed robustness analysis; NhauFinance-v2 shows 51% lower cross-seed variance on NER, confirming that domain pre-training stabilises token-level recognition. CURRENCY_ACTION and INTERVENTION classes contain insufficient training examples (17 and 10 respectively) for reliable current estimates; expanded annotation is targeted for subsequent benchmark rounds.

The NhauFinance corpus, annotation guidelines, and model weights are released as the first open benchmark for African central bank NLP, providing a reproducible evaluation framework for emerging-market monetary policy text analysis.

title: Historical Ethnic Geography and Routes of Prosocial behavior across 85 Countries

detail.title: Historical Ethnic Geography and Routes of Prosocial behavior across 85 Countries

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Prosocial behavior is often treated as a single outcome, but people help through distinct routes, including volunteering, helping strangers, direct giving and formal charity. I test whether country-level ethnic fractionalization is associated with these routes using CAF 2025 outcomes for 85 countries and a historicalgeographic instrumental-variable design. The instrument, GECI 1913, measures external-contact isolation from CShapes 1913 political geography and modern country geometries. Instrumented ethnic fractionalization is associated with higher active/direct prosocial engagement (2SLS coefficient=2.777, 95% CI 1.388-4.165) and volunteering (coefficient=34.184, 95% CI 18.549-49.818); both headline outcomes meet primary-family multiple-testing correction. Formal charity and total-giving outcomes are mixed, null or opposite-signed. The findings recast diversity-and-cohesion debates as a question about routes of helping, while remaining bounded to a global historical-geographic relationship.

AI.tldr: 本文利用85个国家的CAF 2025数据及历史地理工具变量（GECI 1913），发现国家层面的民族分裂程度与积极/直接的亲社会行为（如志愿服务、直接帮助陌生人）正相关，但与正式慈善捐赠的关系不显著或负相关，挑战了"多样性削弱亲社会性"的传统认知。
AI.research_question: 国家层面的民族分裂程度是否以及如何与不同类型的亲社会行为（志愿服务、帮助陌生人、直接捐赠、正式慈善）相关联？
AI.motivation: 既有研究常将亲社会行为视为单一结果，但现实中人们通过不同途径提供帮助。论文试图探索民族多样性对不同亲社会路径的影响，以重新审视"多样性-社会凝聚力"的经典争论。
AI.theoretical_framework: 民族分裂与亲社会行为的关系理论；亲社会行为的多元路径框架（积极/直接参与 vs. 正式/间接捐赠）。
AI.method: 使用CAF 2025中85个国家数据，采用历史地理工具变量（GECI 1913，基于CShapes 1913政治地理与现代国家几何测算的外部接触隔离度），进行两阶段最小二乘回归（2SLS），并对主要结果进行多重检验校正。
AI.findings: 工具变量化的民族分裂程度与积极/直接亲社会参与（2SLS系数=2.777, 95% CI 1.388-4.165）和志愿服务（系数=34.184, 95% CI 18.549-49.818）显著正相关；正式慈善和总捐赠的结果混合、不显著或方向相反。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"多样性-凝聚力"争论重新定位为"帮助路径"问题，即民族分裂并不一概削弱亲社会性，而是改变人们帮助的具体方式（更偏向直接参与而非正式捐赠）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和慈善组织提供启示：在多元社会中，应更注重促进志愿服务和直接互助等非正式亲社会途径，而非仅依赖正式慈善渠道。

title: The Contracts Not Written: Measuring Covenant Tightness with LLM-Generated Synthetic Counterfactuals
affiliations: University of Georgia - Department of Banking and Finance and University of Georgia

detail.title: The Contracts Not Written: Measuring Covenant Tightness with LLM-Generated Synthetic Counterfactuals
detail.abstract: Syndicated loan covenants exhibit substantial heterogeneity even among observably similar borrowers. We ask whether this variation reflects economically meaningful differences in contracting outcomes shaped by bargaining power or is largely incidental once observable risk is accounted for. Using a new measure of covenant tightness, defined as a contract's position within a deal-specific distribution of feasible covenant packages generated by large language models and validated against independent programmatic methods, we document a sharp asymmetry across borrower credit quality. Among investment-grade borrowers, tighter covenants are associated with significantly higher loan spreads but do not predict subsequent violations. Among speculative-grade borrowers, tightness has no incremental pricing power but strongly predicts violations. This cross-outcome asymmetry is difficult to reconcile with a residual risk interpretation and instead reflects two distinct contracting regimes: negotiated outcomes driven by bargaining power for investment-grade borrowers, and lender risk management and proximity to binding constraints for speculative-grade borrowers. More broadly, we show how counterfactual contract distributions can be used to measure contract design in settings with substantial contractual heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 本文利用大语言模型生成反事实合同分布，构建了新的契约紧密度指标，发现投资级借款人的契约紧密度与贷款利差正相关但不预测违约，而投机级借款人的紧密度不反映定价但预测违约，揭示了两种不同的缔约机制。
AI.research_question: 银团贷款契约的异质性是否源于经济上有意义的谈判力量差异，还是在控制可观测风险后主要是偶然性差异？
AI.motivation: 观察上相似的借款人所签订的贷款契约存在显著异质性，传统方法难以区分这种异质性究竟反映真实的缔约结果差异还是噪声。
AI.theoretical_framework: 谈判力量理论、风险管理和约束边界理论。
AI.method: 利用大语言模型生成可行的反事实契约分布，构建契约紧密度指标，并结合独立程序化方法进行验证，分析紧密度与贷款利差、违约概率之间的关系。
AI.findings: 投资级借款人：紧密度越高，贷款利差越高，但不预测后续违约；投机级借款人：紧密度无定价能力，但显著预测违约。这种跨结果不对称性不支持残余风险解释，而是反映了两种不同的缔约机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了利用大语言模型构建反事实契约分布来度量契约设计的新方法，揭示了谈判力量与风险管理两种不同的缔约机制，丰富了契约设计理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为贷款市场参与者（银行、借款人、监管机构）理解和评估契约紧度的经济含义提供了新的分析工具和实证依据，有助于更精准地进行风险定价和契约设计。

reference: Proceedings Book of "Technology & Business Update", pp. 454-473
title: Bridging the AI Gap in Environmental Compliance: Assessing Institutional Readiness for AI Driven Monitoring of Strategic Investments in Albania
affiliations: University of Tirana

detail.title: Bridging the AI Gap in Environmental Compliance: Assessing Institutional Readiness for AI Driven Monitoring of Strategic Investments in Albania

publicationDetails.detailsText: Proceedings Book of "Technology & Business Update", pp. 454-473

detail.abstract: This research assesses the preparedness of the Albanian institutions to apply Artificial Intelligence (AI) to environmental monitoring through the lens of strategic investments as governed by Law No. 55/2015. Rather than depending on the collection of original data from the field, the assessment depends upon prior international reports and indexes in order to determine the present-day institutional capacity in fields of digital infrastructure, organization, regulation and skills. The research presents an uneven image; while Albania has made significant strides toward developing its Digital Government and currently possesses a very high degree of E-Government Development, the same cannot be said for environmental monitoring. Compared to the many recent development activities being carried out in the country, monitoring systems and enforcement capabilities remain extremely limited. During the years between 2016 and 2024, 49 large strategic investment projects worth more than €7.5 billion were approved by the government of Albania. Approximately all of these projects were either in tourism or located in environmentally sensitive coastal regions. Despite this added pressure, environmental oversight continues to be weak and ill-equipped for the application of AI-based tools. Generally speaking, the overall results of the study indicate that Albania's primary challenge is not AI technology itself, but rather the institutional conditions that need to exist for it to be used effectively. Before AI can contribute to the improvement of environmental governance, improvements in data management, organizational coordination, regulation and skills will need to occur. Insights developed within the framework of this research could also have relevance for other EU candidate countries that are confronting similar challenges during their own digital and institutional transformations.

AI.tldr: 本文评估阿尔巴尼亚机构在环境监测中应用人工智能（AI）的准备情况，发现尽管该国在数字政府方面取得显著进展，但环境监测领域的制度能力（数据管理、组织协调、监管和技能）严重不足，是制约AI有效应用的主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 阿尔巴尼亚机构在环境监测中应用人工智能的准备程度如何？
AI.motivation: 阿尔巴尼亚在2016-2024年间批准了49个大型战略投资项目（超75亿欧元），大多位于环境敏感的海岸区域，但环境监管能力薄弱，亟需评估AI应用于环境监测的制度前提。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于第55/2015号法律关于战略投资的制度视角，结合数字基础设施、组织、监管和技能等多维制度能力框架。
AI.method: 依赖现有国际报告和指数（而非原始实地数据）进行制度能力评估。
AI.findings: 阿尔巴尼亚电子政务发展程度很高，但环境监测系统极不完善；49个大型投资项目几乎全部涉及旅游或位于环境敏感海岸区，环境监督却依然薄弱；主要挑战不是AI技术本身，而是所需的制度条件（数据管理、组织协调、监管和技能）不足。
AI.theory_contributions: 强调制度准备度而非技术本身是AI应用于环境治理的关键前提，为后发国家AI应用提供了制度分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出阿尔巴尼亚及欧盟候选国在推进AI环境监测前必须优先改善数据管理、组织协调、监管和技能等基础制度条件。

title: Towards an Ideometrics-Based General Theory of Human Progress
affiliations: and University of Edinburgh - Usher Institute

detail.title: Towards an Ideometrics-Based General Theory of Human Progress
detail.abstract: This paper proposes ideometrics as the foundation for a generalised and potentially testable theory of human progress and civilisational progress, thus linking ideometrics to studies in economics and history. Building on prior work that conceptualises the human brain as a “sensor of ideas”, the paper integrates diverse disciplinary perspectives, from economics, decision theory and evolution to philosophy of science and information theory, into a single, closed-loop framework. Within this framework, human progress is understood not primarily through outcomes such as wealth, health, or technological advancement, but through the dynamic process by which ideas are generated, evaluated, prioritised, and implemented to shape future states. The paper advances a formal definition of “human progress” as a measurable improvement in the ability of individuals and societies to generate, evaluate, prioritise, and implement ideas in a way that increasingly aligns prioritised ideas - under scarcity of human capacity, energy, time and resources - with those that truly lead to preferred future states, given available information and uncertainty. It further introduces the “Ideometric Index of Human Progress” (IIHP), a composite measure capturing the quality of idea generation (G), accuracy of their evaluation (E), efficiency of their prioritisation (P), and effectiveness of their implementation (Ie). It then shows that, although IIHP can serve to evaluate the quality of the process of ideometrics, the true progress in the future will only be realised if there is good alignment between the “perceived future value of ideas” and their true, realised future value, which can be assessed at different future points as “outcome monitoring” (O). This formulation shifts the analytical focus from static outcomes to the quality of evaluating ideas, thereby offering a novel lens for understanding both progress and regress. While acknowledging theoretical and practical challenges, the paper argues that approximate measurement through observable proxies can enable first empirical testing. The concept can also be extended to long periods of history through the “Ideometric Index of Civilisational Progress” (IICP), where additional parameters of successful documentation of outcomes (D) and successful intergenerational transmission of gathered knowledge (T) are added. IICP exposes fragility of civilisations, because any effective action to reduce quality of either G, E, P, Ie, O, D or T variables is sufficient to interfere with civilisational progress and eventually lead to regress. By transforming “ideas” into measurable units of analysis and emphasising the improvement of selection processes, rather than outcomes alone, ideometrics offers a potentially transformative approach to understanding human progress. This has practical implications for funding new research, supporting start-up companies, developing strategies for existing companies, formulating governmental policies, and advancing artificial intelligence systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"思想计量学"（ideometrics）作为人类进步与文明进步的可检验理论的基础，将大脑视为"思想传感器"，构建了一个涵盖经济学、决策理论、演化论、科学哲学和信息论的闭环框架。通过定义思想生成（G）、评估（E）、优先排序（P）、实施（Ie）、结果监测（O）、文献记录（D）和代际传递（T）等可量化维度，提出了人类进步指数（IIHP）和文明进步指数（IICP），强调进步本质上是思想选择过程质量的提升，而非仅仅是物质成果的改善。
AI.research_question: 如何将"思想"转化为可测量的分析单元，从而构建一个可检验的人类进步与文明进步的统一理论？
AI.motivation: 现有进步理论多以财富、健康、技术等静态结果为导向，缺乏对进步背后动态过程的系统性度量。作者试图弥合经济学、历史学、演化论与信息科学之间的鸿沟，提出一个能够解释进步与退步的通用分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨学科闭环框架：将人类大脑视为"思想传感器"；整合经济学、决策理论、演化论、科学哲学与信息论；核心逻辑是思想在稀缺约束下的生成→评估→优先排序→实施→结果监测→知识传递的循环过程。
AI.method: 理论建构与形式化定义：提出"人类进步"的形式化定义，构建IIHP（G, E, P, Ie的综合指标）和IICP（在IIHP基础上增加D和T维度），并论证通过可观察代理变量进行近似测量的可行性。
AI.findings: （1）人类进步应被理解为提升思想选择过程质量的能力；（2）IIHP可用于衡量进步过程质量，但真正进步取决于"感知价值"与"实际价值"的吻合度（即结果监测O）；（3）IICP揭示了文明的脆弱性——G、E、P、Ie、O、D、T中任何一个维度的有效削弱都足以干扰文明进步甚至导致倒退。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将"思想"转化为可量化分析单元，为进步研究提供新的度量范式；（2）将分析焦点从静态结果转移到思想选择过程的动态质量；（3）将人类进步与文明进步纳入统一的可检验框架；（4）为理解文明脆弱性和退步提供了系统性解释。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为科研资金分配、初创企业支持、企业战略制定和政府政策设计提供新的评估依据；（2）为人工智能系统的发展提供理论指导；（3）通过可观察代理变量为实证检验提供了可行路径。

title: High School Never Ends: Secondary School Attributes on Formal Sector Earnings

detail.title: High School Never Ends: Secondary School Attributes on Formal Sector Earnings

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None.
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: Five hundred million children are enrolled in secondary education in developing countries, over five times that in developed nations. Yet little is known about what features of secondary education matter most for short-term academic or long-term labor market outcomes. I combine data from a national high school entrance exam linked to individual tax records in Jamaica. Using a regression discontinuity design, I find that access to a school with two additional years of education increases formal sector earnings by 2,900 USD PPP per year from ages 22-31. I find no short-or longterm effects from higher quality peers, casting doubt on tracking as a policy tool. I find large academic benefits from same-sex peer exposure but no long-term labor market effects.

AI.tldr: 本文利用牙买加全国高中入学考试数据和个人税务记录，通过断点回归设计，发现接受额外两年中学教育可使正式部门年收入增加2,900美元（购买力平价），而同质同伴质量对短期学业和长期劳动力市场结果均无显著影响，同性同伴接触虽有学术益处但无长期劳动力市场效应。
AI.research_question: 在发展中国家，中学教育的哪些特征对短期学业结果和长期劳动力市场结果最为重要？
AI.motivation: 发展中国家有5亿儿童接受中等教育，是发达国家的五倍以上，但关于中等教育特征对学业和劳动力市场结果的影响知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、同伴效应理论、教育生产函数
AI.method: 利用牙买加全国高中入学考试数据与个人税务记录，采用断点回归设计（Regression Discontinuity Design）识别因果关系。
AI.findings: （1）进入多提供两年教育的学校可使22-31岁正式部门年收入增加2,900美元（PPP）；（2）同伴质量（跟踪分班）对短期学业和长期劳动力市场无显著影响；（3）同性同伴接触有学术益处，但无长期劳动力市场效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家中等教育对长期收入的因果效应提供了新证据；挑战了通过同伴质量（能力分组/跟踪）提升教育效果的传统假设；区分了教育年限与同伴构成的不同作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示政策制定者应优先关注延长教育年限而非进行能力分组/跟踪；为发展中国家中等教育投资提供了量化收益参考（每年2,900美元）。

reference: 79 Ohio State Law Journal 802 (2019); Northwestern Public Law Research Paper No. 19-31
title: Cities Taxing New Sins: The Judicial Embrace of Local Excise Taxation
affiliations: Northwestern University School of Law

detail.title: Cities Taxing New Sins: The Judicial Embrace of Local Excise Taxation

publicationDetails.detailsText: 79 Ohio State Law Journal 802 (2019)
Northwestern Public Law Research Paper No. 19-31
publicationDetails.journalName: Northwestern University Pritzker School of Law, Public Law & Legal Theory Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The past decade has witnessed an unprecedented expansion in the number and reach of local excise taxes. Though excise taxes have always formed part of the American fiscal system, they have traditionally been largely state, or even federal, level taxes. Therefore, contemporary excise taxes that have received much attention-soda taxes, plastic bag taxes, gun taxes, and more-are innovative not only in the products they target, but also in the identity of the government imposing them: a city or county government. From a legal perspective, the most striking-and heretofore, largely unacknowledged-feature of this development is the wholehearted legal embrace of this turn to the local. This Article demonstrates that when confronting the new local excise taxes, courts have completely reversed their typically hostile attitude towards local action. Usually courts insist that a locality identify a source of authority for any act it adopts. But when the contested local act is an excise tax, courts will only strike it down if an explicit state preempting law is shown-and, when present, they will interpret such a law narrowly. This result is achieved through the manipulation of a series of doctrines that are at play when local excise taxes are challenged, including doctrines pertaining to the interpretation of enabling acts, to home rule initiative powers, to implied preemption, to home rule immunity powers, to uniformity in taxation clauses, and more. The justifications courts provide for these moves draw on a formalistic, and rather unpersuasive, distinction between taxation and regulation. Still, this Article argues that courts' resultant permissive attitude towards local excise taxation is worthwhile for other, substantive, reasons: local decision-making in this specific field promotes the political and economic normative values normally ascribed to localism.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了美国地方消费税（如苏打税、塑料袋税、枪支税等）的兴起，指出法院在审理此类地方税案件时一反常态地采取了宽松态度，不再严格审查地方政府的立法权限，而是仅在有明确州法禁止时才予以推翻，并对此类州法进行狭义解释。文章认为，尽管法院以形式主义的“征税与监管”二分法为其辩护，但这种宽容态度实际上有利于促进地方主义所倡导的政治与经济价值。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国法院在审理地方消费税案件时，一反通常对地方行为的严格审查态度，转而采取极度宽容的法律立场？这种转变的背后机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 过去十年间，美国地方消费税（如苏打税、塑料袋税、枪支税）数量激增，但法学界对其独特的法律待遇缺乏关注。作者发现法院对待地方消费税的态度与通常对地方行为的敌对态度截然不同，这一现象值得深入探究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 地方主义（Localism）的政治与经济规范价值；法院审查地方行为的传统敌对态度；征税与监管的形式主义二分法；授权法解释、地方自治创制权、隐含优先适用、地方自治豁免权、税收统一性条款等系列法律原则。
AI.method: 法律 doctrinal 分析：通过梳理法院在地方消费税案件中的裁判逻辑，分析其如何运用和操纵一系列法律原则（如授权法解释、隐含优先适用、地方自治豁免权等），实现从传统敌对态度到宽容态度的转变。
AI.findings: 法院对地方消费税采取了完全不同于其他地方行为的审查标准：通常要求地方行为必须有明确授权，但对于地方消费税，法院只在有明确的州优先法时才予以推翻，且对此类州法进行狭义解释。这一结果通过操纵一系列法律原则实现，法院以形式主义的“征税与监管”二分法为其辩护。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了美国地方税法领域一个被忽视的重要现象：法院对地方消费税的特殊宽容态度；指出了法院所依赖的形式主义“征税与监管”二分法在理论上的不具说服力；同时为地方消费税的宽松司法待遇提供了替代性的实质性正当理由（地方主义价值）。
AI.practical_contributions: 为地方政府推行新型消费税（如含糖饮料税、塑料袋税等）提供了法律可行性分析；帮助理解法院在地方税案件中的裁判倾向，为相关政策制定与法律挑战提供参考；揭示了地方消费税作为地方治理工具的相对优势。

title: Doubly Robust Local Projections with Continuous State Dependence
affiliations: University At Albany and International Monetary Fund (IMF)

detail.title: Doubly Robust Local Projections with Continuous State Dependence
detail.abstract: We develop AIPW-LP-STF, a doubly robust framework for state-dependent dynamic treatment effects in observational panels. The estimator first constructs horizon-specific augmented inverse-probability-weighted treatment-effect scores and then applies smooth-transition weights to form regime-specific dynamic average treatment effects. This score-based construction distinguishes the target parameters from coefficients in interacted local projections because the estimands are smooth-transition weighted averages of potential-outcome differences across the economic state. Under conditional independence and overlap, the regime estimators are consistent if either the propensity score or the outcome model is correctly specified. Monte Carlo experiments show near-zero bias and materially lower root mean squared error than IPW-LP-STF, hard-split AIPW, and the unadjusted interacted LP-STF benchmark. A policy-evaluation application to fiscal consolidations in 31 advanced and emerging market economies illustrates how selection correction changes regime-specific dynamic effects and how interacted local projections without the AIPW re-randomization step can produce different conclusions about the magnitude and precision of state dependence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AIPW-LP-STF双重稳健框架，用于估计观测面板数据中状态依赖的动态处理效应。该框架通过增强逆概率加权和光滑转换权重，在双重稳健条件下一致估计不同经济状态下的动态平均处理效应。蒙特卡洛实验显示该方法偏差近乎为零且均方根误差更低。将其应用于31个国家的财政整顿政策评估，发现选择偏差校正会显著改变状态依赖效应的结论。
AI.research_question: 如何对观测面板数据中随经济状态变化的动态处理效应进行无偏且稳健的估计？
AI.motivation: 已有的交互局部投影法（LP-STF）和逆概率加权法（IPW-LP-STF）在估计状态依赖的动态处理效应时，可能因倾向得分或结果模型设定错误而产生较大偏差。需要发展一种双重稳健的估计方法以提升估计的可靠性和精确性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双重稳健估计（Doubly Robust）、增强逆概率加权（AIPW）、光滑转换模型（Smooth Transition）、潜在结果框架（Potential Outcomes）、局部投影法（Local Projections）、条件独立假设（Conditional Independence）、重叠假设（Overlap）
AI.method: 理论推导了AIPW-LP-STF估计量的构造过程：首先生成特定时域的增强逆概率加权处理效应得分，然后应用光滑转换权重形成状态特定的动态平均处理效应。通过蒙特卡洛模拟进行有限样本性能评估，并以31个国家的财政整顿政策为案例进行实证应用。
AI.findings: （1）在倾向得分模型或结果模型中至少有一个正确设定时，AIPW-LP-STF估计量是一致的；（2）蒙特卡洛实验中，该方法偏差近乎为零，均方根误差显著低于IPW-LP-STF、硬分割AIPW和未调整的交互LP-STF基准模型；（3）实证应用中，选择偏差校正会改变状态依赖效应的幅度和精度结论，未使用AIPW重随机化步骤的交互局部投影法可能导致关于状态依赖的不同结论。
AI.theory_contributions: 将双重稳健估计思想扩展至状态依赖的动态处理效应框架中，提出了基于得分的估计量构造方法，明确了目标参数与交互局部投影系数的区别，为因果推断中的状态依赖效应估计提供了更坚实的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为经济学、政治学和流行病学等领域中评估因经济状态不同而变化的政策动态效应提供了可靠的工具；对财政整顿政策的实证评估表明，该方法能更正传统方法可能产生的误导性结论，具有重要的政策评估价值。

title: Towards an Ideometrics-Based General Theory of Human Progress
affiliations: University of Edinburgh - Usher Institute and University of Edinburgh - Usher Institute

detail.title: Towards an Ideometrics-Based General Theory of Human Progress

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not required
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract: This paper proposes ideometrics as the foundation for a generalised and potentially testable theory of human progress and civilisational progress, thus linking ideometrics to studies in economics and history. Building on prior work that conceptualises the human brain as a “sensor of ideas”, the paper integrates diverse disciplinary perspectives, from economics, decision theory and evolution to philosophy of science and information theory, into a single, closed-loop framework. Within this framework, human progress is understood not primarily through outcomes such as wealth, health, or technological advancement, but through the dynamic process by which ideas are generated, evaluated, prioritised, and implemented to shape future states. The paper advances a formal definition of “human progress” as a measurable improvement in the ability of individuals and societies to generate, evaluate, prioritise, and implement ideas in a way that increasingly aligns prioritised ideas - under scarcity of human capacity, energy, time and resources - with those that truly lead to preferred future states, given available information and uncertainty. It further introduces the “Ideometric Index of Human Progress” (IIHP), a composite measure capturing the quality of idea generation (G), accuracy of their evaluation (E), efficiency of their prioritisation (P), and effectiveness of their implementation (Ie). It then shows that, although IIHP can serve to evaluate the quality of the process of ideometrics, the true progress in the future will only be realised if there is good alignment between the “perceived future value of ideas” and their true, realised future value, which can be assessed at different future points as “outcome monitoring” (O). This formulation shifts the analytical focus from static outcomes to the quality of evaluating ideas, thereby offering a novel lens for understanding both progress and regress. While acknowledging theoretical and practical challenges, the paper argues that approximate measurement through observable proxies can enable first empirical testing. The concept can also be extended to long periods of history through the “Ideometric Index of Civilisational Progress” (IICP), where additional parameters of successful documentation of outcomes (D) and successful intergenerational transmission of gathered knowledge (T) are added. IICP exposes fragility of civilisations, because any effective action to reduce quality of either G, E, P, Ie, O, D or T variables is sufficient to interfere with civilisational progress and eventually lead to regress. By transforming “ideas” into measurable units of analysis and emphasising the improvement of selection processes, rather than outcomes alone, ideometrics offers a potentially transformative approach to understanding human progress. This has practical implications for funding new research, supporting start-up companies, developing strategies for existing companies, formulating governmental policies, and advancing artificial intelligence systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"思想计量学"（ideometrics）作为人类进步与文明进步的可检验理论基石，将大脑视为"思想传感器"，构建了包含思想生成、评估、优先级排序和实施四个环节的闭环框架，并提出了人类进步指数（IIHP）和文明进步指数（IICP）两个复合测量指标。
AI.research_question: 如何将"思想"转化为可测量的分析单元，以构建一个可检验的人类进步与文明进步理论？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多从财富、健康、技术等静态结果维度衡量进步，缺乏对"思想选择过程"本身质量的系统化测量和理论化框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将经济学、决策理论、进化论、科学哲学和信息论整合为一个闭环框架，核心概念包括：大脑作为思想传感器、思想生成（G）、思想评估（E）、优先级排序（P）、实施（Ie）、结果监控（O）、文档记录（D）、代际传承（T）。
AI.method: 理论建构为主，提出复合指数（IIHP和IICP），通过可观测代理变量实现近似测量，为未来实证检验奠定基础。
AI.findings: 人类进步的本质是提升思想选择过程的质量，而非仅仅关注结果；文明的脆弱性源于G、E、P、Ie、O、D、T任一变量的下降都足以导致文明退步。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"思想"转化为可测量的分析单元，从关注静态结果转向关注思想选择过程的动态质量，为跨学科理解进步与退步提供了新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科研资助、创业公司支持、企业战略制定、政府政策设计以及人工智能系统开发提供可操作的评估框架。

title: The Limits of Current Explanations: County-Level Variation in Medicaid Managed Care Enrollment Loss During New York's Post-PHE Unwinding

detail.title: The Limits of Current Explanations: County-Level Variation in Medicaid Managed Care Enrollment Loss During New York's Post-PHE Unwinding

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. This research was conducted in an independent, personal capacity and does not represent the views of any employer or affiliated organization.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study used only de-identified, publicly available aggregate data and did not involve human subjects as defined under 45 CFR 46. It was therefore not subject to institutional review board review.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received for this work.

keywords: Medicaid; Medicaid unwinding; coverage retention; county-level variation; administrative burden; managed care; population health; health policy

detail.abstract:
Background. The expiration of pandemic-era continuous Medicaid enrollment requirements, commonly termed the unwinding, produced substantial coverage losses across the United States beginning in 2023. The degree to which these losses reflect genuine ineligibility versus administrative process failure, and whether they self-correct over time, remains incompletely understood at the subnational level.


Objective. To examine county-level variation in Medicaid managed care enrollment retention in New York State during and after the unwinding, and to assess how fully commonly available demographic, socioeconomic, transportation, and administrative indicators explain that variation.


Methods. An observational analysis of 25 consecutive months of New York State Department of Health Mainstream Medicaid Managed Care enrollment reports (December 2023 through December 2025) was conducted across 58 counties. County-level enrollment change was modeled using ordinary least squares regression against four sociodemographic variables (poverty rate, median household income, unemployment, and absence of vehicle access) drawn from U.S. Census American Community Survey estimates. Renewal-completion rates from state redetermination dashboards were then added to assess incremental explanatory power. A sub-county urban poverty-concentration measure was tested separately.


Results. Statewide mainstream managed care enrollment fell from approximately 5.08 million to 4.48 million between December 2023 and December 2024 (a decline of 11.8 percent, approximately 600,000 members). Contrary to the characterization of unwinding losses as transient churn, enrollment did not rebound: it continued to decline through December 2025, a further 37,840 members, with no recovery in the year after the initial losses. Counties operating under identical statewide policy conditions diverged substantially in enrollment loss, which ranged from 3.2 percent to 22.3 percent. The four sociodemographic variables explained 58.6 percent of the cross-county variation, so that commonly available indicators accounted for only part of the divergence. Renewal completion, the leading administrative candidate, added only a modest and non-robust increment (incremental R-squared 0.031, p = 0.046); its coefficient was positive but lost significance under heteroskedasticity-robust standard errors (p = 0.08), under regional fixed effects (p = 0.18), and after removal of the five most influential counties (p = 0.37). A sub-county urban poverty-concentration measure did not reach significance and is reported as a null result. Taken together, the commonly available public indicators tested here, including the administrative-performance measure most likely to be reached for, did not adequately explain the observed county-level variation.


Conclusions. The principal finding of this study is not the identification of a specific driver of retention, but rather the demonstration that commonly available public indicators, including the administrative-performance measures most likely to be reached for, do not adequately explain the substantial variation in enrollment outcomes observed across New York counties operating under a single statewide policy. Renewal completion showed a positive but non-robust association with retention and may be part of the explanation, but it did not survive regional adjustment or sensitivity testing. The losses were patterned and did not recover in the subsequent year. The study is best understood as diagnostic rather than prescriptive: it establishes that meaningful unexplained variation exists and defines an agenda for identifying the administrative, operational, managed-care, and cross-sector factors that current public data do not capture.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了2023年美国Medicaid"连续参保"政策终止后，纽约州各县医疗补助管理式医疗的参保保留情况。研究发现，全州参保人数在一年内下降约11.8%（约60万人），且未在后续一年内反弹。各县之间的参保流失率差异很大（3.2%至22.3%），而常用的社会经济和行政指标（包括续保完成率）只能部分解释这些差异，说明存在大量未被公共数据捕捉的重要因素。
AI.research_question: 纽约州各县在Medicaid"政策终止"（unwinding）期间及之后，医疗补助管理式医疗的参保保留情况存在怎样的差异？常用的社会经济、交通和行政指标能在多大程度上解释这种差异？
AI.motivation: 政策终止导致的参保流失究竟是源于参保人真正失去资格，还是行政流程失败？这种流失是否会随时间自我纠正？这些问题在次国家级层面尚不完全清楚，而理解这些差异对于改进政策执行至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 政策执行理论、行政负担理论（administrative burden）、社会决定因素与健康保险覆盖的关系。
AI.method: 观察性研究，覆盖纽约州58个县连续25个月（2023年12月至2025年12月）的医疗补助管理式医疗参保数据。使用普通最小二乘回归（OLS）建模，先以四个社会经济变量（贫困率、家庭中位收入、失业率、无车辆通行）为自变量，再加入续保完成率评估增量解释力，并单独测试了次县级城市贫困集中度指标。
AI.findings: 1) 全州参保人数从约508万降至448万（下降11.8%），且未在后续一年内恢复。2) 各县参保流失率差异显著，从3.2%到22.3%不等。3) 四个社会经济变量解释了58.6%的县际差异。4) 续保完成率仅增加微弱解释力（增量R²=0.031，p=0.046），且在稳健性检验中不显著。5) 次县级城市贫困集中度指标未达显著性。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了即使在同一州政策框架下，政策执行结果在次国家级层面存在巨大差异，且常用的公共数据指标不足以解释这些差异，为行政负担理论和政策执行理论提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: ①揭示政策终止导致的参保流失并非"短暂波动"，而是持续性的损失，不会自我纠正；②指出当前公共数据无法充分解释县际差异，需要收集更精细的行政、运营、管理式医疗和跨部门因素数据；③为政策制定者提供了诊断性分析框架，明确了需要进一步关注的领域。

title: The Toll Exacted on the Moroccan Forests during World War II

detail.title: The Toll Exacted on the Moroccan Forests during World War II
detail.abstract: This article analyzes the evolution of forestry operations and their implications following the alignment of Moroccan legislation with the French Law of 1938 concerning the general organization of the nation in wartime. The substitution of hydrocarbons and imported timber, relied upon during peacetime, with fuelwood and locally sourced timber immediately after the declaration of hostilities in 1939 triggered a radical shift in forest management, diverting focus from forest conservation, the main objective of the forestry code, to exploitation. Prices set without regard to the economic value of the exploited resources, amid endemic inflation and arbitrary rationing practices, fostered overexploitation of forests and distorted income distribution, to the detriment of production-phase workers and the State budget. Furthermore, indicative estimates are provided of the toll exacted on forests by substituting fuelwood and cedar timber for imports. Finally, the risk of environmental degradation from the depletion of forest cover is exacerbated by livestock grazing, which prevents overexploited areas from regaining their normal capacity to regenerate.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了摩洛哥立法与法国1938年战时国家组织法接轨后，林业运营的演变及其影响。1939年战争爆发后，燃料木材和本地木材替代了和平时期依赖的碳氢化合物和进口木材，导致森林管理从保护转向过度开发。价格设定忽视经济价值、通货膨胀和配给制度加剧了森林过度开采和收入分配扭曲。文章还估算了燃料木材和雪松木材替代进口对森林造成的损失，并指出过度放牧加剧了环境退化风险。
AI.research_question: 摩洛哥立法与法国1938年战时法接轨后，林业运营如何演变，以及这种演变对森林资源、收入分配和环境产生了哪些影响？
AI.motivation: 探讨战时资源替代政策对森林管理的根本性转变及其经济、生态后果，揭示价格机制失灵和配给制度对林业可持续发展的破坏作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战时经济管理理论、森林资源管理与保护理论、资源替代与价格机制理论、收入分配理论。
AI.method: 历史分析法、定性描述与定量估算相结合。通过分析政策变化、木材替代数据、价格机制和配给制度，估算森林资源消耗和环境损失。
AI.findings: 战时资源替代导致森林管理从保护转向过度开发；价格制定忽略经济价值，加上通货膨胀和配给制度，造成森林过度开采和收入分配扭曲（损害生产阶段工人和国家预算）；燃料木材和雪松木材替代进口对森林造成严重损失；过度放牧阻碍了被过度开采区域的森林再生能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了战时资源管理对森林生态系统影响的理论理解，揭示了价格机制失灵与制度扭曲在森林过度开发中的关键作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为战时或危机时期的森林资源管理政策提供历史教训，警示价格机制和配给制度设计不当可能导致资源耗尽和环境退化；为摩洛哥及类似发展中国家在特殊时期的林业规划提供参考。

title: Predicted, Not Provoked: Financial Vulnerability as the Structural Driver of Activist Intervention in Japan

detail.title: Predicted, Not Provoked: Financial Vulnerability as the Structural Driver of Activist Intervention in Japan
detail.abstract: We demonstrate that activist shareholder intervention in Japan is structurally predictable from publicly available financial data years before it occurs. Using the ACTS (Activist Candidate Target Score) model applied to 3,569 Tokyo Stock Exchange listed companies, we show that firms subsequently targeted by activist investors score significantly higher on financial vulnerability measures three years before intervention (mean difference: +3.31 points, p<0.001), with the gap widening monotonically to +9.07 points at the time of intervention. Firms in the highest vulnerability quartile experience intervention at 49.67 times the rate of firms in the lowest quartile. The dominant early-warning signals-institutional ownership ratio and float ratio-are structural ownership characteristics entirely independent of corporate controversy. Three lines of evidence reject the scandal hypothesis: the pre-intervention score divergence predates any corporate event; the earliest predictive signals are structural, not event-driven; and the activists themselves explicitly deny the scandal thesis in primary-source interviews. These findings establish that activist intervention is the visible endpoint of a multi-year process rooted in financial vulnerability, not an unpredictable external shock to corporate governance.

AI.tldr: 本文证明，在日本，激进股东干预可以通过公开财务数据提前数年进行结构预测，而非不可预测的外部冲击。研究利用ACTS模型分析了3569家东京证券交易所上市公司，发现被激进投资者盯上的公司在干预前三年财务脆弱性评分已显著更高（平均差异+3.31分），且差距逐年扩大至干预时的+9.07分。最高脆弱性四分位公司的干预率是最低四分位公司的49.67倍。关键的早期预警信号——机构持股比例和流通股比例——是与公司争议无关的结构性所有权特征。三项证据反驳了“丑闻假说”：评分差异先于任何公司事件出现；最早的预测信号是结构性而非事件驱动的；激进投资者本人在原始访谈中也否认丑闻论点。这些发现表明，激进干预是基于财务脆弱性的多年进程的可见终点，而非对公司治理的不可预测外部冲击。
AI.research_question: 在日本市场中，激进股东干预是否可以通过公开财务数据提前数年进行结构性预测？这种干预是财务脆弱性长期积累的结果，还是不可预测的外部冲击（如公司丑闻）所引发？
AI.motivation: 挑战既有的“冲击假说”——认为激进股东干预是突发、不可预测的事件。如果干预可以提前预测，那么公司治理研究需要重新理解激进主义作为长期财务脆弱性累积的结果，管理者也可以提前采取防御措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 财务脆弱性理论（Financial Vulnerability Theory）；结构性所有权特征理论（Structural Ownership Characteristics）；丑闻假说（Scandal Hypothesis）的反驳框架。
AI.method: 构建ACTS（Activist Candidate Target Score）模型，基于公开财务数据计算3569家东京证券交易所上市公司的财务脆弱性评分。采用纵向比较（干预前三年至干预时点的评分差异分析）、分组比较（最高与最低脆弱性四分位公司的干预率）以及三项证据反驳丑闻假说（时间序列分析、信号来源分析、原始访谈验证）。
AI.findings: （1）被干预公司干预前三年财务脆弱性评分已显著更高（+3.31分，p<0.001），差距单调扩大至干预时的+9.07分；（2）最高脆弱性四分位公司干预率是最低四分位的49.67倍；（3）早期预警信号为结构性所有权特征（机构持股比、流通股比），与公司争议无关；（4）三项证据一致拒绝丑闻假说。
AI.theory_contributions: 将激进股东干预重新概念化为一个可预测的多年前进程的可见终点，而非不可预测的外部冲击；建立了财务脆弱性与激进主义之间的结构性因果链条；反驳了主流的丑闻驱动假说。
AI.practical_contributions: 为日本上市公司管理层提供了早期预警工具（ACTS模型），使其能够在激进干预发生前数年识别自身脆弱性并采取主动治理改进；为投资者和政策制定者提供了理解激进股东行为逻辑的实证基础。

title: Building Tomorrow's Identity Today: The 4MQ Framework for Early Childhood Resource Education through Narrative
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Building Tomorrow's Identity Today: The 4MQ Framework for Early Childhood Resource Education through Narrative
detail.abstract: This conceptual study proposes a narrative-based intervention to foster impulse control and future thinking in preschoolers (ages 3-5) through identity development. The Current Me formula-where present identity emerges from past experiences, future vision, internal feelings, and external influences-frames how "Max and the Bananas That Vanished" serves as narrative scaffolding, facilitating exploration within the Four Money Quadrants (4MQ) framework. A 20-minute classroom protocol combines storytelling with token-based activities, helping children explore resource decisions as identity choices rather than rules to follow. A Kuwaiti pilot study demonstrates the framework's cross-cultural diagnostic validity. While empirical validation awaits, this approach offers educators practical tools for integrating financial concepts with social-emotional learning through developmentally appropriate narrative pedagogy. The framework's key contribution is identifying observable indicators of early financial identity development that can be developed into validated measurement instruments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于叙事的干预方法，通过身份发展培养3-5岁幼儿的冲动控制和未来思维，结合"Max and the Bananas That Vanished"故事和"四钱象限"框架，并在科威特进行了试点研究。
AI.research_question: 如何通过叙事干预培养学龄前儿童的冲动控制、未来思维和早期金融身份发展？
AI.motivation: 幼儿期是冲动控制和未来思维发展的关键窗口，但现有干预方法缺乏以身份发展为抓手、融合社会情感学习与金融概念的整合性教学工具。
AI.theoretical_framework: "当前我"公式（过去经历、未来愿景、内在感受、外部影响塑造当前身份）；四钱象限（4MQ）框架；叙事支架理论；身份发展理论。
AI.method: 概念性研究，设计20分钟课堂方案（故事讲述+代币活动），科威特试点研究检验跨文化诊断效度。
AI.findings: 该框架在科威特试点中表现出跨文化诊断效度；将资源决策重构为身份选择而非规则遵守；识别出可观测的早期金融身份发展指标。
AI.theory_contributions: 将身份发展理论与幼儿金融教育整合，提出"当前我"公式作为叙事干预的机制框架，识别早期金融身份发展的可观测指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育者提供发展适宜的叙事教学法工具，将金融概念与社会情感学习结合，可用于课堂实践的20分钟标准化方案。

title: Price-index Bias and Innovation under Demand Stagnation
affiliations: Faculty of Economics, Osaka University of Economics

detail.title: Price-index Bias and Innovation under Demand Stagnation
detail.abstract: This paper studies how price-index measurement shapes the macroeconomic effects of innovation under persistent demand shortage. We develop a monetary general equilibrium model with consumption-and intermediate-goods innovation and measurement biases in price indexes. When the consumer price index (CPI) fully captures the welfare gains from consumption variety and quality, both types of innovation operate through productivity improvements. Under demand shortage, this widens the deflationary demand gap and lowers demand for welfare-relevant consumption services. If the CPI instead misses some of these gains, consumption-goods innovation also raises the marginal utility of CPI-deflated expenditure relative to real money balances, lowering the liquidity premium and stimulating demand for consumption services. In contrast, intermediate-goods innovation is contractionary because it improves production efficiency without changing consumer valuation. Thus, R&D policy in stagnation should be evaluated by the types of goods being innovated and by whether price indexes capture the welfare gains from those innovations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究价格指数测量如何影响创新在持续需求不足下的宏观经济效应。当CPI完全捕捉消费品种类和质量提升的福利收益时，两类创新均通过生产率提升发挥作用，但在需求不足下会扩大通缩缺口。若CPI遗漏部分福利收益，消费品创新通过降低流动性溢价刺激需求，而中间品创新则因不改变消费者估值产生紧缩效应。
AI.research_question: 价格指数测量偏差如何影响消费品创新和中间品创新在持续需求不足环境下的宏观经济效应？
AI.motivation: 现实中CPI等价格指数可能无法完全捕捉消费品种类增加和质量改进带来的福利收益，这种测量偏差在需求不足时期可能对创新政策的宏观效果产生重要影响，但既有研究对此关注不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币一般均衡模型，包含消费品创新和中间品创新，以及价格指数中的测量偏差。
AI.method: 理论建模与数值分析：构建包含两类创新（消费品与中间品）和价格指数测量偏差的货币一般均衡模型，分析不同创新类型在不同价格指数测量情景下的宏观经济效应。
AI.findings: （1）当CPI完全捕捉消费品种类和质量福利收益时，两类创新均通过生产率提升起作用，但在需求不足下扩大通缩缺口，降低福利相关的消费服务需求。（2）若CPI遗漏部分福利收益，消费品创新提高CPI平减支出的边际效用相对实际货币余额，降低流动性溢价，刺激消费服务需求。（3）中间品创新因提升生产效率但不改变消费者估值，具有紧缩效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 将价格指数测量偏差纳入创新与需求不足的宏观分析框架，区分了消费品创新与中间品创新的不对称宏观效应，揭示了价格测量如何影响创新通过需求渠道的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为需求不足（停滞）时期的R&D政策制定提供指导：政策评估需考虑创新类型（消费品vs中间品）以及价格指数是否已捕捉相关福利收益，避免因测量偏差导致创新政策的错误设计。

title: Algorithmic Collusion or Algorithmic Confusion? Rethinking the Risks of AI Pricing for Companies and Policymakers
affiliations: Berkeley Research Group, LLC

detail.title: Algorithmic Collusion or Algorithmic Confusion? Rethinking the Risks of AI Pricing for Companies and Policymakers
detail.abstract: Regulators and the public often view the threat of algorithmic collusion through the lens of sophisticated, autonomous agents.  One prevailing view is that as Artificial Intelligence (AI) becomes more advanced, it is more likely to learn to coordinate with rivals to fix prices and extract monopoly rents without human intervention.  A recent line of academic literature challenges this view.  It shows that when an algorithm is not explicitly designed to collude, the risk to competition does not necessarily stem from AI becoming too smart, but potentially from it remaining too simple.  In fact, collusive-looking outcomes discovered in prior studies may be explained by limitations in algorithm design rather than by superior algorithmic intelligence.  These findings have important implications for how supracompetitive pricing is interpreted and for how risks associated with AI pricing are assessed by policymakers, regulators, and companies.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"高级AI更易学会合谋定价"的主流观点，提出算法合谋的风险可能源于算法过于简单而非过于智能，先前研究中发现的合谋现象可能源于算法设计局限而非高级智能。
AI.research_question: 算法合谋的风险到底来自AI的"过于智能"还是"过于简单"？
AI.motivation: 监管者和公众通常认为先进的AI更容易学会与竞争对手合谋定价，但最新学术文献对此提出质疑，需要澄清算法合谋的真实来源，以避免政策误判。
AI.theoretical_framework: 算法合谋理论、AI学习能力与协调行为的关系、算法设计局限性与竞争效应。
AI.method: 文献综述与理论分析，梳理和整合近期关于算法合谋的学术研究成果。
AI.findings: 算法合谋的风险不一定来自AI变得过于智能，而是可能来自算法过于简单；先前研究中的合谋现象可能源于算法设计局限而非高级智能。
AI.theory_contributions: 颠覆了"AI越先进越容易合谋"的传统认知，提出了"简单算法也可能导致合谋"的替代性理论解释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者、政策制定者和企业评估AI定价的竞争风险提供了新的分析框架，提示应关注算法设计的局限性而非仅关注AI的智能化水平。

title: The Occupational Safety Implementation Gap in Small Construction Firms: Multi-State Field Evidence from the United States

detail.title: The Occupational Safety Implementation Gap in Small Construction Firms: Multi-State Field Evidence from the United States

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflicts of interest. SafeTech Occupational Safety Solutions LLC is the author's own firm and is disclosed as part of the research context.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved voluntary, anonymous field observations of publicly accessible worksites. No personal identifying information was collected. Informed verbal consent was obtained from site contacts where applicable. No IRB approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. Field observations were conducted independently by the author.
declarations.clinicalTrialRegistration: Not applicable. This is not a clinical trial.

keywords: occupational safety • construction industry • small firms • implementation gap • OSHA • immigrant workforce • multilingual training • field research • NIOSH

detail.abstract: Occupational fatalities in the U.S. construction sector have remained persistently high for over a decade, with 1,032 deaths recorded in 2024 alone-one every 104 minutes. Despite federal regulatory frameworks, OSHA enforcement mechanisms, and a multi-billion-dollar compliance industry, the fatality rate has not meaningfully declined. This paper argues that the core failure is structural: existing safety solutions are neither integrated nor accessible to the segment where the majority of fatalities occur-small and medium construction firms with fewer than 200 employees. Drawing on structured field research conducted across 16 companies in 7 U.S. states (Massachusetts, Connecticut, Florida, Texas, New York, New Jersey, and California) between 2025 and 2026, this study documents consistent patterns of occupational safety non-compliance driven by four systemic barriers: (1) cost constraints that prevent regular safety training, (2) language gaps that render English-only training ineffective for immigrant workforces, (3) production pressure that systematically overrides safety protocols, and (4) the complete absence of integrated safety and waste management systems. All 16 firms (100%) lacked recurring safety training-relying on onboarding or OSHA 10-hour certification only. Fifteen of 16 firms (94%) had no multilingual safety system in place. All 16 firms presented at least one documented noncompliance condition. The findings suggest that current occupational safety systems remain structurally inaccessible to a substantial portion of the U.S. construction workforce, supporting the urgent need for scalable, implementation-oriented, and culturally adapted national safety models. These results carry direct implications for NIOSH research priorities, OSHA enforcement strategy, and federal investment in integrated safety infrastructure for small and medium construction enterprises.

AI.tldr: 美国建筑行业工伤死亡率持续居高不下（2024年每104分钟死亡1人），核心问题在于现有安全体系对中小建筑公司（员工<200人）结构性不可及。通过对7州16家企业的实地研究发现，成本约束、语言障碍、生产压力和安全与废物管理系统的缺失是导致100%企业缺乏持续安全培训、94%企业缺乏多语言安全系统的四大系统性障碍。
AI.research_question: 为什么美国建筑行业的工伤死亡率在过去十余年未能显著下降？现有职业安全体系为何对中小建筑企业失效？
AI.motivation: 美国建筑行业工伤死亡率长期居高不下（2024年1032人死亡，每104分钟1人），尽管存在联邦监管框架（OSHA）和数十亿美元的合规产业，但死亡率未有效下降，这一悖论亟需解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构性不可及理论（structural inaccessibility）：安全解决方案从设计上对中小建筑企业不可及，而非简单的企业意愿或认知问题。
AI.method: 结构化实地调研：覆盖美国7个州（马萨诸塞州、康涅狄格州、佛罗里达州、得克萨斯州、纽约州、新泽西州、加利福尼亚州）的16家建筑企业，于2025-2026年开展。
AI.findings: （1）100%的企业（16/16）缺乏持续性安全培训，仅依赖入职培训或OSHA 10小时认证；（2）94%的企业（15/16）没有多语言安全系统；（3）100%的企业存在至少一项记录在案的不合规情况；（4）四大系统性障碍：成本约束、语言鸿沟、生产压力、安全与废物管理系统整合缺失。
AI.theory_contributions: 将职业安全研究的焦点从企业个体行为转向系统性结构障碍，提出"结构性不可及"分析框架，揭示安全解决方案的设计本身对特定企业群体排除的问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为NIOSH研究优先事项、OSHA执法策略和联邦对中小企业安全基础设施投资提供直接政策依据；呼吁建立可扩展、实施导向、文化适应的国家安全模型。

title: Flapping-Wings Drones for Pests and Diseases Detection in Horticulture

detail.title: Flapping-Wings Drones for Pests and Diseases Detection in Horticulture
detail.abstract: Agriculture and horticulture are essential for ensuring safe food to the growing global population, but they also contribute significantly to climate change and biodiversity loss due to the extensive use of chemicals. Integrated pest management is currently employed to monitor and control pest populations, but it relies on labor-intensive methods with low accuracy. Automating crop monitoring using aerial robotics, such as flapping-wing drones, presents a viable solution. This study explores the application of deep learning algorithms, You Only Look Once (YOLO) and Faster region-based convolutional neural network regions with convolutional neural networks (R-CNN), for pest and disease detection in greenhouse environments. The research involved collecting and annotating a diverse dataset of images and videos of common pests and diseases affecting tomatoes, bell peppers, and cucumbers cultivated in Dutch greenhouses. Data augmentation and image resizing techniques were applied to enhance the dataset. The study compared the performance of YOLO and Faster R-CNN, with YOLO demonstrating superior performance. Testing on data acquired by flapping-wing drones showed that YOLO could detect powdery mildew with accuracy ranging from 0.29 to 0.61 despite the shaking movement induced by the actuation system of the drone’s flapping wings.

AI.tldr: 本研究探索利用深度学习算法（YOLO和Faster R-CNN）结合扑翼无人机，实现温室环境中病虫害的自动检测。研究发现YOLO算法性能优于Faster R-CNN，即使在扑翼无人机抖动条件下，仍能检测白粉病（准确率0.29-0.61）。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习算法（YOLO和Faster R-CNN）结合扑翼无人机，实现温室环境中病虫害的自动检测？
AI.motivation: 传统农业病虫害监测依赖人工方法，劳动强度大且精度低；同时农业化学品的大量使用导致气候变化和生物多样性丧失。因此，需要自动化、高精度的作物监测方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 深度学习目标检测算法（YOLO和Faster R-CNN）、扑翼无人机技术、数据增强技术
AI.method: 收集荷兰温室中番茄、甜椒、黄瓜常见病虫害的多样图像和视频数据集，进行标注、数据增强和图像缩放处理；对比YOLO和Faster R-CNN的性能；最后用扑翼无人机采集的数据进行测试。
AI.findings: YOLO算法性能优于Faster R-CNN；在扑翼无人机抖动条件下，YOLO检测白粉病的准确率范围为0.29至0.61。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了深度学习目标检测算法在扑翼无人机抖动条件下的适用性，为农业自动化监测提供了理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为温室作物病虫害的自动化、高精度监测提供了可行方案，减少对人工监测和化学农药的依赖，有助于可持续农业发展。

title: The efficacy of the Triple P program on reducing parental physical violence in a low-resource setting in Kenya
affiliations: University of Konstanz, Queensland University of Technology, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Konstanz

detail.title: The efficacy of the Triple P program on reducing parental physical violence in a low-resource setting in Kenya

publicationDetails.detailsText: []
CHIABUNEG-D-26-00917

detail.abstract: Background: Parenting programs are effective in reducing harsh discipline, increasing parental effectiveness, and improving parent-child relationships and child adjustment. However, research is sparse regarding their benefits in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs), despite the high prevalence of physical discipline. Objective: This study evaluated the efficacy of the Group Triple P — Positive Parenting Program in improving parenting and reducing harsh discipline in a low-resource setting in Kisumu, Kenya. This is the first randomized controlled trial of Group Triple P in sub-Saharan Africa. Participants and setting: Participants (N = 156) were caregivers of children aged 2-12 years, randomized to the intervention or a waitlist condition. The intervention was delivered over five weeks. Assessments occurred pre- and post-intervention and at 12-month follow-up. Methods: Outcomes included parenting confidence, discipline practices, child adjustment, and program satisfaction. Analyses used linear mixed models and Cohen’s d effect sizes.Results: The intervention improved parenting confidence (d = 1.44 post-intervention, d = 1.54 at follow-up) and reduced severe physical discipline (d = -0.85 post-intervention, d = -1.07 at follow-up) and negative verbal discipline (d = -1.03 post-intervention, ​d = -1.19 at follow-up). Child conduct and emotional problems also improved. Program satisfaction was high, and effects were sustained at 12-month follow-up.Conclusions: Group Triple P may reduce coercive and violent discipline in LMICs with minimal cultural tailoring. Findings suggest evidence-based parenting supports may be a beneficial part of broader violence reduction strategies in LMICs.Evidence-based parenting supports may contribute to violence reduction strategies in LMICs.

AI.tldr: 这项研究通过随机对照试验，在肯尼亚基苏木的低资源环境中评估了 Group Triple P 育儿项目的效果。结果显示，该干预显著提升了育儿信心，减少了严厉体罚和负面言语管教，并改善了儿童的行为与情绪问题，效果在12个月后仍持续。研究表明，经过最小化文化调整的循证育儿支持项目在低收入和中等收入国家具有减少暴力管教的潜力。
AI.research_question: 在肯尼亚基苏木的低资源环境中，Group Triple P 积极育儿项目能否有效改善育儿方式并减少严厉管教行为？
AI.motivation: 尽管育儿项目在高收入国家已被证明有效，但在低收入和中等收入国家，尤其是撒哈拉以南非洲地区，相关研究非常匮乏。然而这些地区体罚等严厉管教的普遍率很高，因此亟需检验循证育儿项目在此类环境中的效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于社会学习理论和积极育儿框架（Triple P 项目），强调通过增强父母信心、减少强制性和惩罚性管教行为，来改善亲子关系与儿童适应结果。
AI.method: 采用随机对照试验设计，将156名2-12岁儿童的照料者随机分配至干预组（接受为期五周的 Group Triple P 项目）或等待对照组。在干预前、干预后及12个月随访时进行评估，使用线性混合模型和Cohen's d效应量分析数据。
AI.findings: 干预显著提升了育儿信心（干预后d=1.44，随访d=1.54），减少了严重体罚（干预后d=-0.85，随访d=-1.07）和负面言语管教（干预后d=-1.03，随访d=-1.19），儿童的行为和情绪问题也得到改善，且效果在12个月随访时持续。项目满意度高。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在撒哈拉以南非洲地区通过随机对照试验验证了 Group Triple P 项目的有效性，拓展了社会学习理论在低资源环境中的应用，证实了该理论框架在跨文化背景中的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为低收入和中等收入国家提供了经过实证支持的暴力管教减少策略；证明循证育儿支持项目只需最小化文化调整即可有效实施；为将育儿干预纳入更广泛的暴力预防政策提供了依据。
